hook.name: BunniHook
hook.description: Bunni's core Uniswap v4 hook that computes all swap math internally using a configurable Liquidity Density Function (LDF), applies dynamic TWAP-based and surge fees with optional am-AMM for MEV/LVR recapture, and supports automatic pool rebalancing via FloodPlain.

hook.name: BunniHook
hook.description: Bunni protocol's central Uniswap v4 hook that handles swaps using custom liquidity density functions and its own swap math. Implements dynamic surge and TWAP-based fees taken via BeforeSwapDelta, an am-AMM mechanism for LVR/MEV recapture, a TWAP oracle, and auto-rebalancing via FloodPlain.

hook.name: ArrakisPrivateHook
hook.description: Arrakis Finance private vault hook that restricts liquidity additions to authorized vault modules and overrides LP fees per swap direction (zeroForOne/oneForZero) on every swap, enabling custom fee tiers for private Arrakis vaults.

hook.name: BVCC Dynamic Fee Hook (Arbitrum)
hook.description: Dynamically adjusts LP fees per-swap based on current gas price tiers and penalizes high-frequency traders, while collecting an additional protocol fee in afterSwap from the swap output.

hook.name: JBUniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap V4 hook that routes swaps to whichever venue — the V4 pool or the Juicebox project terminal — yields the most output tokens for the user. Uses a built-in TWAP oracle (30-minute window) to estimate V4 output and compares it against live Juicebox terminal previews for both buy-side (pay) and sell-side (cash-out) paths.

hook.name: WETH Hook (Arbitrum)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that enables seamless wrapping and unwrapping of ETH and WETH in a dedicated zero-fee pool, intercepting swaps to perform 1:1 ETH↔WETH conversion while blocking direct liquidity operations.

hook.name: BackGeoOracle
hook.description: A TWAP oracle hook that records price observations and mitigates price impact by executing automatic backruns on large swaps, crediting the original sender with ERC6909 tokens. Only exact-input swaps are supported; calling routers must implement IMsgSender.

hook.name: SafeSwap
hook.description: Anti-rug and anti-whale protection hook. Sell rate limiting, cooldowns, progressive fees, launch protection mode. Immutable config per pool.

hook.name: UniswapV4KEMHook
hook.description: A swap hook that requires a signed off-chain quote in hookData for each swap, validating exchange rate, nonce, and expiry against a designated quote signer. Excess output beyond the signed maximum exchange rate is captured as EG tokens minted as ERC-6909 claims in the PoolManager, claimable by designated accounts.

hook.name: The Pool
hook.description: The Pool protocol's volatility-adjusted fee hook (on-chain contract: DynamicFeeHookV2). Takes a percentage of each swap's output via afterSwapReturnsDelta (25 bps base, scaling up to 37.5 bps under realized volatility) and routes it to a fee distributor. Also supports reserve-sale fills in beforeSwap, where a registered vault can offer single-sided inventory to swappers at a chosen price in either price-improvement or vault-spread mode.

hook.name: Alphix
hook.description: JIT (just-in-time) liquidity hook that atomically adds concentrated liquidity around each swap in beforeSwap and removes it in afterSwap to improve price execution. Uses a dynamic fee algorithm that adjusts LP fees based on the pool's token ratio, and re-hypothecates idle liquidity to external yield sources.

hook.name: The Pool
hook.description: Uniswap v4 dynamic fee hook that captures 25 bps per swap (scaling 1.5× in volatile blocks) and routes 80% of fees back to in-range LPs via poolManager.donate(), with the remaining 20% to treasury. Pairs with an ERC-4626 vault for auto-compounding LP yield. No emissions token.

hook.name: WLimitOrderHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing single-tick limit orders with atomic swap + order placement. Users place orders by adding concentrated liquidity at a specific tick; when the pool price crosses that tick, the position is automatically filled. The swapAndPlaceOrder() function combines a swap and limit order placement in a single transaction, preventing front-running. Filled orders can be withdrawn at any time.

hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: Tracks swap fees in afterSwap and periodically collects them from an LP position, burning non-native token proceeds. Distributes accumulated ETH fees weekly to vMooney token holders who check in each week.

hook.name: TokiHook
hook.description: Custom curve hook implementing a Pendle-style fixed-rate AMM for Principal Token / underlying token pairs on Uniswap v4. Handles all liquidity operations directly, maintains a TWAP oracle for log-implied rates, supports optional ERC4626 rehypothecation vaults, and gates swaps on both a curator-controlled pause flag and a PT maturity expiry.

hook.name: TokiHook
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook for fixed-maturity Principal Token yield markets, implementing a Pendle-style curve via beforeSwapReturnsDelta. Supports optional rehypothecation into ERC4626 vaults, TWAP oracle tracking, and hooklet plugins; swaps are permanently blocked after pool maturity.

hook.name: FedzHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a stablecoin pool that restricts swaps and liquidity operations to the current active player in an external time-slot system (checked via tx.origin), and reverts any swap whose post-execution price falls below a configurable depeg threshold.

hook.name: External DEX Wrapper (Arbitrum)
hook.description: Routes Uniswap v4 swaps through the Camelot (Algebra) V3 ETH/USDC pool on Arbitrum, intercepting swaps in beforeSwap and fully settling them via BeforeSwapDelta with a configurable owner-adjustable fee ratio.

hook.name: ArrakisPrivateHook
hook.description: Arrakis private vault hook that overrides LP fees per swap direction (zero-for-one vs one-for-zero) via beforeSwap, and restricts liquidity addition to the vault's authorized module only.

hook.name: DopplerHookInitializer
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 pool initializer implementing the Doppler Multicurve bonding curve mechanism for token launches. Distributes liquidity across multiple tick ranges, supports optional dynamic LP fee adjustment via an associated Doppler hook, and enforces a graduation condition when the pool price reaches a target tick.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook implementing a per-pool buyback-and-burn mechanism. On sells of the designated main token, a pot absorbs a portion at the pool's exact execution price (shield, via beforeSwap delta). On buys, pot funds purchase more of the main token and deliver it to a configured recipient or burn address (pump, via afterSwap nested swap). Optionally manages an auto-compounding hook-held LP position whose fees are split between compounding, buyback, and burn.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: Full-range AMM hook with a truncated geometric mean oracle that dynamically adjusts LP fees (base + surge) based on tick movement. Charges a configurable protocol fee share on each swap and reinvests it into a full-range liquidity position via the FullRangeLiquidityManager.

hook.name: CoalaArbitrumHook
hook.description: A Coala launch hook that collects a 1% buy and sell tax on swaps in registered pools. Tax is taken from the specified or unspecified currency via BeforeSwapDelta (beforeSwap) and AfterSwapDelta (afterSwap), minting ERC6909 tokens to the project token address.

hook.name: VTSwapHook(ATH-vATH)
hook.description: A custom AMM hook that implements a vesting token (VT) to underlying token (T) swap market with a custom pricing curve delegated to an external helper contract, completely replacing Uniswap v4's default concentrated liquidity mechanism.

hook.name: VTSwapHook
hook.description: A custom-curve Uniswap v4 hook that implements an AMM for swapping between a Vesting Token (VT) and its underlying token (T), delegating pricing to an external helper contract. Provides its own LP token (ERC-20) and manages reserves directly, replacing the standard concentrated liquidity curve.

hook.name: Slippage Fee Hook (Arbitrum)
hook.description: Dynamically computes LP fees before each swap based on the simulated price impact (tick difference between current and post-swap price), charging higher fees for larger swaps to reduce impermanent loss for liquidity providers. Requires pools to use dynamic fees and reverts any swap that would cause slippage exceeding 5%.

hook.name: JBUniswapV4Hook
hook.description: Routes exact-input swaps to whichever venue—Uniswap V4 pool or Juicebox project terminal (pay/cashOut)—offers the best output, using a 30-minute TWAP oracle for price-manipulation resistance. Also implements IGeomeanOracle so external contracts (e.g. buyback hooks) can query this pool's TWAP.

hook.name: TokiHook
hook.description: Custom AMM hook implementing Pendle-style yield trading for Principal Tokens on Uniswap v4. Computes swaps against a custom curve in beforeSwap, returning a delta, with support for ERC4626 rehypothecation, a TWAP oracle, and curator-controlled pause and pool expiry.

hook.name: Limit Order Hook (Arbitrum)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that enables limit order functionality by recording the tick before each swap and delegating to a LimitOrderManager contract after each swap to execute any limit orders whose tick range was crossed. Supports dynamic LP fee updates via a permissioned fee manager role.

hook.name: EMADynamicFeeHook
hook.description: EMA-based dynamic fee hook for Uniswap V4. Calculates swap fees using Exponential Moving Average of price, with 30-step fee schedule (0.01%-3.00%) and 300-block anti-JIT protection via tx.origin. No owner, no admin functions, fully immutable.

hook.name: BlockAddLiquidityHook
hook.description: Records the EOA that initialized each pool (via tx.origin) and blocks all subsequent liquidity additions from any other origin address, making each pool effectively single-provider.

hook.name: Clanker Static Fee Hook (Arbitrum)
hook.description: A Clanker token launch hook for Arbitrum that applies separate, configurable LP fees for buys and sells of the Clanker token (set statically at pool initialization), and collects a protocol fee on each swap via beforeSwap and afterSwap delta adjustments. It also includes a short-lived MEV protection module active in the first two minutes after pool creation.

hook.name: Clanker Dynamic Fee Hook (Arbitrum)
hook.description: Clanker V4 hook for autonomous token deployment with dynamic fees that adjust based on swap volatility using a tick-based accumulator model. Also includes MEV protection via an optional external module active for the first 2 minutes after pool creation.

hook.name: StrategyFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 10% fee (1000 bps) on the output token of each swap in owner-allowlisted pools, then converts the collected fees to AVAX or WAVAX and forwards them to a configurable strategy manager contract.

hook.name: StrategyFeeHook
hook.description: Collects a fixed 10% fee on the output token of every swap in owner-allowlisted pools, converting non-AVAX fees to AVAX via an in-pool swap, and forwarding all collected fees to a configurable strategy manager contract.

hook.name: AuthSwaps
hook.description: A KYC-gated Uniswap v4 hook that restricts swaps, liquidity operations, and pool initialization to addresses verified through the Manifest Finance AuthManager contract. Swaps are additionally gated by a per-chain trusted-sender allowlist.

hook.name: StrategyFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a 10% fee on the output token of each swap in owner-allowlisted pools, converting non-AVAX fees to AVAX via an in-pool nested swap, then forwarding all collected fees to a configurable strategy manager contract.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: Buyback-and-burn hook that shields main-token sells by absorbing them at pool execution price (no price impact, via beforeSwap delta) and pumps on buys using a per-pool donation pot. Optionally supports a hook-held LP program with auto-compounding, configurable fee splits, and burn/recipient delivery.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: Dynamic-fee hook that charges configurable protocol fees on swaps (exactIn in beforeSwap, exactOut in afterSwap), reinvests accrued fees into full-range liquidity positions via a FullRangeLiquidityManager, and maintains a truncated geometric TWAP oracle with auto-tuning tick-cap frequency.

hook.name: AuthSwaps
hook.description: Restricts swaps, liquidity operations, and pool initialization to users verified as whitelisted and not banned or sanctioned by an external Manifest Finance Auth Manager contract, with router-level access gated via an owner-managed trusted-sender allowlist.

hook.name: ArenaHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook that charges a configurable percentage of swap output in afterSwap, distributing fees to multiple recipients defined by an external ArenaFeeHelper contract. Pool initialization is restricted to allowlisted deployer addresses.

hook.name: BunniHook
hook.description: Core Uniswap v4 hook for the Bunni v2 protocol. Replaces standard AMM swap execution with custom Liquidity Density Functions (LDFs), dynamic surge-fee pricing, optional am-AMM for fee management, a TWAP oracle, auto-rebalancing via Flood, and a per-pool hooklet plugin system.

hook.name: BunniHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for Bunni v2 concentrated liquidity pools that handles the entire swap lifecycle in beforeSwap using custom Liquidity Density Function math, dynamic surge fees, a TWAP oracle, am-AMM auction-based LVR/MEV recapture, and automated FloodPlain-based rebalancing.

hook.name: BunniHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that fully handles swap execution via custom BunniSwapMath, computing output amounts and fees directly rather than delegating to the pool manager. Features a TWAP oracle, dynamic surge-based fees, am-AMM manager fee support, and a hooklet plugin system for extensible fee and price overrides.

hook.name: DeliHookConstantProduct
hook.description: A constant-product (x*y=k) AMM hook that replaces Uniswap v4's concentrated liquidity with a Uniswap v2-style curve. Manages pool reserves directly, collects swap fees in wBLT, forwards fees to a FeeProcessor, and notifies gauge contracts on swaps and liquidity changes.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. Only the afterInitialize permission is active; the callback itself is a no-op. Pool setup is handled externally via initializePools(), which calls a LiquidityBootstrapper contract and records the initial tick.

hook.name: TokenMesaHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable USDC-denominated fee (up to 1%) on every swap using an internal TWAP oracle (circular buffer of 100 tick observations) to convert token amounts to USDC. Fees are deducted via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas and forwarded to a configurable recipient address controlled by the owner.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Saturn Omnichain with only the afterInitialize permission. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op stub. Pool setup is handled externally via initializePools(), which delegates to a linked ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper to set the initial tick and mark the pool as initialized.

hook.name: AdvancedFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a configurable tax on each swap (up to 10%), split between a platform treasury, a burn address, single-sided liquidity re-injection, and up to 8 creator payees. Pool initialization is restricted to a designated launcher address.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Saturn Omnichain hook that uses only the afterInitialize permission as a no-op callback. Exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to an ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to seed initial liquidity and records the resulting initial tick.

hook.name: Zora Hook
hook.description: Zora's Uniswap v4 hook for their Coins protocol on Base, which applies a dynamic launch fee that decays from 99% to 1% over the 10 seconds after coin creation. On every swap it collects LP fees, converts them to a backing currency, and distributes rewards to creators and trade referrers.

hook.name: GovernedLBPStrategy
hook.description: A governance-controlled Liquidity Bootstrapping Pool (LBP) strategy hook that restricts pool initialization to the contract itself and blocks all swaps until a designated governance address approves migration. After approval, it deploys full-range liquidity from a completed token distribution phase.

hook.name: UniClawHookV4
hook.description: Dual-mode Uniswap v4 hook supporting agent-only pools (requiring on-chain agent registry verification) and public pools. Captures swap fees via afterSwapReturnDelta with optional reputation-based fee discounts for verified agents.

hook.name: CabalFeeHook
hook.description: Platform fee hook that charges a configurable fee (default 1%) on every swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta. ETH fees are forwarded directly to a fee receiver; token fees are sent to a CabalFeeExecutor contract that sells them for ETH before distribution. Supports time-based launch fees with optional half-parabola decay curve.

hook.name: LpGuardHook
hook.description: A hook that restricts pool initialization to a single whitelisted launcher address, reverting any attempt to initialize a pool from an unauthorized caller.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that subscribes only to afterInitialize (as a no-op selector return) and exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to a liquidity bootstrapper contract to record the pool's initial tick.

hook.name: TupleOracleHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that maintains a TWAP oracle (truncated observations) and a liquidity book tracking liquidity distribution across tick buckets. It records collateralized debt positions via hookData on liquidity operations, overrides swap fees based on direction (zero fee for tuple→wrapped-native swaps, fixed LP_FEE otherwise), and donates wrapped-native fees back to LPs on qualifying swaps.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only afterInitialize active (as a no-op selector return). Provides an initializePools() function that calls an external liquidity bootstrapper contract to record the initial tick and mark the pool as initialized.

hook.name: CapGate
hook.description: Reverts swaps where the absolute amount specified exceeds MAX_TRADE (100e18 units). Inherits AeonFee, which takes a mandatory 10 bps fee on the unspecified (output) currency of every swap via afterSwap return delta, routing it to a hardcoded recipient.

hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Clanker token pools that applies directional static LP fees (configurable per-pool for buying vs. selling the Clanker token), collects protocol fees by modifying swap deltas via beforeSwapReturnsDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta, and supports optional MEV modules (temporary high-fee anti-sniping) and pool extensions during the swap lifecycle.

hook.name: GovernedLBPStrategy
hook.description: A governance-controlled Liquidity Bootstrapping Pool (LBP) strategy hook that restricts pool initialization to the contract itself and blocks all swaps until a designated governance address approves migration.

hook.name: BoardHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a token launch platform that manages fair launch token sales (one-sided positions with time-gating, optional Merkle whitelist, and premine for creators), captures protocol swap fees and distributes them to the protocol, creator, and inspired-by recipients, and blocks direct pool initialization (pools must be created via the `publiphi` function).

hook.name: OwnerManagedRangeHook
hook.description: Owner-managed concentrated liquidity hook for a single SLEUTH/USDC pool on Base. Maintains two hook-owned positions (a main concentrated range and a single-sided USDC bid), with owner-controlled seeding, reanchoring, and optional auto-compounding of accrued fees triggered on each swap.

hook.name: ZoraV4CoinHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for Zora Coins that collects LP fees on every swap, converts them to a backing currency via multi-hop paths, and distributes them as rewards. On initialization it provisions multiple liquidity positions per coin configuration, and after each swap it fills Zora limit orders based on the tick range crossed.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that registers afterInitialize permission but performs no swap-modifying logic. Exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract to set up initial liquidity and record the initial tick.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. Only the afterInitialize permission is enabled; swap behavior is fully vanilla.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that enables afterInitialize but performs no action in the callback. Provides an external initializePools() function that calls a separate liquidity bootstrapper contract to seed initial pool liquidity and record the starting tick.

hook.name: Apex Yield
hook.description: Oracle-priced market maker hook that intercepts swaps at Pyth oracle price + dynamic fee. Fees accumulate in-pool and are distributed as dual-token rewards to LP depositors via a Synthetix-style accumulator. ~285K gas per swap.

hook.name: AI Protocol Swap Fee Hook v1 (Base)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a configurable fee on swaps involving a designated fee token. Fees are collected in beforeSwap and afterSwap based on whether the operation is a buy or sell and whether the swap is exact-in or exact-out, then forwarded to a configured fee recipient contract.

hook.name: Zora Creator Hook v2.2.1 (Base)
hook.description: A Uniswap V4 hook for Zora's Creator Coin protocol that automatically collects LP fees after each swap, converts them to a backing currency via multi-hop paths, and distributes rewards to creators and trade referrers. On pool initialization, it sets up multiple liquidity positions based on the coin's Doppler multi-curve configuration.

hook.name: BerylPadHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: A BerylPad launchpad hook that enforces asymmetric static LP fees (separate buy and sell rates for the launched token) and collects a 20% protocol fee on every swap via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta adjustments. Includes a time-limited MEV protection module active immediately after pool launch and optional configurable pool extensions.

hook.name: GovernedLBPStrategy
hook.description: A Liquidity Bootstrapping Pool (LBP) hook that gates pool initialization to the strategy contract itself and blocks all swaps until a designated governance address approves migration, then migrates raised funds into a full-range Uniswap v4 liquidity position.

hook.name: SpectraHook
hook.description: Standalone afterSwap hook for SpectraLaunch token pools: after each swap, harvests the pool token's parked fee balance via takeFeeBalance(), auto-sells it for ETH via a nested poolManager.swap() call, then distributes the ETH proceeds to token holders pro-rata via the token's creditPoolFees() accumulator.

hook.name: OriginFeeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for native ETH/TOKEN pools that charges a configurable 1.5–3.5% fee on every exact-input swap, with optional linear anti-sniper fee decay from 80% down to the base rate. Fees are collected in native ETH via BeforeSwapDelta (buys) and AfterSwapDelta (sells); exact-output swaps are blocked.

hook.name: ArrakisPrivateHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Arrakis private vaults that overrides LP fees per swap direction (zeroForOne vs oneForZero) as configured by the vault executor, and restricts liquidity additions to the vault's active module.

hook.name: TripoolsAntiSnipeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Tripools launch factory pools that enforces a 6-second anti-snipe window (50% tax for non-whitelisted buyers) and collects dynamic tiered ETH swap fees, splitting revenue between the protocol treasury and the pool creator via TripoolsFeeLocker.

hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: Clanker protocol hook that configures asymmetric static LP fees per pool (separate buy and sell rates for the clanker token), collects protocol fees from swaps via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, and includes an optional MEV module that can temporarily raise fees to deter sandwich attacks during the initial liquidity deployment window.

hook.name: A51peg Hook
hook.description: A51pegHook locks the A51peg token pool on first liquidity addition, and in afterSwap opportunistically triggers NFT reveal when an unrevealed token is pending. Emits swap analytics events via AlienSwap. No swap access control.

hook.name: TruthMarketHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for TrueMarkets prediction pools that tracks tick movements across swaps to trigger range-order settlement via an OrderManager, optionally validates swaps against tick boundaries via a configurable SwapValidator, and deducts a configurable protocol fee from swap output using afterSwapReturnsDelta.

hook.name: SuperStrategy Hook (Base)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects a 2% fee on each swap and auto-compounds the accumulated reserves back into pool liquidity. It forwards 0.30% to a protocol fee receiver, allows admin-designated market makers to trade fee-free, and supports multi-pool liquidity management with configurable auto-compounding thresholds.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook with only the afterInitialize permission, which is a no-op. Provides an initializePools() function that delegates to an external liquidity bootstrapper contract to seed initial pool liquidity and record the starting tick.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that only subscribes to afterInitialize. An external liquidity bootstrapper contract supplies the initial tick, which is stored in public state. All swap, liquidity, and donate callbacks are pure no-ops that return their respective selectors with no side effects.

hook.name: Flaunch PositionManager
hook.description: The Flaunch protocol's central Uniswap v4 hook managing the full memecoin lifecycle: a time-gated fair launch phase (buy-only), an internal swap pool that recycles accumulated fees as liquidity before hitting the Uniswap pool, protocol and creator fee distribution, and a bid wall for buy-side liquidity support.

hook.name: tokens.fun HookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: Token launchpad hook with static fees, MEV protection, automated LP locking, fee conversion, and pool extensions. Used by tokens.fun on Base.

hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: A Clanker protocol hook with configurable per-direction static LP fees (clanker vs paired token direction), dynamically updated on each swap via updateDynamicLPFee. Collects a 20% protocol fee on the non-clanker token per trade using BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, with optional MEV protection modules and pool extensions.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 launchpad hook that gates pool creation and liquidity management to a factory, permanently locks single-sided token liquidity, and charges configurable fees on swaps—split among creator, platform, referrer, and fixed recipients—with a linearly-decaying anti-snipe surcharge in a configurable window after launch.

hook.name: AdvancedFeeHookV5
hook.description: Collects a configurable swap fee (up to 10%) in afterSwap, splitting it between a platform treasury and per-pool creator payees; portions of the creator share may be burned or reinvested as single-sided liquidity. Pool initialization is gated to a designated launcher address.

hook.name: SnapBackHook
hook.description: Oracle-based market maker using Pyth price feeds, dynamic fees, and atomic multi-DEX rebalancing

hook.name: MoonsendFeeHook_BASE
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that enforces per-pool dynamic LP fee overrides. Pools must be pre-registered by an authorized factory before initialization; `beforeSwap` returns the registered fee with the OVERRIDE_FEE_FLAG set, overriding the pool's LP fee on every swap.

hook.name: ZoraV4CoinHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for Zora Coins that initializes multiple Doppler-curve liquidity positions on pool creation. On every swap, collects LP fees, converts them to a backing currency, and distributes rewards. Features a dynamic launch fee decaying from 99% to 1% over 10 seconds post-creation, and triggers Zora limit order book fills on each swap.

hook.name: BpegHook
hook.description:
An afterSwap hook that syncs NFT metadata with token balance. 
When a user buys BPEG tokens, the hook mints NFT metadata 
proportional to their integer balance. When they sell, it burns 
NFT metadata accordingly. Uses tx.origin to identify the end user.

hook.name: Flaunch POSM v4 (Base)
hook.description: Flaunch's PositionManager is a Uniswap v4 hook that manages the full lifecycle of memecoin launches, from token creation and fair-launch phase to ongoing swaps. It incorporates an InternalSwapPool for protocol fee accumulation, a BidWall for native-token liquidity support, and a FeeDistributor that routes swap fees to creators and optional referrers encoded in hookData.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that implements only afterInitialize as a no-op callback. An external initializePools() function delegates to a liquidity bootstrapper contract to seed initial liquidity and record the pool's starting tick.

hook.name: TELxIncentiveHook
hook.description: Tracks LP positions and fee accruals in an external PositionRegistry to support off-chain incentive/reward distribution. Liquidity callbacks are restricted to an authorized position manager address; no swap logic is implemented.

hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a bonding curve token launch platform. Deploys new ERC20 tokens with configurable multi-chunk liquidity curves backed by a base token, collects a 1% swap fee split equally between creator and platform fee receivers, and automatically graduates tokens to a standard full-range AMM pool when the bonding curve supply is exhausted.

hook.name: ExponentialLiquidityHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook that deploys ERC20 tokens paired with WBTC. It manages segmented liquidity across 10 tick intervals within a fixed price range. When a swap moves the price past the bonding curve's end threshold, the hook removes all liquidity segments and calls enablePackOpening() on the token, graduating it from the bonding curve. Direct pool initialization is blocked; pools must be created via deployERC20Token().

hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: Clanker v2 hook that applies configurable static LP fees with separate rates per swap direction (clanker-in vs. paired-token-in), collects protocol fees via BeforeSwap/AfterSwap return deltas, and supports optional MEV module (temporary high-fee anti-MEV window) and pool extension integrations.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. All swap-related callbacks are no-ops; swap behavior is identical to a standard Uniswap v4 pool.

hook.name: AutoBurnHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for ETH-paired pools (currency0 must be ETH) that charges a configurable per-swap fee (default 1%). On ETH→token swaps, the collected ETH fee is routed through a nested swap via SwapExecutor and the resulting tokens are burned to the dead address. On token→ETH swaps, the collected token fee is transferred directly to the dead address.

hook.name: ZoraV4CoinHook
hook.description: Zora Coin hook that initializes Doppler multi-curve liquidity positions on pool creation, charges a dynamic LP fee each swap, and in afterSwap collects accrued fees, converts them to a backing currency, distributes market rewards, and fills limit orders if the price tick moved.

hook.name: DCAHook
hook.description: A hook that gates liquidity additions on two specific pools: limits the ETH/DCA pool to a single initial liquidity add, and enforces full-range tick bounds (±887200) for the DCA/SPX6900 pool via beforeAddLiquidity.

hook.name: WhaleAIHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook with parabolic fee decay that collects protocol fees via hook deltas on all swap directions (buy/sell, exact-input/exact-output), includes optional same-block MEV protection via hookData, and periodically auto-sells accumulated fees to ETH.

hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that deploys ERC20 tokens via a bonding curve on Uniswap v4, blocking external liquidity additions and removals. When the bonding curve supply is exhausted, it automatically migrates liquidity to a full-range AMM pool. Collects a 5% fee on swaps (1% creator, 1% platform, 3% protocol) distributed to configurable fee receivers via afterSwapReturnsDelta.

hook.name: MoonpotHook
hook.description: A USDC/TMP pool hook that applies dynamic defense taxes on TMP sells (scaled by distance above a configurable price floor), intercepts and burns excess TMP beyond the protocol liquidity cap via BeforeSwapDelta, and records a TWAP oracle to guard against sandwich attacks during liquidity injection.

hook.name: GovernedLBPStrategy
hook.description: A Liquidity Bootstrapping Pool (LBP) strategy hook that restricts pool initialization to the hook contract itself and gates all swaps behind a governance-approved migration flag.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that implements only afterInitialize (no-op). Provides an initializePools() function that delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap initial liquidity and records the initial tick on-chain.

hook.name: HeavierHand
hook.description: Gates swaps to only allow selling the token the pool currently holds more of, based on virtual reserves derived from slot0 price and active liquidity. Past a 10% skew cap the gate inverts so only the rebalancing direction is admitted. Charges a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on every swap via afterSwap return-delta, routed to a fixed recipient address.

hook.name: LayerMemeHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: A meme token launchpad hook that enforces separate static LP fees for buying vs. selling the meme token, collects a 20% protocol fee on each swap via before/afterSwap delta returns, and optionally integrates an MEV protection module (active for up to 2 minutes post-launch) and a pluggable pool extension.

hook.name: Zora Post Hook v2.2.1 (Base)
hook.description: Zora's content coin hook that manages multi-position liquidity for creator coins, collecting swap fees after each trade and distributing them as rewards to creators, referrers, and LPs in a backing currency. Supports liquidity migration to new hook versions via a registered upgrade gate.

hook.name: BVCC Dynamic Fee Hook (Base)
hook.description: An advanced dynamic fee hook by BlockVenture Chain Capital that adjusts LP fees based on gas price, price volatility, and 24-hour trade volume, while applying anti-bot cooldown penalties for repeated swaps. It also collects a small protocol fee on each swap output via afterSwapReturnsDelta.

hook.name: ProjectHook
hook.description: Emits a ProjectPoolInitialized event on pool initialization, recording the pool ID, project token, and sender. Requires one of the pool's currencies to be native ETH; reverts if neither currency is the zero address.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A hook with only the afterInitialize permission, implemented as a no-op stub. Delegates pool initialization and liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract; all swap, liquidity, and donate callbacks are pass-through stubs with no custom logic.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers only the afterInitialize permission. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op (returns the selector only). Includes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper to bootstrap liquidity and record the initial tick.

hook.name: ClawnchHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Clawnch token deployments that sets distinct static LP fees for clawnch-direction vs. paired-direction swaps, and collects a 20% protocol fee on each swap by adjusting swap amounts via beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas.

hook.name: ClawnchHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: Token launcher hook for Base. Fork of Clanker ClankerHookV2 with security fixes: transient storage for reentrant fee safety, slippage protection on fee swaps, MEV decay boundary fix, per-direction static fees, fee preference system, VestedDevBuy extension.

hook.name: SeedifyFeeHook
hook.description: A time-based fundraise fee hook for Uniswap v4 that charges configurable fees on swaps involving a designated fundraise token, with a higher initial rate during a launch window that drops to a lower rate afterward. Fees are split between platform and creator treasuries and accumulated for on-demand withdrawal.

hook.name: Seedify Fee Hook
hook.description: Collects fees on swaps involving a designated fundraising currency. Fees split between platform treasury and optional creator treasury, with launch vs post-launch fee tiers.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; the contract provides an external initializePools() function that delegates to a LiquidityBootstrapper contract to set the initial tick and mark the pool as initialized.

hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: A bonding curve token launch platform hook that manages ERC-20 token launches through a fixed bonding curve phase, collects 1% swap fees split 50/50 between creator and platform fee recipients, and automatically migrates fully-bonded tokens to a standard AMM pool with split single-sided liquidity positions.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. All hook callbacks are no-ops; the only active flag is afterInitialize, which returns the selector without modifying state.

hook.name: BoardHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches with a time-gated FairLaunch period: it blocks trading before a scheduled publish timestamp, fills buy-only swaps from a pre-seeded one-sided liquidity position during FairLaunch, and distributes custom swap fees to referrers, creators, protocol, and inspired parties after the FairLaunch closes.

hook.name: Clanker Dynamic Fee Hook (Base)
hook.description: A Clanker hook that dynamically adjusts LP fees based on tick volatility accumulation, updating pool fees on every swap via updateDynamicLPFee. It also applies a protocol fee by capturing a portion of swaps as EIP-6909 claims, and optionally forwards hookData to an external MEV module during a post-launch window.

hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: A bonding curve token launch hook that blocks external liquidity management (beforeInitialize/beforeAddLiquidity/beforeRemoveLiquidity all revert). Newly launched tokens trade on a bonding curve until the supply cap is reached, then the hook automatically migrates liquidity to a standard AMM pool. Each swap incurs a 1% fee split 50/50 between the creator and platform, taken via afterSwapReturnsDelta.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: An omnichain hook for the Saturn protocol that records the initial tick after pool initialization and coordinates liquidity bootstrapping via an external bootstrapper contract. The hook has no swap-time logic; all swap callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: Wassblaster Hook
hook.description: A hook for wASS/memecoin pairs that charges a 1% total fee (0.3% to LPs, 0.7% to the hook) and routes a configurable portion of buys through an in-swap OTC mechanism at the actual pool rate, distributing wASS fee proceeds to stakers and accumulating memecoin fees as OTC inventory.

hook.name: UruLaunchHook
hook.description: Uniswap V4 hook for the URU token launch that collects a time-decaying sniper tax (up to 99% at launch, decaying to 1% over a configured duration) on each swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta, sending proceeds to a vault. Also tracks per-epoch URU/WETH volume to compute and emit an emission rate signal for external consumers.

hook.name: StableSwapHooks
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a Curve-style StableSwap AMM with full custom accounting. Supports 2–4 currencies with optional rate oracles and dynamic amplification coefficient (ramp). Executes swaps entirely in beforeSwap via BeforeSwapDelta, collecting LP, hook, and protocol fees. Issues its own ERC20 LP token (SSLP).

hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: A bonding curve token launchpad hook that deploys new ERC20 tokens into dedicated Uniswap v4 bonding curve pools. When bonding curve supply is exhausted, the hook automatically removes liquidity and migrates it into a standard AMM pool. A fixed 1% swap fee is collected via afterSwapReturnsDelta and split 50/50 between a creator fee receiver and a platform fee recipient.

hook.name: BoardHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a token launch platform with a fair launch mechanism that fills purchases from a dedicated position, enforces time-gated access control (pre-launch block), optional Merkle-proof whitelisting, and distributes swap fees across protocol, creator, inspired, and referral recipients.

hook.name: BoardHook
hook.description: A fair-launch token launchpad hook that manages a time-gated fair launch period (buy-only, optional Merkle whitelist), closes the fair launch position after expiry while burning unsold tokens, and captures and distributes swap fees among protocol, creator, referrer, and "inspired" recipients on every swap.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for token launchpad pools that locks liquidity to a single-sided position, charges a time-decaying anti-snipe fee on the quote currency around launch, and distributes fees among creator, platform, and optional referrer via a FeeEscrow contract.

hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: Token launch factory hook implementing a bonding curve for newly deployed ERC-20 tokens. Blocks external pool initialization and liquidity additions, collects a 1% swap fee on the base token split between creator and platform, and automatically graduates tokens to a full-range AMM pool when the bonding curve supply threshold is reached.

hook.name: BoardHook
hook.description: A token launch hook that creates and manages ERC20 token pools with a fair launch mechanism. During the fair launch window, the hook provides a one-sided liquidity position, restricts sells, optionally enforces Merkle proof whitelisting, and blocks swaps before a configurable launch timestamp. Swap fees are distributed to creators, protocol, inspired fee recipients, and referrers.

hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Clanker-launched token pools that enforces directional static LP fees (separate rates for buying vs. selling the Clanker token) via updateDynamicLPFee, deducts protocol fees from each swap using return deltas, optionally integrates a MEV protection module, and supports pool extensions via external callbacks.

hook.name: BoardHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook powering a token launchpad ("publiphi") with fair launch mechanics: it enforces a temporal launch window (blocking swaps before launch time), fills buys directly from a one-sided fair launch position during the launch window, and captures fees after every swap distributing them across protocol, creator, referrer, and swapper recipients.

hook.name: UniswapV4ScheduledMulticurveInitializerHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that restricts pool initialization and liquidity additions to a designated initializer contract, enforces a per-pool scheduled start time before which swaps revert with CannotSwapBeforeStartingTime, and emits events for liquidity modifications and swaps.

hook.name: TruthMarketHook
hook.description: A prediction market hook that records pre-swap tick, then in afterSwap calls an external OrderManager to settle limit orders triggered by tick movement. Optionally collects a configurable fee on the unspecified token amount via afterSwapReturnsDelta, and supports per-pool pausing by an operator role.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook with only afterInitialize enabled; the callback is a no-op that returns the selector. Exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external liquidity bootstrapper to seed initial positions and records the resulting tick.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only the `afterInitialize` permission active. The `afterInitialize` callback is a pure no-op stub; the contract also exposes `initializePools()` which calls an external `ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper` to bootstrap pool liquidity.

hook.name: LayerMeme Dynamic Fee Hook v2 (Base)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook used by the LAYERMEME token launch platform. It dynamically adjusts LP fees based on volatility, collects a protocol fee on launched token swaps, and supports optional MEV protection modules and per-pool extensions via custom swap data. The source is verified on BaseScan and the hook is deployed on Base mainnet.

hook.name: UniswapV4KEMHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that enforces signed quotes for exact-input swaps. Each swap requires hookData containing a valid signature from an authorized quoteSigner; if the swap yields more output than the quoted maximum exchange rate allows, the excess is minted as ERC6909 tokens to an admin-controlled recipient.

hook.name: UniswapV4MigratorHook
hook.description: Restricts Uniswap v4 pool initialization to only the UniswapV4Migrator contract by reverting in beforeInitialize if the caller is not the designated migrator address. Has no swap-related hooks.

hook.name: GPX Hook (Base)
hook.description: GPXHooks manages the Uniswap V4 GPX-USDC liquidity pool, collecting 1% fees per swap and distributing them across four destinations (GoldPesa Mines, Treasury, Pawn, and GPX Owner), while blocking unauthorized liquidity changes and periodically triggering automated pool rebalancing.

hook.name: Spectra Launchpad
hook.description: Bonding-curve memecoin launchpad that raises ETH along a linear curve, then graduates into a Uniswap V4 ETH/token pool. ERC-20 balances are mirrored as NFTs ("facets"); pool swap fees are harvested and distributed pro-rata to facet holders in ETH.

hook.name: WontonHook
hook.description: Restricts liquidity additions to a single authorized manager address and gates buy-side swaps behind a governance-controlled `tradingEnabled` flag. Pre-launch exact-input buys are punished: the input token is taken but output is forced to zero via beforeSwapReturnsDelta.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that implements only afterInitialize as a pass-through. Provides an initializePools() function that delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper to bootstrap liquidity and record the initial tick.

hook.name: StockifyFeeHook
hook.description: Takes a fixed 3% fee on ETH-specified swaps in beforeSwap and STFY-specified swaps in afterSwap, routing fees to an immutable DividendVault address via poolManager.take(). Designed for a single ETH/STFY Uniswap v4 pool.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that records the initial tick after pool initialization via a liquidity bootstrapper contract. Only afterInitialize is active; all swap callbacks are no-ops and swap behavior is fully standard Uniswap v4.

hook.name: Vvveity Fee Hook V2
hook.description: Charges a flat immutable fee (in basis points) on every swap via beforeSwap, forwarding the fee inline to either a platform address or the token creator, determined by trade direction and token registration.

hook.name: JanpuHookDynamicFeeV2
hook.description: JANPU Base launchpad hook that adjusts LP fees with a volatility accumulator, collects JANPU protocol fees on launched-token swaps, supports optional MEV fee protection and pool extensions, and accepts empty hook data for standard swaps.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that enables only afterInitialize (as a no-op) and provides an initializePools() function that delegates to an external liquidity bootstrapper contract to set up initial liquidity positions and record the initial tick.

hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: Token launch platform hook implementing a bonding curve for new ERC-20 tokens. Collects configurable platform and creator fees on swaps via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, and automatically graduates tokens to a full AMM pool when the bonding curve supply target is reached.

hook.name: Pubhouse Hook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that performs internal swaps using accumulated token fees to fill buy orders, distributes LP fees between token creators and the protocol team, and automatically buybacks and burns the protocol token when accumulated ETH exceeds a threshold.

hook.name: LiquidHookDynamicFeeV2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that adjusts LP fees dynamically based on a volatility accumulator derived from tick movement between swaps, and collects protocol fees on each swap by modulating swap deltas via beforeSwapReturnsDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta. Supports optional MEV module and pool extension integrations.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only the afterInitialize flag set. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; the contract exposes a separate initializePools() function that delegates to an external liquidity bootstrapper contract to set up initial liquidity and record the starting tick.

hook.name: Politiswap
hook.description: A hook that manages political token ETH/ERC20 pools, taking a 2% fee on each swap and redirecting it to a fee collector. It tracks daily net ETH inflows per pool, determines which pool had the highest inflow each day, and allows holders of that day's winning token to claim governance token rewards.

hook.name: DynamicFeeHookV2
hook.description: Implements a linearly decaying LP fee that starts high at launch and decreases to a steady-state fee over a configurable duration (anti-sniper mechanism). Records an on-chain TWAP oracle after each swap using a cumulative sqrtPrice accumulator.

hook.name: Flaunch POSM v1
hook.description: The Flaunch PositionManager is a Uniswap v4 hook that manages the full lifecycle of memecoin creation and trading, including a fair launch window, an internal swap pool for fee reinvestment, and fee distribution to token creators and referrers.

hook.name: KPEGHook
hook.description: Updates an on-chain randomness seed after each swap in pools containing the configured token, using block variables and swap metadata. On the first liquidity addition to a qualifying pool, calls start() on a lifecycle token contract.

hook.name: GBPFv4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that intercepts all swaps against a USDS/GBPF pool and fully replaces pool math with primary-market mint or redeem operations against a vault, pricing trades via a GBP/USD oracle TWAP, a solvency-indexed spread curve, and a flat 20 bp protocol fee.

hook.name: CurveHook
hook.description: A custom bonding curve AMM hook for FIFA/Country token pairs using a virtual reserve formula to price buys and sells. Charges a 5% fee per swap (burned), fully replaces pool liquidity mechanics (all direct add/remove liquidity and donate operations revert), and gates trading behind a phase-activation flag set by an authorized pack opener.

hook.name: Deli Hook (Base)
hook.description: Collects swap fees always in wBLT and forwards them to a FeeProcessor contract, while enforcing that all pools include wBLT as a token and use dynamic LP fees (overriding them to 0 at swap time). Syncs DailyEpochGauge and IncentiveGauge on every swap to support incentive accounting.

hook.name: TokenFactory
hook.description: A token launch factory that deploys ERC-20 tokens, initializes Uniswap v4 pools with permanently locked liquidity, and collects a 0.5% tax on token purchase swaps (non-WETH output) via the afterSwap hook, forwarding the tax to a fee recipient.

hook.name: Adaptive Burn Hook
hook.description: Automatically burns a configurable percentage of PR token output on buys and captures ETH into a vault on sells. Burn and capture rates are admin-adjustable within bounds, capped at a maximum of 5%.

hook.name: PokeHook
hook.description: Pokeworld's swap hook that collects LP fees and dynamic sell-side charges (including rolling sell tax and price-impact fees) via BeforeSwapDelta, matches buy orders against an internal OTC token inventory, and delegates additional Aerodrome liquidity logic to an immutable hybrid module via delegatecall.

hook.name: Flaunch PositionManager
hook.description: Flaunch's core hook managing memecoin token launches ("flaunches") with single-sided liquidity seeding, an internal swap pool for fee-token conversion, multi-recipient fee distribution (creator, protocol, BidWall), temporal gating for scheduled launches, and per-swap TWAP oracle recording.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that responds to pool initialization. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; the hook exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract to set initial liquidity and records the initial tick.

hook.name: NARA Liquidity Growth Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a single registered token/base pool that applies a configurable, block-level pressure-based fee to exact-input swaps only. Fee rates scale through tiered thresholds relative to a protocol-configured depth parameter; collected fees are taken from the swap input via poolManager.take() and forwarded to an external vault.

hook.name: BackGeoOracle
hook.description: A TWAP oracle hook that combines price observation with a geometric backrun mechanism, automatically reversing a proportional share of swaps that cause significant price impact and crediting the excess tokens back to the original user via ERC6909 minting.

hook.name: BackGeoOracle
hook.description: A TWAP oracle hook that performs partial backruns after price-impacting swaps: when a swap moves the tick beyond a threshold, the hook executes an inverse swap via poolManager.swap() and credits the surplus to the original sender as ERC6909 tokens. Only exactIn swaps are supported; routers must implement IMsgSender() to identify the recipient for backrun proceeds.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that only implements afterInitialize as a no-op stub. Pool and liquidity setup is handled externally via initializePools(), which calls an ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper to bootstrap positions and record the initial tick. No swap logic is present.

hook.name: IpStrategyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that gates pool initialization and liquidity addition to an IpStrategyFactory contract, and collects a 2.5% fee on each swap. Non-ETH fees are converted to ETH via a nested pool swap, then distributed to the strategy's NFT vault, owner, and platform via the factory.

hook.name: Fey Hook (Base)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Fey Protocol that manages paired-token pools with per-direction static LP fees and a 20% protocol fee. It includes MEV protection active for 2 minutes post-launch, optional pool extensions, and LP locker integration for automatic fee collection.

hook.name: Zora Post Hook v1.1.1.1 (Base)
hook.description: A Zora content coin hook that mints multiple Doppler-style liquidity positions on pool initialization and, on every swap, collects LP fees, swaps them to a backing currency, and distributes rewards to coin holders and optional trade referrers encoded in hookData. It supports a governance-gated liquidity migration path to successor hook implementations.

hook.name: Super Strategy v2 (Base)
hook.description: A fee-compounding hook that skims a portion of each swap's input as fees, splitting the take between a per-pool hook balance and a protocol fee receiver, then allows that accumulated hook balance to be deployed as liquidity back into the pool.

hook.name: SuperStrategy
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that collects percentage-based swap fees using BeforeSwapDelta, splitting proceeds between a per-pool hook reserve and a configurable protocol fee receiver. Manages concentrated liquidity positions per pool with cooldown-gated rebalancing logic.

hook.name: JBUniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap V4 hook that routes swaps to whichever venue (V4 pool or Juicebox terminal) offers more output tokens, using a 30-minute TWAP oracle for manipulation-resistant price comparison. Also maintains a TWAP oracle by recording observations after pool initialization, liquidity changes, and swaps.

hook.name: GovernedLBPStrategy
hook.description: A governance-gated Liquidity Bootstrapping Pool (LBP) strategy hook that blocks swaps until a designated governance address approves migration, then migrates token distribution from a bootstrapping phase to a full-range Uniswap v4 pool position.

hook.name: Coinbase Verified Hook (Base)
hook.description: A Coinbase-authored access-control hook for Verified Pools that restricts pool initialization, liquidity operations, swaps, and donations to addresses verified by configurable on-chain policies. Also collects an optional configurable bips-based hook fee on swaps via afterSwapReturnsDelta.

hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: A token launch factory hook that deploys ERC20 tokens and manages them through a bonding curve pool. Once a token's bonding curve supply cap is reached, the hook automatically migrates liquidity to a standard AMM pool, charging a 1% swap fee split equally between creator and platform fee recipients.

hook.name: BlockEcho
hook.description: Gates swaps by requiring the swap amount's last two digits (mod 100) to be within ±2 of the current block number's last two digits. Takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on every swap's unspecified (output) amount, routed to a hardcoded recipient via afterSwap return delta.

hook.name: Zora Creator Hook v1.1.1.1 (Base)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Zora creator coins that collects LP fees on every swap, converts them to a backing currency, and distributes them as rewards. Supports optional trade referrals via hookData and gated liquidity migration to new hook versions.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Saturn Omnichain hook that holds an `afterInitialize` permission but performs no action in the callback. Exposes an `initializePools()` function that calls an external `LiquidityBootstrapper` to set up liquidity and records the initial tick. Has no swap, fee, or liquidity modification logic.

hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFee
hook.description: A Clanker factory hook that launches ERC-20 tokens into Uniswap v4 pools with configurable static LP fees per trade direction (clanker-buy vs. clanker-sell). On every swap it sets the dynamic LP fee via updateDynamicLPFee, collects a protocol fee by modifying the swap delta, auto-claims LP locker rewards, and optionally runs a time-limited (2-minute) MEV protection module.

hook.name: LayerMeme Static Fee Hook v2 (Base)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook used by the LAYERMEME token launch platform. It enforces fixed LP fees per launched token pool, collects a protocol fee on launched token swaps, and supports optional MEV protection modules and per-pool extensions via custom swap data. The source is verified on BaseScan and the hook is deployed on Base mainnet.

hook.name: MoonpotHook
hook.description: A floor-price defense hook for a TMP/USDC pool. It applies a dynamic sell tax that ramps from a maximum rate near the floor tick down to a base rate as price rises above it, and intercepts and burns excess TMP tokens that would push the price below the protocol floor. Buys are charged a flat base defense tax.

hook.name: AngstromL2
hook.description: MEV-aware hook that taxes top-of-block swaps based on priority fees and charges configurable fees on swaps and JIT liquidity additions/removals, distributing LP compensation rewards proportional to liquidity across affected ticks.

hook.name: Angstrom Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements MEV-aware swap and liquidity taxes, distributing fees between the protocol, pool creator, and LPs via return deltas. Includes a governance-controlled withdraw-only mode that blocks new swaps and liquidity additions.

hook.name: StockHook
hook.description: Fee hook for klik.finance token/stock pools on Uniswap v4. Applies market-cap-tiered fees (0.10%–1.00%) with anti-snipe launch protection, collecting fees via ERC-6909 claims deferred to the next swap and split between a platform treasury and token creator.

hook.name: BondingCurveHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook for memecoin launchpad pools. Pre-graduation, it overrides all swap math via beforeSwapReturnsDelta using a constant-product curve; post-graduation, swaps fall through to standard V4 math. Includes a block-number anti-snipe gate and blocks external LP additions until graduation.

hook.name: Super Strategy v3 (Base)
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook that splits each swap's input into a 2% hook reserve and 0.3% protocol fee, accumulating reserves per pool so anyone can trigger auto-compounding back into concentrated LP positions when a configurable threshold is met.

hook.name: SuperStrategy
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that skims 2.3% from each swap (2% retained in hook reserves for auto-compounding, 0.3% forwarded to a protocol fee receiver) via BeforeSwapDelta. Accumulated reserves are periodically compounded back into pool liquidity positions (one NFT position per pool), with an incentive mechanism rewarding callers who trigger the compounding.

hook.name: EstateHook
hook.description: A bonding curve AMM hook that replaces standard pool swaps with buy/sell actions against a logarithmic curve. Buyers mint EstateTokens by paying ETH; sellers burn tokens to receive ETH, with 10% of proceeds withheld as rental rewards distributed through the EstateToken contract.

hook.name: XDHook
hook.description: A launchpad hook that collects swap fees (initially 2%) via ERC-6909 claims, preferring WETH when possible. Pre-graduation, pool initialization, liquidity, and swaps are restricted to allowlisted actors via an authority registry; post-graduation, access control is lifted and the fee is capped at 0.15%.

hook.name: XDHook
hook.description: A launchpad hook that gates pool initialization, liquidity management, and swaps to authorized actors pre-graduation, collecting WETH-denominated fees as ERC-6909 claims. After graduation, access restrictions are lifted and the swap fee is capped at 0.15%.

hook.name: BoardHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that manages token fair launches with time-gated trading windows, optional Merkle-proof whitelist enforcement during the fair launch period, and custom fee distribution to protocol, creator, referrer, and inspired parties. Unsold tokens at the end of the fair launch are burned.

hook.name: VvveityFeeHook
hook.description: Charges an immutable flat fee (in basis points, capped at 10%) on every swap by skimming the specified amount in beforeSwap and forwarding it to an immutable fee recipient. Fee rate and recipient are fixed at deployment with no admin, upgrade path, or pause mechanism.

hook.name: UniClawHookV4
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook supporting dual pool types (agent-only and public) with an on-chain agent registry allowlist for agent-only pools. Collects a configurable percentage fee from swap output via afterSwapReturnsDelta, with optional reputation-based fee tiers that discount fees for higher-reputation agents.

hook.name: TruthMarketHook
hook.description: A prediction market hook that tracks tick movements between before and after swap to trigger limit order settlement via an external OrderManager. Optionally collects an admin-configurable fee on the unspecified swap token using afterSwapReturnsDelta, and supports pluggable swap validation via an optional ISwapValidator.

hook.name: BotcoinWethFeeHook

hook.name: GPO Hook (Base)

hook.name: ContentCoinHook

hook.name: CreatorCoinHook

hook.name: PoolStartegyHooks
hook.description: NFT strategy hook that gates pool initialization and liquidity addition to the factory contract, collects time-decaying swap fees (starting at 99% and decreasing every 5 blocks), converts non-ETH fees via nested swaps, and distributes fees among a vault, optional strategy fee recipient, and protocol address. Blocks exact-output swaps.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that implements only afterInitialize as a no-op. Exposes initializePools() which delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract and stores the returned initial tick in contract storage.

hook.name: CornersHookStaticFee
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Corners protocol that applies asymmetric static LP fees per pool based on swap direction (corners token vs. paired token), takes a 20% protocol fee on each swap by manipulating BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, and optionally runs an MEV protection module during the first 2 minutes after pool creation.

hook.name: StonkHook
hook.description: A hook that gates swaps via an external `isTradingOpen()` oracle, withholds a configurable fee (up to 5%) from the asset leg of every swap using beforeSwap/afterSwap return-deltas, permanently locks liquidity (any negative liquidityDelta reverts), restricts liquidity additions to the factory only, and overrides the native LP fee to zero via OVERRIDE_FEE_FLAG.

hook.name: BTC ACC Hook (Base)

The beforeInitialize hook enforces that pools must pair exactly one allowed base token (ETH/WETH/USDC/cbBTC) with a non-base token.

hook.name: FloorPad Floor Hook

The vault backs a WETH-per-token redemption floor that ratchets up only on buys; holders can burn coins to redeem at the floor at any time.

hook.name: ZoraV4CoinHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for Zora Coins that sets a dynamic launch fee decaying linearly from 99% to 1% over a short window after coin creation. On every swap, it collects accrued LP fees, mints LP rewards, swaps fees to a backing currency via multi-hop paths, distributes rewards to recipients, and fills Zora limit orders based on tick movement.

hook.name: DynamicFee
hook.description: Adjusts the LP fee dynamically based on tick movement from the previous swap — larger moves increase the fee (up to 5%), smaller moves reduce it (floor 0.05%). Inherits AeonFee, which takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on every swap routed to a fixed hardcoded recipient via afterSwap return-delta.

hook.name: ZoraV4CoinHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for Zora Coins that collects LP fees from multiple positions on every swap, converts them to a backing currency via multi-hop swaps, and distributes rewards to creators, referrers, and the protocol. Supports limit order filling and liquidity migration to new hook implementations.

hook.name: tokens.fun HookStaticFee

hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFee

hook.name: TaxHook

hook.name: UniV4Hook

hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2

hook.name: AdvancedFeeHookV6

hook.name: AlphixLVRFee
hook.description: A dynamic fee hook that combines per-pool adjustable LP fees set by a restricted admin with a configurable protocol hook fee captured from swap output as ERC-6909 claims, forwarded to a treasury address.

hook.name: Alphix LVR Fee Hook

hook.name: BoardHook

Includes an optional MEV-protection module active for up to 2 minutes after pool creation.

hook.name: ClankerHookDynamicFeeV2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Clanker token launchpad that dynamically adjusts LP fees based on a volatility accumulator derived from tick movement across swaps. Collects a configurable protocol fee on each swap of the paired (non-Clanker) token via before/afterSwap delta manipulation, and supports an optional MEV-protection module and pool extension.

hook.name: AngstromL2

hook.name: AngstromL2

hook.name: AdvancedFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a configurable tax (up to 10%) on each swap's output token, splitting proceeds between a platform treasury and up to 8 configurable payees.
