On pool initialization, it creates multiple Doppler-curve liquidity positions.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain token that records the initial tick on pool initialization and exposes an initializePools() function to trigger an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. All swap and liquidity hook callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: Limit Order Hook (Base)
hook.description: A limit order hook that records the tick before each swap and triggers limit order execution after the swap completes by delegating to a LimitOrderManager contract. It also supports role-based dynamic LP fee management via AccessControl.

hook.name: ETH-flETH Auto Wrap Hook (Base)
hook.description: A 1:1 ETH/flETH swap hook that fully handles swaps in beforeSwap by depositing/withdrawing from the flETH contract, acting as a custom curve with zero fees. Liquidity additions are blocked, and only the ETH/flETH pair is accepted.

hook.name: Zora Post Hook v1.1.2 (Base)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Zora content coins that automatically collects LP fees after each swap, converts them to a backing currency via multi-hop paths, and distributes rewards to coin creators and trade referrers. On pool initialization, it creates multiple liquidity positions using Doppler multi-curve configurations.

hook.name: BoardHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that manages fair launch pools for newly issued tokens. It enforces a temporal trading gate (tokens cannot be swapped before their scheduled launch time), supports optional Merkle-proof whitelisting during the fair launch window, burns unsold supply at fair launch close, and distributes swap fees to protocol, creator, referrer, and inspired-fee recipients.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that stores pool configuration constants and a reference to a liquidity bootstrapper contract. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; pool initialization is triggered externally via initializePools(), which delegates to the bootstrapper.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Shared hook for token launchpads that gates pool initialization and liquidity changes to a factory, permanently locks single-sided token liquidity, and collects a configurable fee (creator/platform/referrer split with a block-decaying anti-snipe surcharge) on every swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta.

hook.name: SuperTokenWrapperHook
hook.description: Hook for upgrading/downgrading (wrapping/unwrapping) SuperTokens (Wrapper Super Tokens) via Uniswap V4 pools. Inspired by the WETHHook from Uniswap V4 Periphery.

hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: A bonding curve token launchpad hook that manages token launches, collects configurable platform and creator fees on swaps, and automatically migrates fully-bonded tokens from the bonding curve pool to a standard AMM pool upon reaching the target supply.

hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: Clanker protocol hook that applies per-direction static LP fees (separate rates for buying and selling the Clanker token) and collects protocol fees on each swap via delta manipulation in beforeSwap and afterSwap. Supports optional MEV protection modules and pool extensions for factory-deployed pools.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn omnichain protocol with only the afterInitialize permission. It records a poolInitialized flag and the initial tick after pool creation, delegating liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract.

hook.name: Zora Post Hook v1 (Base)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Zora coin pools that sets up multi-position liquidity on pool initialization and, after each swap, collects accrued LP fees, converts them to a backing currency, and distributes rewards to creators, referrers, and the protocol.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only the afterInitialize permission set. All hook callbacks are no-ops returning their selector. Provides an initializePools() function that delegates to a liquidity bootstrapper contract to seed initial liquidity and record the initial tick.

hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: Token launch factory hook implementing a bonding curve for newly deployed ERC20 tokens. Liquidity is distributed across multiple tick ranges; when the bonding curve supply threshold is reached, liquidity is removed and migrated to a new full-range AMM pool. Collects a 1% swap fee on the base-token side, split equally between the token creator and the platform.

hook.name: VieTokenPoolHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Vie platform that gates pool initialization to a factory, enforces a 2-block delay before external liquidity additions, and after every swap sweeps accumulated LP fees from the pool's single managed position into a vault, splitting them between a token fee recipient and a platform fee recipient.

hook.name: FlowHookV3
hook.description: A USDG-denominated tax hook for token/USDG pools. On every swap it takes a configurable fee (plus an anti-snipe time-decaying surcharge) in USDG via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, then routes proceeds across five buckets: holder baskets, LP auto-add above spot, treasury, token buyback-and-burn, and referral payouts, with a tiered platform cut split between a burn pot and a platform wallet.

hook.name: ArrakisPrivateHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Arrakis private vaults that restricts liquidity additions to the authorized vault module and applies per-direction dynamic fee overrides in beforeSwap based on fees configured by the vault executor.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only afterInitialize permission enabled. All hook callbacks are no-ops; pool initialization is delegated to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract that sets the initial tick and liquidity positions.

hook.name: CornersHookStaticFee
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Corners token pools that sets configurable static LP fees per swap direction (corners vs. paired token), collects a 20% protocol fee on the non-corners token side of each swap using BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, and optionally runs an MEV protection module for the first 2 minutes after pool creation.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that implements only afterInitialize as a no-op. Pool setup is coordinated externally via initializePools(), which calls an ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap liquidity and records the initial tick and poolInitialized flag.

hook.name: TotalizerTrap
hook.description: Tracks a per-pool cumulative swap volume and reverts any swap whose amount would bring the running total to a multiple of 11. Inherits a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee (AeonFee) taken on every swap's output currency via afterSwap return delta.

hook.name: DopplerHookInitializer
hook.description: Uniswap v4 pool initializer for the Doppler protocol that distributes liquidity across multiple bonding curve positions and supports optional Doppler Hook callbacks for dynamic LP fee adjustment and pool graduation lifecycle management.

hook.name: Loyalty Volatility Dynamic Fee Hook
hook.description: Dynamic LP fee hook that adjusts the swap fee based on recent tick volatility (using configurable gamma and tick-delta threshold) and grants a discount to swappers holding a configured ERC-20 or ERC-721 loyalty token above a threshold. A fixed 0.01% developer fee is extracted from the unspecified currency on every swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Fee bounds and loyalty parameters are configurable per pool by the pool owner.

hook.name: ClankerHookDynamicFee
hook.description: A Clanker token launch hook that computes dynamic LP fees based on tick-movement volatility accumulation, charges a 20% protocol fee on the non-Clanker token side of each swap via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta adjustments, and includes an optional MEV protection module active for the first 2 minutes after pool creation.

hook.name: tokens.fun HookDynamicFee
hook.description: Token launchpad hook with volatility-based dynamic fees, MEV protection, and automated LP locking. Used by tokens.fun on Base.

hook.name: MoonsendFeeHook_BASE
hook.description: A factory-gated Uniswap v4 hook that enforces pool pre-registration before initialization and sets a one-time dynamic LP fee (from a fixed set of tiers: 1.33%–4.20%) via updateDynamicLPFee() in afterInitialize. Has no swap callbacks, imposing zero gas overhead per swap.

hook.name: BDeFiHook
hook.description: Applies buy/sell taxes and fulfills fee queues on swaps using TWAP oracle pricing. Gates trading until all LPs are initialized and records pool observations via a truncated geometric oracle. Part of the BDeFi protocol on Base.

hook.name: ZNS Launchpad
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that sets directional LP fees (separate rates for buying vs. selling the launched token) via updateDynamicLPFee. Includes an optional MEV protection module active for up to 2 minutes after pool creation that can temporarily raise fees, and blocks liquidity additions during the MEV window.

hook.name: HaberdasheryHook
hook.description: A fee-taking hook that charges a 1% fee on each swap via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, capturing the input-side token as protocol revenue retained by the contract. The owner can withdraw accumulated fees, with non-Habs tokens automatically swapped to a designated Habs token through an internal pool swap.

hook.name: Politiswap
hook.description: Manages a set of ETH/political-token (PolToken) pools, routing all swaps through a per-pool allowlist (only the PolToken contract itself may be the swap sender). Charges a fixed 2% fee on each swap in ETH, tracks net daily ETH inflows per pool, and distributes governance token (POL) rewards to holders of whichever pool attracted the highest daily ETH inflow.

hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: Token launch platform implementing a bonding curve that automatically transitions to a two-sided AMM pool once the bonding curve supply is fully purchased. Charges a 1% fee on swaps (split 50/50 between creator and platform), and only permits swaps where the launched token amount is the specified side.

hook.name: FlashHook
hook.description: FLASH v2 protocol hook for WETH-rooted token ecosystems. Routes buys through an OTC order book and AMM aggregator, charges dynamic sell taxes (including price-impact taxes), and distributes proceeds to stakers, pool creators, and protocol treasury. Requires governance to activate a directional protocol fee before any swaps are permitted.

hook.name: Zora Post Hook v1.0.0.1 (Base)
hook.description: A Zora content coin hook that automatically handles fee collection and reward distribution on every swap, converting LP fees to a backing currency and paying out rewards. On pool initialization, it creates multiple Doppler liquidity positions; supports migration to new hook implementations via a registered upgrade gate.

hook.name: BaldpadFeeHookV3
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Baldpad protocol that charges directional quote-currency fees on swaps, splitting revenue between a per-pool creator and a platform treasury. Supports a configurable opening fee that linearly decays to a base rate over a set time window, implemented via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapReturnDelta.

hook.name: WETH Hook
hook.description: A 1:1 ETH/WETH wrapper hook that allows users to swap between ETH and WETH within Uniswap V4 pools. It intercepts swaps to perform native wrapping and unwrapping, blocks direct liquidity operations, and requires pools to be initialized with zero fee.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A buyback-and-burn hook that maintains a donation pot per pool: on sells of the designated main token, the pot absorbs the trade at the pool's own execution price (shield, via BeforeSwapDelta); on buys, it spends pot funds to buy more main (pump). Optionally runs an LP fee program with auto-compounding and configurable fee splits per pool.

hook.name: IconCurveHook
hook.description: A bonding-curve AMM hook for player ("icon") tokens paired with country tokens. It intercepts every swap to price buys/sells using a virtual-reserves formula, mints/burns PlayerToken on demand, and burns a 5% fee on each trade. Trading is gated behind a phase2Active governance flag set by the owner or pack-opener.

hook.name: BondingCurveHook
hook.description: Routes swaps through a custom bonding curve during the token's bonding phase by intercepting beforeSwap and executing buys/sells via the BondkitToken contract. After migration to DEX phase, collects LP fees from the hook-owned position in afterSwap and distributes them via a DexPhaseSplitter contract.

hook.name: BurnOnSwapHook
hook.description: Burns a configurable percentage (up to 3%) of a designated token on each swap by taking a portion of the swap amount from the pool manager and calling burn() on the token contract. Configuration is per-pool and owner-controlled.

hook.name: Clanker Static Fee Hook v2 (Base)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook used by the Clanker token launch platform that enforces separate fixed LP fees for the clanker token and the paired token, collects a 20% protocol fee on each swap, and supports optional MEV protection modules and pool extensions.

hook.name: BoardHook
hook.description: Token launchpad hook implementing fair launch periods with temporal gating and optional Merkle-proof allowlisting. Fills buy swaps from a pre-seeded position during the fair launch window, captures swap fees, and distributes them to protocol, creators, referrers, and other recipients via afterSwapReturnsDelta.

hook.name: SPAWN (Base)
hook.description: SpawnerHook is a Uniswap V4 hook for the SPAWN token ecosystem that takes a configurable fee on each swap and distributes it among token creators, parent token chains, and the protocol. After each swap, it also triggers automatic creation of a new "spawn" token via the Spawner contract.

hook.name: CurveHook
hook.description: A bonding-curve AMM hook that fully intercepts all swaps between a FIFA token and per-country ERC-20 tokens, executing trades via a virtual constant-product formula with a 5% fee split between burns and treasury. Add/remove liquidity and donations are blocked.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that computes dynamic LP fees via a truncated geometric oracle (base + surge model), collects a configurable protocol fee share per swap, and auto-reinvests accumulated fees into a full-range liquidity position.

hook.name: HookToken
hook.description: Maintains a registry of project tokens and enforces that only pre-registered tokens (paired with native ETH) can be used to initialize Uniswap v4 pools. On afterInitialize, it validates the pool's token is registered and records the pool ID → token mapping.

hook.name: JanpuHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: JANPU Base launchpad hook that applies per-pool static LP fees through Uniswap v4 dynamic-fee updates, collects JANPU protocol fees on launched-token swaps, supports optional MEV fee protection and pool extensions, and accepts empty hook data for standard swaps.

hook.name: C402DynamicFeeHook
hook.description: A hook that restricts pool initialization to whitelisted launchers, enforces one-time liquidity addition per pool, and applies a time-based dynamic LP fee (2.5% for the first 24 hours after pool creation, then 1% thereafter).

hook.name: CommodityCombinedHook
hook.description: A combined swap and liquidity gating hook for commodity pools. Swap access is gated by a block-number unlock window controlled by a designated locker address, with optional price impact caps. Liquidity provision is restricted to an owner-managed allowlist (with an open-mode override).

hook.name: Flaunch POSM v3 (Base)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that manages the full lifecycle of memecoin token launches ("flaunches") — including a fair launch window, an internal swap pool for fee recycling, a BidWall for ETH liquidity concentration, and configurable fee distribution to creators and referrers.

hook.name: HomelanderUniV4Plugin
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that dynamically overrides the LP fee in beforeSwap (zero for a privileged MEV executor, configurable for all others) and runs on-chain arbitrage in afterSwap by delegating to an external MEV router and executor, distributing captured profits via a configurable profit distributor.

hook.name: B20FeeHook
hook.description: A dynamic fee hook for native ETH/TOKEN pools that charges 1–5% fees in ETH on both buys (via beforeSwap delta) and sells (via afterSwap delta). The fee scales with the previous swap's tick movement as a volatility measure. Pool creation is factory-gated via beforeInitialize; exact-output swaps are reverted.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that implements only afterInitialize (as a no-op) and exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external LiquidityBootstrapper to seed pools and record the initial tick. Has no swap, liquidity, or donate logic.

hook.name: AdvancedFeeHookV5
hook.description: A token launchpad hook (BaseStonk) that collects configurable swap fees (up to 10%) in afterSwap, splitting proceeds between a platform treasury, creator payees, a burn address, and single-sided liquidity provisions. Pool initialization is gated to a trusted launcher address.

hook.name: ZoraV4CoinHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for Zora Coins that creates multi-curve liquidity positions on pool initialization. On every swap, collects LP fees from all positions, swaps them to a backing currency, and distributes rewards. Applies a time-decaying dynamic launch fee (99% to 1% over 10 seconds) and fills Zora limit orders when ticks cross.

hook.name: DecayMulticurveInitializerHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook by Whetstone Research (Doppler v2) that implements time-based linear LP fee decay, lowering fees from a configurable start rate to an end rate over a set duration. Liquidity additions are gated to a designated initializer contract.

hook.name: DynamicFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a 14-step dynamic fee schedule (0.03%–1.00%) based on price volatility, with anti-JIT liquidity protection that enforces a 300-block (~10 min) minimum hold period before liquidity can be removed.

hook.name: DopplerHookInitializer
hook.description: Initializes Uniswap v4 pools with multi-curve (bonding curve) liquidity positions, supporting dynamic LP fees and optional DopplerHook callbacks for custom initialization, swap fee collection via afterSwap delta, and pool graduation.

hook.name: DynamicFeeHookV2
hook.description: Implements a dynamic LP fee that linearly decays from a high launch fee to a flat end fee over a configurable duration (anti-sniper mechanism), then holds the end fee permanently. Maintains a TWAP price oracle via per-swap sqrt-price accumulator updates. No pause or access control of any kind can halt swaps.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal hook with only an afterInitialize permission (no-op callback). Exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external liquidity bootstrapper to seed pool liquidity and records the resulting initial tick.

hook.name: AdvancedFeeHookV3
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the BaseStonk token launchpad that collects configurable swap taxes in afterSwap, distributing fees between a platform treasury, creator payees, optional token burns (to a dead address), and single-sided liquidity additions. Pool initialization is restricted to the launcher address.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol with a no-op afterInitialize callback. Exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract to seed liquidity and record the initial tick.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that records pool initialization state. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; actual liquidity bootstrapping is delegated to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract invoked via initializePools().

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only the afterInitialize flag enabled. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; initial liquidity is bootstrapped separately via an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract called through the initializePools() function, which records the initial tick.

hook.name: Counter
hook.description: A minimal hook that counts beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeAddLiquidity, and beforeRemoveLiquidity calls per pool. Does not modify swap behavior or fees.

hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: A token launchpad hook implementing a bonding curve via staged Uniswap v4 liquidity positions. Once the bonding curve supply (240 tokens) is fully sold, liquidity is automatically removed and migrated to a full-range AMM pool. Swaps incur a 1% fee split equally between the token creator and the platform.

hook.name: DeliHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for wBLT-paired pools that replaces standard LP fee collection with custom fee handling: overrides the dynamic LP fee to 0 and takes fees always in wBLT, forwarding them to a FeeProcessor. Syncs DailyEpochGauge and IncentiveGauge on every swap. Pools must include wBLT as one of the two currencies and must use dynamic LP fees.

hook.name: Farstr Hook (Base)
hook.description: Collects swap fees via the afterSwapReturnsDelta mechanism with graduated anti-MEV fee tiers (up to 90%) during a cooldown window following NFT sales, distributing collected ETH to a strategy contract and an optional fee-split address. Pool initialization is restricted to a specific strategy token, and liquidity is permanently locked after the first addition.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. Only the afterInitialize flag is set (no-op implementation). Exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper to bootstrap liquidity and record the initial tick.

hook.name: Graduation Hook (Base)
hook.description: Restricts pool initialization to a designated Moxie bonding curve address, ensuring Uniswap v4 pools can only be initialized through the authorized bonding curve as part of a token graduation process.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol with only afterInitialize active. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; pool setup is handled via a separate initializePools() function that delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap liquidity and record the initial tick.

hook.name: ClankerHookDynamicFeeV2
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for Clanker token pools that computes dynamic LP fees from volatility (tick-distance accumulation relative to a reference price), collects protocol fees via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta hooks, and supports an optional MEV-protection module that can temporarily raise fees during pool launch and a pluggable pool extension for afterSwap actions.

hook.name: Zora Post Hook v2.3.0 (Base)
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for Zora Coins that automatically collects LP fees on every swap, converts them to a backing currency, and distributes rewards — with optional trade referral support via hookData and hook migration managed through a registered upgrade gate.

hook.name: Bonker Static Fee Hook (Base)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches that stores direction-specific LP fees (bonker-side and paired-side) set at initialization, and collects a 20% protocol fee on each swap via beforeSwap and afterSwap delta returns. Includes an optional time-limited MEV-protection module that can temporarily raise fees, and supports configurable pool extensions.

hook.name: Super Strategy
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook that skims a 2.3% fee on each swap (2% hook reserves + 0.3% protocol) via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, accumulating reserves per pool. Pools are registered automatically on initialization. The owner can pause trading and claim LP fees; anyone can trigger liquidity management (minting or adding to positions via Uniswap v4's PositionManager) and receives a 0.1% caller incentive for doing so.

hook.name: Super Strategy
hook.description: An automated liquidity management hook that intercepts a portion of each swap (2% hook fees + 0.3% protocol fees) via beforeSwapReturnsDelta and periodically compounds accumulated fees back into the pool's full-range LP position.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that holds the afterInitialize flag but performs no logic in any callback. Liquidity bootstrapping is delegated to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract via a separate initializePools() call.

hook.name: Simple Sell Tax Hook
hook.description: Applies a configurable basis-point sell tax when tokens are swapped against ETH or wrapped native assets. The fee is taken from the pool in beforeSwap and sent to a recipient address configured per-token by the token owner.

hook.name: CurveHook
hook.description: A bonding-curve AMM hook that manages swaps between a FIFA token and CountryToken ERC-20s using a virtual constant-product formula. Fully intercepts swap execution via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, minting or burning CountryToken supply on each trade while burning a 5% FIFA fee. Standard liquidity add/remove and donate operations are all blocked.

hook.name: GlassHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Glass token launchpad pools that applies direction-dependent static LP fees (different rates for buying vs. selling the glass token), collects a ~20% protocol fee via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, and includes an optional MEV-protection module that can temporarily raise fees for up to 2 minutes after pool creation.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that uses only the afterInitialize permission (as a no-op) and exposes an initializePools() function that delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract, recording the initial tick.

hook.name: Angstrom L2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that extracts a MEV tax from top-of-block (ToB) swaps paid in ETH and distributes it to LPs as rewards, while also applying a JIT liquidity tax on adds and removes to disincentivize just-in-time liquidity provision.

hook.name: AngstromL2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for ETH-paired pools that applies MEV-based swap taxes (scaled to gas priority fee) and protocol/creator swap fees, distributes rewards to in-range LPs via tick-based accounting, charges a JIT liquidity MEV tax on adds/removes, and supports a withdraw-only emergency mode controlled by an external factory owner.

hook.name: GovernedLBPStrategy
hook.description: A Liquidity Bootstrapping Pool (LBP) hook that restricts pool initialization to the contract itself and gates swaps behind a governance-controlled approval, ensuring the migration from an initial token distribution phase to a full-range Uniswap v4 position is authorized before trading begins.

hook.name: Arcmind
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that creates ETH-only paired pools, adds initial liquidity, and collects a configurable BPS fee on ETH-side swaps using beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns. Fees are split between the token creator and the platform owner; deployed as a transparent upgradeable proxy.

hook.name: ForgeHook
hook.description: Shared hook for all Forge V4 pools that enforces factory-only pool initialization and applies a time-decaying MEV fee: starts at 80% and decays parabolically to a 1.5% base fee over a 30-second window after pool creation.

hook.name: MineSwapHookV2
hook.description: A universal fee-capture hook that deducts 0.15% of output tokens on every exact-input swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta, accumulating tokens in the contract. Anyone can trigger fee processing, which swaps accumulated tokens to BG via Uniswap V3, then splits the result: 50% burned to 0xdead, 49% sent to a rebate tracker for volume-based rewards, and 1% paid to the caller as a mining reward.

hook.name: CrownClash
hook.description: Takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee (AeonFee) plus an optional 7 bps tribute on every swap's unspecified currency when hookData encodes a player address, routing both directly to a fixed treasury. Tracks cumulative per-pool swap volume per player and maintains an on-chain leaderboard of the highest-volume trader (the 'champion').

hook.name: HaberdasheryHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook that charges a configurable percentage fee (default 1%, max 10%) on each swap by taking the fee amount via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, accumulating fees per pool by currency. The owner can withdraw accumulated fees, automatically converting non-Habs token balances to the Habs token via an internal pool swap.

hook.name: CornersHookStaticFee
hook.description: A Corners protocol hook that manages Uniswap v4 pools with two configurable static LP fees (one for buying the "corners" token, one for selling it), collects a 20% protocol cut of each swap fee, and runs an optional MEV-protection module during the first 2 minutes after pool creation.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook that implements only afterInitialize, storing the initial pool tick via an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper. All swap, liquidity, and donate callbacks are no-ops that return their selectors without modifying behavior.

hook.name: Aquinas Hook (Base)
hook.description: Restricts Uniswap v4 pool initialization to factory-authorized Safe addresses for Aquinas DAOs, preventing frontrunning of LP initialization by requiring the caller to be pre-approved by the Aquinas factory.

hook.name: ContentCoinHook
hook.description: A Zora v4 coin hook that, on every swap, collects accrued LP fees from all managed positions, converts them to a backing currency via multi-hop Uniswap v4 swaps, and distributes the proceeds as rewards to creators, trade referrers, and the protocol. On pool initialization it mints multiple Doppler-curve liquidity positions.

hook.name: UniswapV4SwapFeeHookV1
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges configurable buy and sell fees (in basis points) on swaps involving a designated fee token. Fees are collected in the fee token via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta return values and forwarded to a configurable recipient contract, with separate rates for buy and sell operations.

hook.name: PlayerCurveHook
hook.description: Bonding curve hook for player token / country token pairs. Intercepts all swaps via beforeSwapReturnsDelta, applying a custom pricing formula with a 5% fee (fully burned). Swaps are gated on per-country phase 2 activation (all packs sold) and an owner-controlled pause.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Initialization hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick from an external liquidity bootstrapper contract after pool setup. Has no swap, liquidity, or donation logic.

hook.name: AutoFeeCollectionHook
hook.description: Collects a fixed 1% fee on every swap via afterSwap delta return, taking the fee from the pool manager and transferring it to a per-pool creator address configured on the first liquidity addition.

hook.name: ArtacleIndexHook
hook.description: Non-upgradeable hook that enforces a time-decaying anti-snipe fee mechanism on trades. Charges dynamic fees starting at 95% decaying to 10% on buys, 50% then 10% on sells. Fees distributed: 80% to token contract for NFT acquisitions, 10% to admin, 10% to artblocks.io fund.

hook.name: Generic4626Router
hook.description: A hook-based router for symmetric ERC4626 vault pairs that intercepts swaps to perform vault deposits (underlying → shares) or redeems (shares → underlying) in place of standard AMM swaps. Pool initialization is gated through the hook; direct liquidity addition is blocked entirely.

hook.name: Clanker Dynamic Fee Hook v2 (Base)
hook.description: A Clanker v2 hook that dynamically adjusts LP fees based on a volatility accumulator derived from simulated tick movement. It also collects a protocol fee on Clanker token swaps and supports optional MEV protection modules and per-pool extensions via custom swap data.

hook.name: Zora Creator Hook v1.1.2 (Base)

hook.description: Accumulates swap fees from a Uniswap v4 pool and distributes collected ETH to vMooney token holders who perform weekly check-ins, proportional to their vMooney balance. After each swap, non-native tokens collected as fees are burned to the dead address.

hook.name: Ring FewV2 Direct Routing Hook
hook.description: Ownerless Uniswap v4 hook that exposes Ring FewV2 direct-pair liquidity through v4 swaps. The hook wraps the input token into its canonical FewToken, swaps through the corresponding FewV2 pair, unwraps the output token, and settles back through PoolManager. It does not require or decode custom hookData, does not allow liquidity in the v4 pool, and has no hook owner, pause, upgrade path, or route-control admin.

hook.name: KlikHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Klik.finance that implements market-cap-tiered swap fees for token launch pools. Fees are collected as ERC-6909 claims during beforeSwap/afterSwap and distributed to a platform treasury and token creator. Includes anti-sniping protection that locks trades on the deployment block and caps buy amounts in USD during the first few blocks.

hook.name: DiamondHandsHook
hook.description: Anti-dump hook for a single DMND/WETH pool that charges 0% on buys and a dynamic 0.5–10% fee on sells, scaling with 1h rolling sell pressure via integral pricing. Captured fees are split 50/30/20 between a MerkleDistributor jackpot for DMND holders, WETH→DMND buyback-and-burn, and direct LP donations via poolManager.donate().

hook.name: ArrakisPrivateHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Arrakis private vault system that applies directional dynamic LP fee overrides per pool (separate rates for zeroForOne and oneForZero swaps), and restricts liquidity additions to the authorized module for each pool.

hook.name: MoonCatsStrategyHookV2
hook.description: Fee-collecting hook that takes configurable buy/sell fees (up to 10%, or 50% for the first hour post-launch) after each swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta, converts token fees to ETH through a nested pool swap, and distributes proceeds 80% to a strategy contract and 20% to a marketing wallet. Pool initialization and liquidity addition are restricted to the strategy contract.

hook.name: HeavierHand
hook.description: Gates swaps to only allow selling the token the pool currently holds more of, based on virtual reserves derived from slot0 price and active liquidity. Past a 10% skew cap the gate inverts so only the rebalancing direction is admitted. Charges a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on every swap via afterSwap return-delta, routed to a fixed recipient address.

hook.name: OraclePricingHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that prices swaps entirely from Chainlink oracle feeds, bypassing the AMM curve. Operates as an on-chain RFQ venue for tokenized equities, with configurable markets, bid-ask spreads, market hours, and inventory held as ERC-6909 claims inside the PoolManager.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A pass-through Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. Only afterInitialize is enabled, but the callback performs no logic. A separate initializePools() function bootstraps liquidity via an external contract and records the initial tick.

hook.name: STRMOGHook
hook.description: Accrues a 10% fee on all swaps in a designated ETH/STRMOG pool, routing collected fees to an immutable treasury address. Fees are captured inline via swap delta returns in beforeSwap and afterSwap, and can be swept to treasury by any caller, with an optional 0.3% bounty to the sweep initiator.

hook.name: QuasarHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that burns 1% of its own QUASAR/PRISM token on every swap (taken via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas) and distributes 4% LP fees to rank-weighted NFT holders. Each whole QUASAR token unit held automatically mints a corresponding facet NFT, with earlier-minted facets assigned higher rank-based weights for proportionally greater fee shares.

hook.name: Uni20Hook
hook.description: A beforeSwap-only Uniswap v4 hook that automatically triggers LP fee harvesting via an immutable IUni20FeeLocker contract before each registered pool swap. Harvesting failures are caught with try/catch so they cannot block user trades. No hookData is required and no swap deltas are modified.

hook.name: CumHook
hook.description: Dynamic LP fee hook that adjusts fees based on cumulative price impact (CPI) across swaps. Fees scale with directional market imbalance and time-decay between swaps; each pool must be explicitly configured with fee bounds, decay parameters, and illiquidity scale before trading is permitted.

hook.name: OneTimeLaunchHookTemplate
hook.description: A launch hook that restricts pool initialization and liquidity addition to a single occurrence per token. In afterSwap, when enabled via the permissionless zero() function, reverts non-zeroForOne (buy) swaps if tx.origin is not in a deployer-managed allowlist, creating asymmetric swap access control.

hook.name: StratHook
hook.description: A fee-taking hook for the $STRAT/wETH pool that levies a 2% fee on all swaps, routing wETH fees to a reserve and burning STRAT fees to maintain a monotone-increasing price floor (N = reserve/supply). Includes a permissionless `defend()` function that uses reserve wETH to market-buy and burn STRAT when TWAP price falls below the floor, and blocks LP additions below the floor price.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook that holds afterInitialize permission but implements all callbacks as no-ops. Coordinates multi-chain pool setup via a separate LiquidityBootstrapper contract, recording the initial tick on-chain when initializePools() is called.

hook.name: FWATokenHook
hook.description: ETH/FWAToken pool hook that charges a flat 1% fee on all swaps, routing proceeds to an owner-set fee wallet (buys: fee taken in FWAToken and swapped to ETH; sells: fee taken in ETH). Pool initialization is gated on the token's `launching()` flag; buy-side swaps revert for unauthorized callers until the owner enables external trading via `externalBuysEnabled`.

hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: A Clanker platform hook that enforces per-pool static LP fees with separate buy/sell rates for the Clanker token, collects a protocol fee on each swap via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, and supports an optional MEV-protection module that temporarily raises fees on newly created pools.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; the hook exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap initial liquidity positions across pools.

hook.name: GweiFeeHook
hook.description: The single Uniswap v4 hook used by all gwei.fun launchpad pools. In `beforeSwap`, it deducts a configurable fee (platform fee plus optional per-pool creator tax with separate buy/sell rates and a linearly-decaying anti-snipe tax) from the specified currency via BeforeSwapDelta, routing proceeds to the creator's fee recipient and a GWEI buyback vault as ERC-6909 claims.

hook.name: ForgeHookV4
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for controlled token launches that enforces launchManager authorization for pool initialization and liquidity provision. Collects configurable buy/sell fees via swap deltas and distributes fee shares across platform, creator, rewards, and utility recipients. Remove liquidity and donations are permanently disabled.

hook.name: JBUniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that routes swaps between the V4 pool and Juicebox project terminals, selecting whichever venue gives the user more output tokens. Uses a 30-minute TWAP oracle to compare routes for buy-side (pay into project for tokens) and sell-side (cash out project tokens) swaps. Also serves as a TWAP oracle for external contracts via an IGeomeanOracle-compatible interface.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only the afterInitialize flag set. All hook callbacks are pure no-ops returning the selector. An external initializePools() function delegates to an ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap liquidity and records the resulting initial tick on-chain.

hook.name: ArkHook
hook.description: Charges configurable buy and sell fees on each swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta, taking the fee from the pool manager and routing it to an external fee router. Optionally triggers on-chain maintenance calls (buyback or harbor reinforcement) after each swap.

hook.name: BossHook
hook.description: A gamified Uniswap v4 hook that turns swaps into a boss-fight: buys deal USD-denominated damage and roll for collectible item drops, sells heal the boss. Active curses apply additional fees (taken via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta) on sellers or buyers; LP fee is fixed at 1% via a beforeSwap fee override.

hook.name: BtcPegHook
hook.description:
Mints $bPEG fragments to swap recipients on the ETH/bPEG v4 pool. Calls token.start when first liquidity is added (afterAddLiquidity). Resolves the real EOA recipient on each swap (afterSwap) via hookData (20-byte address override) or tx.origin fallback for routers, then calls BtcPeg.mintFragmentsFor to give the buyer one on-chain fragment per whole bPEG bought. Read-only on the swap path otherwise (no fee, no delta).

hook.name: GeodeMiningHook
hook.description: A token launch hook that tracks WETH buy volume per round to allocate mining rewards to buyers, accrues a 3% fee on all WETH swaps (split between burns and protocol), and automatically executes token buybacks triggered by sell pressure.

hook.name: LiquidGuard
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that skims a configurable fee (in RARE tokens) from every swap in RARE-paired pools, routing the fee to a distributor contract. When RARE is the specified currency, fees are deducted in beforeSwap; when unspecified, in afterSwap. Pool initialization is restricted to owner-approved initializer addresses.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements only the afterInitialize permission, recording an initial tick from a separate liquidity bootstrapper contract. All hook callbacks are no-ops; swap behavior is identical to a standard pool.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that only implements afterInitialize to support pool setup. It stores the initial tick and a poolInitialized flag when called via initializePools(), which delegates to an external liquidity bootstrapper. No swap-side logic is present.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. Only `afterInitialize` is enabled (as a no-op). Exposes an `initializePools()` function that calls an external liquidity bootstrapper contract to record the initial tick and mark the pool as initialized.

hook.name: PAMHook
hook.description: ETH-side fee collector for the Perpetual Asteroid Machine token; converts fees to ASTEROID and distributes to PAM holders

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal hook for the Saturn omnichain token project. Only the afterInitialize flag is set; the callback is a pure no-op returning the selector. Includes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to seed initial pool liquidity and records the resulting initial tick.

hook.name: FullRangeLBPStrategy
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a Liquidity Bootstrapping Pool strategy that restricts pool initialization to the contract itself via beforeInitialize, then migrates raised funds and reserved tokens into a full-range liquidity position after the auction concludes.

hook.name: AggHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that automatically routes swaps across multiple registered liquidity uniswapV3like pools from Uniswap, Pancakeswap, Sushiswap, Aerodrome, etc. By discovering and executing the most efficient path at transaction time, it allows traders to access deeper aggregated liquidity, improve price execution, and reduce the effects of liquidity fragmentation.

hook.name: EthCreatorFeeHookV3
hook.description: Charges immutable, configurable buy and sell fees on native ETH/token pools, split between a registered creator reward vault (authenticated via a factory) and an immutable launcher fee recipient. Fees are deducted directly from swaps via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta return values; ERC-20 transfers are not taxed.

hook.name: STRPNKHook
hook.description: Charges a 10% fee on every swap by intercepting beforeSwap and afterSwap, accumulating ETH and token fees as ERC-6909 claims held by the PoolManager. Fees can be swept by anyone and distributed to a treasury and dev wallet (80/20 split for ETH, all to treasury for tokens), with a 0.25% bounty paid to the caller who triggers the sweep.

hook.name: SimHookMVP
hook.description: A dynamic-fee hook that sets LP fees based on simulated price impact and a time-decaying cumulative price imbalance score. Includes an owner-configurable JIT liquidity lock that prevents LPs from removing liquidity within a configurable block window after adding it.

hook.name: OneTimeLaunchHookTemplate
hook.description: Enforces one-time pool initialization and initial liquidity per token (currency1). When the buy gate is activated via the unprotected `bigInt()` function (callable by anyone), non-zeroForOne (buy) swaps revert unless `tx.origin` is in a deployer-managed allowlist.

hook.name: FreeholdHook
hook.description: Intercepts all swaps in creator-registered sDAI/SyntheticFiatToken pools and routes them through the token's mint() and redeem() functions via BeforeSwapReturnsDelta, providing oracle-priced, zero-slippage virtual liquidity with no real liquidity held in the pool.

hook.name: CustomHook
hook.description: Hook for applying a dynamic (changeable) fee for any pool the hook works with. On each swap, it calls poolManager.updateDynamicLPFee() with an admin-configurable fee rate, and is deployed behind a TransparentUpgradeableProxy.

hook.name: Tetris Custom Dynamic Fee Hook
hook.description: An upgradeable proxy hook that calls poolManager.updateDynamicLPFee() on every swap to enforce a configurable LP fee percentage. The fee and admin address are set at initialization and can be updated by the admin.

hook.name: FWATokenHook
hook.description: ETH/FWAToken pool hook that charges a flat 1% fee on all swaps, routing collected fees to an owner-set address (buys: fee in FWAToken swapped to ETH via internal pool swap; sells: fee in ETH). Pool initialization and liquidity addition are gated on the token's transient launching() flag; buy access is governance-controlled via an owner-toggled externalBuysEnabled flag.

hook.name: PriceImpactDynamicFeeHook
hook.description: A 2-state dynamic fee hook pinned to a single pool. In the DOWN state, non-owner swaps pay a base LP fee (default 2%); if a swap moves the sqrtPrice beyond a configurable threshold, the crank flips ON and subsequent non-owner swaps pay a fee cap (default 10%). Fee is applied as a beforeSwap LP fee override; the owner (tx.origin) pays 0% and can reset the crank via hookData.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. Only `afterInitialize` is enabled (as a no-op returning the selector). Liquidity bootstrapping is delegated to an external `ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper` contract via the `initializePools()` function. All swap and liquidity callbacks are pure no-ops.

hook.name: Meme Strategy Hook (Ethereum)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the MEMS meme token that collects dynamic asymmetric swap fees (Phase 1: 50%, Phase 2: 10–90%) on ETH↔MEMS swaps, splitting proceeds 80/20 between a strategy contract and treasury. Includes anti-snipe protection that blocks public swaps until trading is activated by the strategy.

hook.name: SummerHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Summer protocol that gates pool initialization to the Launchpad, enforces full-range LP positions, and charges a 0.25% protocol fee on each swap's unspecified-currency side via afterSwapReturnsDelta. Also runs a 4-week SUMMER token farming program with vesting for LP stakers and a Founders Pool for Genesis Badge holders.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only the afterInitialize permission enabled (implemented as a no-op stub returning the selector). Pool initialization is bootstrapped via an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract through a separate initializePools() call; the hook does not modify swap or liquidity behavior.

hook.name: OneTimeLaunchHookTemplate
hook.description: A launch hook that restricts pool initialization and initial liquidity addition to once per token. In afterSwap, it tracks buy-direction swap recipients and can revert sell-direction swaps for addresses not on a deployer-managed allowlist. Makes non-standard calls (msgSender, msgTarget, msgData) on the token contract that will revert on standard ERC-20 tokens.

hook.name: LendingHookV3
hook.description: A lending AMM hook that manages a full-range ETH/ERC20 V4 LP position as a shared vault. LPs deposit and earn swap fees; borrowers draw ETH against TOKEN collateral at 40% LTV; a 0.5% protocol fee is skimmed from each swap via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta hooks, and swaps are blocked in any block where a liquidation occurred.

hook.name: Ring FewV2 Aggregator Hook
hook.description: Ownerless router-compatible Uniswap v4 hook that exposes Ring FewV2 AMM liquidity through v4 swaps. The hook uses empty hookData, registers aggregator pools, exposes quote and pseudoTotalValueLocked for routing discovery, and has no hook owner, pause, upgrade path, or route-control admin.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records pool initialization state via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. Only afterInitialize is active; no swap or liquidity callbacks modify swap behavior.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook that only holds the afterInitialize permission, recording the initial pool tick after initialization. An external initializePools() function invokes a separate liquidity bootstrapper contract to bootstrap token liquidity positions.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick on pool initialization via a liquidity bootstrapper contract. Only the afterInitialize flag is active (as a no-op selector return); there are no active swap, liquidity, or donate hooks.

hook.name: NoncePoolHookV1
hook.description: A launchpad hook for nonce.fun pools that restricts pool initialization and liquidity provision to a designated launchpad contract. It enforces a fixed opening price, tick range, and fee, allows only one initial liquidity mint per token, locks principal removal, and permanently disables donations.

hook.name: ForgeHook
hook.description: A swap tax hook for a FORGE token pool that skims a flat 1% sell tax and a 90% cliff launch buy tax (active for 5 minutes post-launch) to a treasury address on every swap. Also overrides the LP fee to a flat 0.30% on all swaps. Pool is locked until a configured launch timestamp.

hook.name: ETIM Tax Hook
hook.description: Applies a configurable buy/sell tax (up to 10%) on ETIM swaps via BeforeSwapDelta; buy tax is collected in ETH (currency0), sell tax is split among a burn address, S6 rewards, a foundation wallet, and an official wallet. Buys are blocked until a governance flag (isGrowthPoolDepleted on the main contract) is set; exempt addresses bypass taxation. afterSwap currently returns a zero delta.

hook.name: ETIMTaxHook
hook.description: A tax hook for the ETIM token that deducts configurable buy and sell taxes from each swap via BeforeSwapDelta, distributing sell-side taxes to foundation, S6, official, and burn allocations. Buys are gated behind a growth-pool depletion check and only exact-input swaps are supported.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that enables only afterInitialize (which performs no action beyond returning the selector). Provides an initializePools() function that delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap initial pool liquidity and record the resulting initial tick.

hook.name: LendingHookV4
hook.description: A lending AMM hook that manages a single full-range ETH/TOKEN LP position as an ERC4626-style vault, allowing LPs to deposit and borrowers to take ETH loans against TOKEN collateral at 40% LTV. Skims a 0.5% protocol swap fee via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns and blocks swaps in the same block as a liquidation.

hook.name: SharesHook
hook.description: Collects protocol fees (2.5% each) on buy and sell swaps for a designated native/token pool, updates an on-chain random seed on each swap, and notifies an external launch controller of swap activity. Triggers a token start on first liquidity addition once config is finalized.

hook.name: UniswapV4KEMHook
hook.description: Validates signed quotes from a designated signer before each exact-input swap, enforcing nonce-based replay protection, a max amount-in, and an expiry time. In afterSwap, any output exceeding the quoted max exchange rate is captured as ERC-6909 tokens for a configured recipient.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. Only `afterInitialize` is active (as a no-op selector return); no swap, liquidity, or donate hooks are enabled.

hook.name: StableStableHook
hook.description: Dynamic fee hook for stable/stable pools that adjusts LP fees based on price deviation from a configurable reference price. Fees decay exponentially when the pool price is outside the optimal range, incentivizing arbitrage back to peg while charging reduced fees for stabilizing swaps.

hook.name: BallisticFeeHookV1
hook.description: Charges immutable directional buy/sell fees on registered native ETH/token pools, splitting collected fees 90/10 between a per-pool creator reward vault and an immutable treasury. Supports optional launch-period fee schedules with linear time-decay from a higher opening rate to a settled base rate.

hook.name: PokemonPegHook
hook.description: Pokémon Peg ($pPEG) v4 hook. Mints NFT fragment metadata (one Pokémon per fragment) on every buy, proportional to pPEG received. Resolves the recipient address from hookData (20- or 32-byte) or falls back to tx.origin for contract callers. Calls start() on the token on first liquidity addition and randomises the RNG seed on each afterSwap.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that enables afterInitialize but performs no logic in any hook callback. Pool initialization tick is recorded externally via a separate liquidity bootstrapper contract called through initializePools().

hook.name: UniLandHook
hook.description:
UniLand is a 10,000-plot lottery meme coin powered by a Uniswap v4 hook. Each whole $ULand token (1e18) maps 1:1 to a numbered plot in [1..10000] via a lazy Fisher-Yates shuffle inside the ERC20. On every sell, the hook's afterSwap takes 3% of the output ETH, draws a random plot id, and forwards the ETH directly to that plot's owner. Free plots fall back to the treasury. Buys are tax-free. Hook permissions: afterSwap | afterSwapReturnDelta (bottom-14 = 0x44).

hook.name: LauncherHook

The actual pool bootstrapping is performed by a separate LiquidityBootstrapper contract invoked via the initializePools() function, which records the initial tick and sets a poolInitialized flag.

hook.name: JrnyHook
hook.description: A protocol-fee hook for ETH-paired Uniswap v4 pools that intercepts swaps to collect a configurable fee on each trade, including a time-decaying "shock fee" window that ramps down from a maximum to a base rate. Collected ETH fees accumulate and are automatically distributed to owner-configured receiver addresses when a minimum threshold is reached.

hook.name: AtomicLimitOrderHook
hook.description: AtomicLimitOrderHook atomically combines a swap and a limit-order placement in a single transaction, extending OpenZeppelin's LimitOrderHook. It prevents front-running between the two steps and adds guards that keep order accounting consistent under aggregator-style multi-hop swaps. Uses the AFTER_INITIALIZE and AFTER_SWAP flags; ordinary swaps through the pool require no custom hook data.

hook.name: Ring Few USDC Hook
hook.description: A hook that facilitates seamless 1:1 wrapping and unwrapping of an ERC20 token and its Ring Few-wrapped counterpart (fewToken) within a Uniswap v4 pool, intercepting swaps in beforeSwap to perform the wrap or unwrap operation and returning a delta to settle the exchange.

hook.name: Ring Few UNI Hook
hook.description: A hook that enables atomic wrapping and unwrapping of Few Protocol wrapper tokens within Uniswap v4 swaps, enforcing a 1:1 exchange rate between an ERC20 token and its fewToken equivalent.

hook.name: StrategyPunkHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a time-decaying fee on swaps (starting at 95% for buys, declining 100 bips per 5 blocks to a 10% floor), collecting fees in ETH via nested pool swaps when needed, routing 80% to a companion StrategyPunk contract and 20% to a fee address. Liquidity operations are gated to the companion StrategyPunk contract.

hook.name: TailTwins
hook.description: Gates swaps by requiring the swap amount's absolute low byte to be within 16 of the current pool's sqrtPriceX96 low byte; reverts otherwise. Also charges a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on every swap's unspecified (output) currency via afterSwap return delta, routed to a fixed recipient.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that implements a constant-product bonding curve priced in IMD tokens. Swaps on launched token pools (ETH/coin) are fully consumed in beforeSwap: the ETH leg routes through a canonical ETH/IMD pool, and the IMD proceeds price the coin against a per-coin virtual reserve curve. Creator fees (ETH) and burn fees (IMD) are applied on each trade.

hook.name: Cork AMM (Ethereum)
hook.description: Cork AMM is a custom Uniswap v4 hook for the Cork Protocol that implements a specialized AMM for depeg-swap token pairs (RA and CT). It replaces the standard Uniswap price curve with its own pricing logic, gates all native liquidity modifications through the hook's own interface, and supports optional flash swaps via a CorkSwapCallback pattern.

hook.name: BloomHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing queue-based sell access control for its native BLOOM token. Buyers are automatically enqueued and only the queue head (or Bloom Pass NFT holders) may sell; idle heads suffer linear token decay. LP fees are distributed to Bloom Pass holders proportionally by weight.

hook.name: LimitOrderHook
hook.description:
A deployment of OpenZeppelin's LimitOrderHook — a Uniswap v4 hook implementing single-tick limit orders. Users place orders by providing concentrated liquidity at a specific tick; when the pool price crosses that tick, the position is automatically filled and can be withdrawn at any time.

Original implementation by OpenZeppelin (github.com/OpenZeppelin/uniswap-hooks). Deployed to Ethereum mainnet to make this functionality publicly accessible.

hook.name: DualPoolHook
hook.description: JIT liquidity hook that deploys multi-range concentrated positions before each swap and removes them after, with ERC4626 vault rehypothecation for idle capital yield. Pool fees are static (set at initialization), and swaps can be paused by the owner via a liveness flag.

hook.name: Auto Liquidity Generator Hook
hook.description: LiquidityGenHook collects configurable buy and sell WETH taxes on swaps via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, accumulates them, and automatically re-invests into the pool as full-range liquidity once a threshold is reached. A platform fee is taken before the liquidity add.

hook.name: Auto Liquidity Generator
hook.description: Collects configurable buy and sell taxes (in WETH) on every swap. Once accumulated fees reach a configurable threshold, deducts a platform fee (20–50% of the accumulated amount) sent to a designated collector, then uses the remainder to buy the paired token and add full-range protocol-owned liquidity. Residual tokens after liquidity addition are burned.

hook.name: WETH Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that enables seamless ETH/WETH wrapping and unwrapping within v4 pools at a 1:1 ratio. It intercepts swaps to deposit or withdraw ETH from the WETH contract in-flight, supporting both exact input and exact output swaps, while blocking liquidity operations since the pool serves purely as a conversion mechanism.

hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: MixpadHook collects a configurable platform fee on every swap for factory-registered tokens, splitting revenue between the token creator and treasury. It applies anti-snipe surcharges in blocks immediately after launch, a time-decaying deployer dump surcharge, optional buyback-and-burn of the creator's fee share, and optional dividend routing to a yield vault.

hook.name: NestHook
hook.description: A liquidity mining hook that distributes EGG token rewards to LPs proportional to their contributed liquidity in a single canonical pool. Reward accrual is triggered on each swap and liquidity modification, with per-position tracking and support for excluding burned (dead-address) liquidity from reward distributions.

hook.name: BracketHook
hook.description: BracketHook is the central contract for the TheCup protocol, managing 48 country-token pools across two AMM regimes: a bonding curve phase (hook handles all swap math via custom virtual-reserve AMM and a 1% protocol fee) and a graduated phase (standard v4 AMM with 1% protocol fee plus an optional 9% elimination tax on sells of knocked-out country tokens). A per-block price-impact cap (5%) is enforced as a sandwich protection mechanism.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that records the initial pool tick after initialization via a separate liquidity bootstrapper contract. Only afterInitialize is enabled; all swap hooks are no-op stubs, making swap behavior entirely vanilla.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that holds the afterInitialize permission but performs no action in its callback. hook.name: Flaunch PositionManager

Open-source biotech and longevity research
Humanitarian relief e...

hook.name: ERC20StrategyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for ERC20Strategy pools that takes time-based buy fees (starting at 99%, decreasing 1% per minute to a floor of 10%) and distributes collected fees among the strategy contract (80%), PunkStrategy token (10%), and a configurable protocol fee address (10%). Pool creation and liquidity addition are restricted to the ERC20StrategyFactory.

hook.name: Unisocks Launch Guard Hook
hook.description: Validates that swaps occur in the designated ETH/token pool. On buy swaps, records transient credit for the external market contract to consume via `consumeBuyCredit()`. On sell swaps, calls `collectFromHook()` on the locker contract to trigger fee collection. Swaps require no custom hookData from public routers.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial pool tick via an external `initializePools()` call to a liquidity bootstrapper contract. The `afterInitialize` callback is a no-op; no swap logic is executed.

hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: A hook that charges a tiered ETH-denominated swap fee (0.5%–1.25% based on token market cap) on ETH/token pools. In beforeSwap and afterSwap it skims the fee from the ETH leg of each swap via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, accruing 75% to a hardcoded protocol wallet and 25% to a per-token registered creator, redeemable via a pull-based claim().

hook.name: 999WHL Hook
hook.description: Takes 10% buy and sell fee, used to buy digits ENS NFTs. Same flywheel as NFTStrategy.

hook.name: ENSWheelHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for ENSWheel token launches that gates pool initialization and liquidity adds to factory-authorized contexts, enforces a governance-controlled tradingEnabled flag on swaps, and extracts a time-decaying buy fee (95%→10% over blocks) via afterSwapReturnsDelta, distributing 80% to the ENSWheel collection and 20% to a team address.

hook.name: OrbitHook
hook.description: A hub-and-spoke liquidity hook for the ORBIT token. Satellite pools (ORBIT/quote) use fully custom accounting: buys fill from a hook-held ORBIT reserve, sells draw from banked quote inventory, both priced via Core TWAP × external oracle with a spread earmarked for token burns. The Core pool (ORBIT/WETH) is passthrough-guarded by a TWAP deviation band and per-block notional cap.

hook.name: ArrakisPrivateHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Arrakis private vaults that overrides LP fees directionally (separate fees for zeroForOne and oneForZero swaps) via the beforeSwap callback, and restricts liquidity additions to only the vault's authorized module.

hook.name: UniagentHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that levies a 1% fee (100 bps) on the WETH side of each swap, taking WETH from the pool manager, unwrapping it to ETH, and distributing it across a reward vault (50%), an AI funding wallet (30%), and a dev wallet (20%) on a weekly epoch schedule.

hook.name: ArtCoinsHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for ArtCoins pools that enforces per-direction static LP fees (configurable buy vs. sell rates), collects protocol fees via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, supports a time-limited anti-sniper MEV module, and dispatches post-swap callbacks to pluggable pool extensions.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that uses only the afterInitialize permission. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op stub; all swap-related callbacks are stubs not active in the address bitmask. Pool setup is delegated to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper via a separate initializePools() function that records the initial tick.

hook.name: BDeFiHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the BuilDeFi protocol that applies configurable buy/sell taxes on swaps, fulfills token fee queues inline using TWAP pricing, and maintains a truncated geometric mean oracle. Swaps are blocked until all LP positions for the token are initialized.

hook.name: V4GasDetectHook
hook.description: A honeypot hook that unconditionally allows buy swaps (zeroForOne=true) but blocks real sell transactions by reverting when gasleft() is below 55M. Simulated sells (which use the full block gas limit) appear to succeed, deceiving users into buying tokens they cannot sell in real transactions.

hook.name: WstETHHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that enables seamless wrapping and unwrapping between stETH and wstETH during swaps, applying the dynamic stETH/wstETH exchange rate in beforeSwap and settling token deltas directly with the pool manager. Liquidity additions are blocked; all exchange is handled exclusively through the hook.

hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: Fee-collection hook for the Mixpad token launch platform. Charges a configurable swap fee on every trade, splits it between the token creator and treasury, applies a decaying anti-snipe surcharge in blocks immediately after launch and a time-limited surcharge on deployer sells, and automatically executes buyback-and-burns using a portion of creator fees.

hook.name: SpyHook
hook.description: Passes ordinary swaps through with zero fee impact; when the designated SpyBatch settler swaps with non-empty hookData, takes a 1% fee (COVERT_FEE_BPS) from the input currency and routes it to a vault address for burning.

hook.name: CellHook
hook.description: CellHook is simultaneously the $CELL ERC-20 token and its own Uniswap v4 hook. After each swap, it takes a 7% fee on the unspecified currency: CELL-side fees are 100% burned for deflation, while ETH-side fees are distributed as ETH yield to token holders and fund a randomized, volume-paced token-elimination mechanism.

hook.name: Hash
hook.description: An ERC20 token (HASH) that is also its own Uniswap v4 hook, managing an ETH/HASH pool with a 1% swap fee captured via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta return values. Includes a genesis sale phase, proof-of-work token mining, and a governance gate that blocks swaps until the genesis pool is seeded.

hook.name: SwingHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for an ETH/SWING token pool that applies a custom fee delta in beforeSwap for buy-side trades, validates minimum output, and authorizes settlement in afterSwap. It supports standard Uniswap swaps and Swing-specific swaps that use randomness-based settlement through an external randomness manager.

hook.name: EthCreatorFeeHookV4
hook.description: Charges immutable directional buy/sell fees on native ETH/token pools, splitting fees between the token creator's registered split vault and a fixed launcher fee recipient. Fee rates (between 0.1% and 10%) are configured per pool at registration by the token creator and cannot be changed afterward.

hook.name: HaloHook
hook.description: HaloHook implements a phase-based ETH tax system for a token launch, extracting 3–30% from buys and sells via hook deltas with a time-decaying ignition period. Buy taxes are partially accrued as claimable refunds, released only if the buyer holds their token position for a minimum block window after purchase.

hook.name: M0 Allowlist Hook
hook.description: An access-control hook that restricts swaps to allowlisted addresses using the Predicate authorization system and restricts liquidity provision to approved providers; donations are blocked.

hook.name: UnicurveHook
hook.description: A factory-gated hook for the Unicurve memecoin launchpad that blocks swaps and liquidity additions until the meme token graduates, as indicated by `transfersEnabled()` on the token contract. Pool initialization is restricted to the factory address.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: LaunchHook manages token launch pools with locked liquidity, applying a high anti-snipe fee (up to 99%) that decays over 20 seconds post-launch to a normal 1% rate. Buy and sell fees are split between the token creator and a protocol escrow.

hook.name: TokiHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 custom curve hook implementing Pendle-style fixed-rate yield trading for Principal Tokens. Uses a custom AMM curve with optional ERC4626 rehypothecation to boost LP yields, maintains a TWAP oracle for logarithmic implied rates, and enforces curator-controlled pool lifecycle with pause and maturity expiry.

hook.name: CrownClash
hook.description: Takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee (AeonFee) plus an optional 7 bps tribute on every swap's unspecified currency when hookData encodes a player address, routing both directly to a fixed treasury. Tracks cumulative per-pool swap volume per player and maintains an on-chain leaderboard of the highest-volume trader (the champion).

hook.name: V4AlphaHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that restricts pool initialization to the contract owner and gates swaps and liquidity additions via a per-pool start timestamp, allowing the owner to schedule when trading begins.

hook.name: LendingHookV2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a range-aware lending AMM (lo0p protocol) that seeds the pool with single-sided LOOP token liquidity across multiple price bands, skims a fixed 1% fee on all swaps via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, and enforces a same-block liquidation lockout. Supports borrow, repay, and liquidation operations tied to concentrated liquidity bands.

hook.name: EBlockHook
hook.description: Enforces a fixed 2.5% ETH-denominated fee on swaps in a single configured pool, collected via beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas. Token purchase amounts are tracked in transient storage for consumption by an external lottery/token contract. Fees accumulate and are distributed to the lottery contract via a permissionless `distributeFees()` call. The buyback executor is exempt from fee collection.

hook.name: EthRL Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook managing an ETH/ETHRL main pool and per-answer token pools. It permanently locks external liquidity (beforeAddLiquidity and beforeRemoveLiquidity always revert), charges a 2% fee on the main pool and 0.5% on answer pools via afterSwapReturnsDelta, converts collected fees to ETH, allocates 2% of ETH for ETHRL buyback-and-burn, and distributes the remaining 98% as ETH rewards through a weighted distributor contract.

hook.name: BackGeoOracle
hook.description: A TWAP oracle hook with built-in backrun protection that records on-chain price observations and automatically executes reverse swaps after large price-impact trades to restore the pool price toward the geometric mean, crediting the original swapper with ERC6909 tokens.

hook.name: BackGeoOracle
hook.description: An oracle hook for Uniswap v4 that records TWAP price observations and executes backrun protection after large swaps. When tick movement exceeds a threshold, the hook performs an inverse counter-swap and credits recovered value to the user as ERC-6909 tokens via the router's `msgSender()` interface.

hook.name: Sa1tHookV2
hook.description: A bonding-curve launchpad hook serving every SA1T token pool through three phases: CURVE (custom constant-product AMM via ERC-6909 claims, fully NoOp'd against the pool), REFUND_WINDOW (optional money-back sells at average entry price), and AMM (full-range liquidity locked in LPLocker with TWAP oracle). Applies a 1.5% fee split between protocol and creator, plus an optional mechanic fee, on both buys and sells across all phases.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers an afterInitialize callback (currently a no-op). Exposes an initializePools() function that calls an external liquidity bootstrapper contract to seed initial liquidity and record the initial tick.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: Maintains a per-pool secondary-token reserve ("pot") that absorbs main-token sell pressure at the pool's own execution price (shield) and buys back the main token piggybacked on secondary-to-main swaps (pump). Supports a hook-held LP position with automated fee harvesting, auto-compounding, and configurable buyback/burn splits.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A dynamic fee hook that charges a base fee derived from oracle tick volatility and a time-decaying surge fee during high-volatility periods; a configurable protocol share of swap fees is minted to a full-range liquidity manager for reinvestment.

hook.name: GeodeHook
hook.description: GeodeHook implements a permanent bonding curve venue on Uniswap v4. Direct swaps execute instantly against a constant-product curve via beforeSwap (0.3% fee split three ways), while gasless EIP-712-signed intents are settled in MEV-protected batches at a uniform clearing price (0.1% fee). The curve is the permanent market maker with no graduation or migration.

hook.name: DeathSTRHookV2
hook.description: A hook for an ETH/ckToken pool that enforces exact-input-only swaps, wraps all pool operations with token-level reentrancy guards (enterSwap/exitSwap), and collects a configurable fee (default 10%, max 20%) on each swap by taking the output token, optionally swapping it to ETH via a nested pool swap, and forwarding proceeds to a DeathSTRCollector fee contract.

hook.name: AccessControlDynamicFeeHook
hook.description: Restricts liquidity provision to the owner and a whitelist of approved addresses, and dynamically overrides the LP fee for all swaps to a value configurable by the owner.

hook.name: PDAIBurnHook
hook.description: Burns 1% of pDAI on every swap in a WETH/pDAI Uniswap v4 pool. beforeSwap handles the specified side and afterSwap handles the unspecified side, each taking pDAI from the pool manager and sending it to address(0xdEaD) via return deltas. Burn failures are silently ignored so swaps always proceed. No admin, no upgrades, all addresses hardcoded.

hook.name: ConfigurableKlikHook
hook.description: Configurable tax hook for token launches on Uniswap v4. Charges per-pool buy/sell taxes with optional launch-decay and volume-based surcharges (capped at 25%), splits fees among platform, hook creator, token creator, buyback, and holder rewards, and automatically purchases and burns tokens when the buyback budget reaches 0.1 ETH.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. Only uses afterInitialize (a no-op returning the selector). Liquidity bootstrapping is handled externally via a separate LiquidityBootstrapper contract. No swap interception or dynamic fee logic.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that only implements afterInitialize. It delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract and records the initial tick. No swap, fee, or liquidity logic is active.

hook.name: UniversalKlikHook
hook.description: A fee-extracting hook for ETH-paired pools that charges tiered buy/sell fees (0.35–1.25%) based on market cap fetched from an external factory contract. Fees are split between a platform treasury and the token contract via delta adjustments. No fees are charged on the pool's deployment block.

hook.name: Ring Few USDT Hook
hook.description: Wraps and unwraps USDT to/from fewUSDT (Ring Protocol's wrapped token) automatically during swaps in Uniswap v4 pools, performing 1:1 conversions and absorbing the full swap delta via beforeSwapReturnsDelta.

hook.name: Dead Pizza LP Hook
hook.description: Burns 1% of the PIZZA LP token side on every swap by sending it to the dead address (0x000...dEaD). Uses beforeSwap delta for LP-as-specified-input swaps and afterSwap delta for LP-as-unspecified-output swaps. Enforces a single ETH/PIZZA_LP pool pair; reverts on any other pool configuration.
