hook.name: OneTimeLaunchHookTemplate
hook.description: Enforces one-time pool initialization and one-time liquidity addition per token (currency1). In afterSwap, when activated, selectively reverts token-sell swaps (zeroForOne=false) for addresses not on an owner-managed allowlist, while anyone can publicly call bigInt() to enable this restriction.

hook.name: TokenWorks Hook v2
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for NFTStrategy trading pools that applies time-decaying buy fees (starting at 99% and decreasing to 10% as blocks accumulate) and a flat 10% sell fee, collecting fees via afterSwap delta returns and distributing them to configured recipients.

hook.name: PrismHook
hook.description: DN404-style ERC20/ERC721 hybrid token (PRISM, 5,000 supply) that manages a single Uniswap v4 ETH/PRISM pool. Each whole token held auto-mints an NFT; LP fees harvested from the hook's own position are distributed pro-rata to NFT holders. The afterSwap callback is a pure no-op.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol with an afterInitialize callback that is a no-op stub. The contract exposes an initializePools() function that calls an external liquidity bootstrapper and stores the resulting initial tick and initialization status on-chain.

hook.name: DopplerHookInitializer
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that manages token launches on a multi-segment bonding curve, with dynamic LP fees, optional plugin hooks (DopplerHooks) for custom swap callbacks, and a graduation mechanism that migrates liquidity to a standard AMM once the target tick is reached.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol with only an afterInitialize permission. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; actual pool setup is handled externally via initializePools(), which calls a LiquidityBootstrapper contract and records the initial tick.

hook.name: DEPHIHook
hook.description: Implements asymmetric block-decaying swap taxes: buy tax starts at 99% and decays to 10% over ~445 blocks (100 bps per 5 blocks), sell tax is constant 10%. Fees are skimmed in afterSwap, converted to ETH via an internal pool swap if needed, then split between the token contract, a charity address, and a protocol address. Exact output swaps are blocked.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records pool initialization state. The afterInitialize callback is enabled but performs no additional logic; a separate initializePools() function delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap liquidity and store the initial tick.

hook.name: WorldCupHook
hook.description: Blocks swaps and liquidity changes on nation-token/WCUP pools when a nation is in a live knockout match. Checks a TournamentRegistry oracle for a global trading-open flag and per-token freeze status; reverts if either currency in the pool is currently frozen.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Saturn Omnichain token pools that registers an afterInitialize callback (which is a no-op) and exposes an initializePools() function that delegates liquidity bootstrapping to a separate LiquidityBootstrapper contract to set initial tick positions.

hook.name: OnePlantV4SwapHook
hook.description: OnePlant protocol hook for a NATIVE/UP token pool that collects burn fees on UP token swaps (burning UP tokens and minting OP tokens to the recipient) and team fees on native token swaps. Restricts swaps to a configurable trusted swap helper address.

hook.name: TaxStrategyHook
hook.description: A revenue-sharing hook that charges 10% fee on all swaps, automatically converting fees to ETH for strategic allocation: 90% to an automated treasury that invests in ETF-candidate tokens, 10% to development fund. Includes automated profit-taking at 10% gains with buyback-and-burn mechanism.

hook.name: NoOp
hook.description: Minimal hook that emits a BeforeSwapFired event on every swap and takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on the unspecified (output) currency, routing it to a hardcoded recipient address via poolManager.take() in afterSwap. The fee rate and recipient are compile-time constants that cannot be overridden by derived contracts.

hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: Charges a 1% ETH fee on every swap in ETH-denominated pools, accruing fees to a per-token registered creator address. Enforces a launch-block swap lock that only the token factory can lift; the owner can claim accrued ETH fees on behalf of creators.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that stores pool configuration constants and integrates with a liquidity bootstrapper contract to initialize liquidity positions. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; swaps execute without any hook intervention.

hook.name: DualPoolHook
hook.description: JIT liquidity hook that deploys concentrated LP positions across multiple configurable tick ranges before each swap and removes them afterward. Idle capital is rehypothecated via ERC-4626 vaults between swaps. The LP fee is static, set at pool creation via PoolKey.fee; dynamic fees are explicitly rejected.

hook.name: FarmHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that acts as a yield farm and liquidity manager, enforcing full-range liquidity added only through the hook. Charges a 1% swap fee routed to a fee recipient, distributes minted reward tokens via a Synthetix-style accumulator with tiered emissions (6.6M/day bootstrap, then 660k/day), and applies a 10% claim tax redistributed to current LPs.

hook.name: NFTXV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the NFTX protocol that manages NFT-backed liquidity pools with dynamic LP fees (per-origin fee overrides via OVERRIDE_FEE_FLAG), on-chain price oracle observations, and AMM fee collection credited to a configurable beneficiary address.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only afterInitialize enabled (as a no-op returning the selector). Exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external liquidity bootstrapper contract and records the initial tick and initialized state on-chain.

hook.name: VirtualLBPStrategyBasic
hook.description: A hook implementing a Virtual Liquidity Bootstrapping Pool (LBP) strategy for token launches. It restricts pool initialization to the contract itself and gates all swaps on a migration approval flag, enabling controlled token distribution.

hook.name: Custom Fee MEV Protection Hook (Ethereum)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for TOKEN/ETH and TOKEN/WETH pools that applies configurable directional buy/sell fee overrides and optional anti-MEV protections including blacklisting, one-trade-per-block enforcement, cooldown periods, and maximum sell amount limits.

hook.name: Mechanic Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a designated token/WETH pool that gates swaps behind a liquidity bootstrap phase, applies time-decaying WETH-denominated fees on buys and sells via swap delta overrides, tracks epoch market state and all-time-high price candidates, and executes automated token buybacks and burns funded by collected fees.

hook.name: TokenWorks Hook v3
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook by TokenWorks that manages fee collection and distribution for NFT strategy ETH/token pools. It enforces ETH/token-only pool initialization via the factory, applies a time-decaying buy fee (starting at 95% and decreasing to 10% over blocks), and uses afterSwapReturnsDelta to skim fees and distribute them to the protocol, stakers, and collection owners.

hook.name: JBUniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap V4 hook that routes exact-input swaps to either the V4 pool or a Juicebox project terminal, choosing whichever venue offers more output, using a 30-minute TWAP oracle for manipulation-resistant comparison. Also maintains a TWAP oracle ring buffer queryable by external contracts such as buyback hooks.

hook.name: AggHook
hook.description: Routes swaps through a hardcoded set of 3 Uniswap v4 pools and 6 V3-compatible pools, sorted on-the-fly by effective sqrtPrice. Handles exactIn and exactOut in both directions, returns a BeforeSwapDelta that fully settles the exchange. Liquidity additions and pool initialization are restricted to a hardcoded admin address.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper. Only afterInitialize is active; all swap and liquidity callbacks are no-ops that return their selectors unchanged.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook with a no-op afterInitialize callback. Pool initialization is triggered externally via initializePools(), which calls an ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap liquidity and records the resulting initial tick and pool initialization status on-chain.

hook.name: Asterix Hook
hook.description: A fee-collection hook that takes a configurable percentage of each swap's unspecified output token: for native ETH outputs the fee is forwarded to a treasury, while for ERC-20 outputs it is burned by sending to a dead address. A separate configurable portion is always forwarded to a main treasury.

hook.name: NFTStrategyHook
hook.description: A hook for NFTStrategy pools that takes swap fees with a time-decaying buy rate (starting at 99%, decreasing by 100bps per 5 blocks down to a 10% floor) and a fixed 10% sell fee. Collected fees are distributed 80% to the NFT collection, 10% to buy-and-burn PNKSTR, and 10% to a configurable fee address. Exact-output swaps are blocked, and liquidity operations are restricted to the NFTStrategyFactory.

hook.name: UNI20Hook
hook.description: A BRC-20-style inscription protocol layered on Uniswap v4. Users embed DEPLOY, MINT, or TRANSFER operations in swap hookData; MINT and DEPLOY ops extract ETH fees from the swap via BeforeSwapDelta and poolManager.take(), minting ERC-1155 tokens to the swapper's EOA. Swaps without hookData pass through normally.

hook.name: M0 Tick Range Hook
hook.description: Restricts liquidity provision to a configurable tick range by reverting in beforeAddLiquidity if the position's ticks fall outside the allowed bounds. An authorized manager role can update the tick range.

hook.name: TTTHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for TTT/ETH pools launched by the TenThousandTokens factory. Applies a decaying buy fee (99%→1% over 98 blocks from launch) and a flat 1% sell fee; buy fees are converted to ETH via an internal pool swap and split between a FeeSplitter and a per-token buyback sink in afterSwap.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Hook with only afterInitialize permission. Exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract to set up liquidity positions, recording the initial tick and marking the pool as initialized. All swap, liquidity, and donate callbacks are pure no-op stubs.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Saturn Omnichain that holds afterInitialize permission but the callback is a no-op. Pool setup is performed via the external initializePools() function, which calls a LiquidityBootstrapper contract and records the initial tick. No swap-phase permissions are active.

hook.name: WhitelistHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that restricts swaps to whitelisted addresses. It checks `tx.origin` against an external `ISwapWhitelist` contract in `beforeSwap`, reverting with `SwapperNotWhitelisted` for non-whitelisted callers. No modification to swap execution occurs beyond access control.

hook.name: TuringHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the TURING protocol that collects a 10% output fee on each swap: burns TURING tokens on buys (ETH→TURING) and distributes ETH fees on sells, splitting 1% to a team wallet and 9% to the token treasury. Calls enterSwap() on the token contract before each swap to set transient authorization.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal hook for Saturn Omnichain that implements only afterInitialize as a no-op. Pool bootstrapping is performed via a separate ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract that sets initial tick and liquidity; the hook records initialTick and a poolInitialized flag.

hook.name: TokenWorks Hook v4
hook.description: A hook for the TokenWorks NFT strategy ecosystem that restricts pool initialization and liquidity addition to the NFTStrategyFactory, and collects a configurable swap fee (default 10%, with a 95% initial buy fee) distributed among the collection owner, a protocol fee address, and PNKSTR token holders.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Saturn Omnichain hook with afterInitialize permission (no-op callback). Provides an initializePools() function that delegates to a separate LiquidityBootstrapper contract to seed initial liquidity and records the starting tick.

hook.name: Hook
hook.description:
Prices swaps on an exponential bonding curve (K × (1 -
   e^(-eth/S))) instead of AMM, charging a dual-phase tax — 0.2% with 1 ETH buy 
  cap in Phase 1, 0.5% uncapped in Phase 2. Locked taxes auto-release as rewards
   to staked NFT holders when circulating supply drops below target. Uses 
  beforeSwapReturnDelta for custom delta accounting and blocks all LP additions 
  via beforeAddLiquidity.

hook.name: UpegHook
hook.description: Stores on-chain SVG data for collectible ERC-20 tokens. Calls start on the configured token when first liquidity is added, and updates a random seed on each swap involving that token.

hook.name: UPeg Hook
hook.description: Calls `start()` on a configured token when the first liquidity is added to that token's pool, and updates an internal random seed on each swap involving the configured token. Both actions are no-ops when no token is configured or for pools not involving the token.

hook.name: WethWstGbpHook
hook.description: Oracle-aware dynamic-fee hook for a WETH/wstGBP Uniswap v4 pool that sets LP fees per swap based on directional flow and deviation from a Chainlink-composed fair price (ETH/USD ÷ GBP/USD ÷ wstGBP NAV). A governance-controlled pause degrades pricing to a fixed fallback fee without blocking swaps.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Saturn Omnichain project hook that registers the afterInitialize callback (implemented as a no-op). Exposes an initializePools() function callable by anyone, which delegates to an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap liquidity and record the initial pool tick.

hook.name: BCHook
hook.description: Collects a static 10% fee on all swaps in ETH/BC token pools, converting token fees to ETH via an internal nested swap and distributing 90% to a league pool and 10% to a fee address. Liquidity additions are restricted to the BCFactory, and exact-output swaps are blocked.

hook.name: EquityPegHook
hook.description: A hook that acts as an equity-pegged market maker, quoting token↔USDC swaps at a price derived from an external equity/stock feed. Liquidity deposits are fully blocked; each swap is settled in full via beforeSwapReturnDelta using locked ERC-6909 inventory seeded at graduation. Swaps revert when the feed is stale or not-ok, or when the pool is frozen by the factory admin.

hook.name: Ash Hook
hook.description: AshHook collects a configurable protocol fee (default 5%, max 10%) on ETH/ASH pool swaps: an ETH fee on buys is taken in beforeSwap via returnDelta, and an ETH fee on sells is taken in afterSwap, both forwarded to a treasury address. The owner can pause fee collection and update the fee rate and treasury.

hook.name: AshHook
hook.description: Protocol fee hook for an ASH/ETH pool that captures a configurable 5% trading fee (up to 10%) on both buys and sells, routing collected ETH to a treasury address using beforeSwapReturnsDelta for buy fees and afterSwapReturnsDelta for sell fees.

hook.name: GoalRushHook
hook.description: Uniswap V4 hook for GoalRush ($GOAL), an on-chain World Cup 2026 prediction game. On a player's first qualifying ETH→GOAL buy it mints a soulbound Predictor passport NFT (afterSwap), and on every swap it applies a tier-based dynamic LP-fee discount (beforeSwap) derived from the wallet's on-chain betting record. afterInitialize locks the canonical ETH/GOAL dynamic-fee pool. Permissions: afterInitialize, beforeSwap, afterSwap (address low 14 bits = 0x10C0).

hook.name: Unipump Fee Hook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook that collects a configurable fee (50–1000 bps) from the unspecified token of each swap in Unipump pools. Splits fees 60% to the pool creator and 40% to a fixed platform wallet; only factory-registered pools may use this hook.

hook.name: FairTradeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that blocks swaps from addresses on an owner-maintained blocklist; beforeAddLiquidity and beforeRemoveLiquidity are implemented as pass-throughs with no additional logic.

hook.name: LendingHookV4
hook.description: A lending AMM hook that manages a full-range ETH/TOKEN LP position as a collateralized borrowing vault. LPs deposit ETH and TOKEN to earn swap fees; borrowers post TOKEN collateral for ETH loans at 40% LTV. Skims a 0.5% protocol fee on each swap via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, and blocks swaps in any block where a liquidation occurred.

hook.name: ShitGiftHook
hook.description: An afterSwap hook that enqueues a commit-reveal lottery ticket for qualifying SHIT token buys (≥ 42069 SHIT) on the canonical pool. Tickets are settled 2+ blocks later using blockhash as RNG, giving a 1% chance of receiving 1 ether of a community-deposited art token (ERC-20/ERC-1155). Winners face a 24-hour cooldown; payouts go to tx.origin.

hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFee
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Clanker token pools that enforces separate configurable static LP fees for buying vs. selling the Clanker token, collects a 20% protocol fee on each swap via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns, and activates an optional MEV-protection module during the first 2 minutes after pool creation.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that implements only the afterInitialize permission as a no-op callback. Liquidity bootstrapping is performed via a separate initializePools() function that calls an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to record the initial tick. No swap, liquidity, or donate hook logic is present.

hook.name: ENS Wheel Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the ENSWheel protocol that restricts pool initialization and liquidity additions to the ENSWheel factory, and applies a time-decaying buy fee (starting at 95%, decreasing to 10% over time) distributed between the ENS collection engine (80%) and a configurable team address (20%).

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers afterInitialize permission to validate hook address constraints at deployment. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; actual pool setup is performed via initializePools(), which delegates liquidity bootstrapping to a separate ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that holds only the afterInitialize permission but performs no logic within that callback. Pool initialization is delegated to an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract via initializePools(), which records the initial tick.

hook.name: PerpLandHook
hook.description: A leveraged-long protocol on a bonding curve that lets users open 2–5x ETH-collateralized long positions. The hook owns all pool liquidity, restricts LP operations to itself, gates trading on a `tradingEnabled` flag, enforces TWAP-based price gates on opens, caps per-block curve advances, and auto-liquidates undercollateralized positions inside `afterSwap`.

hook.name: TideHook
hook.description: TideHook is a Uniswap v4 hook that acts as both an ERC-20 token (TIDE) and the sole LP of a single v4 pool. It enforces a degressive launch fee schedule (25%→10%→5% forever) by overriding the dynamic LP fee each swap, distributes swap fees pro-rata to TIDE holders via a vesting mechanism, and features a lottery that awards forfeited unclaimed earnings from sellers to a random holder.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that implements only afterInitialize as a no-op. Includes an external initializePools() function that calls a liquidity bootstrapper contract and records the initial tick; all other hook callbacks are pure no-ops.

hook.name: BracketHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a dual-regime AMM for a World Cup bracket protocol: a virtual-reserve bonding curve for early-stage trading, transitioning to a standard v4 pool with protocol fees and elimination taxes (up to 10% on sells of eliminated teams) after graduation.

hook.name: Arrakis Private Hook (Ethereum)
hook.description: Restricts liquidity additions to authorized Arrakis LP modules for private vaults, and applies per-direction dynamic fee overrides on swaps via the Uniswap v4 LP fee override mechanism.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that only implements afterInitialize. All swap, liquidity, and donate callbacks are no-ops. Provides an initializePools() function that delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper to bootstrap liquidity and record the initial tick.

hook.name: BVCC Dynamic Fee Hook (Ethereum)
hook.description: An advanced anti-bot Uniswap v4 hook by BlockVenture Chain Capital that dynamically adjusts LP fees based on gas price levels, volatility, and 24-hour pool volume. It applies a repeat-swap penalty to deter bot activity and collects a small hook fee from each swap's output amount.

hook.name: BoltFeeHookV3
hook.description: A launch-protection hook that applies a 10% buy/sell tax on swaps of ≥1.5% of supply during the first 6 blocks after pool initialization, diverting taxed tokens or ETH to a treasury. After the window, it permanently triggers internal self-swaps to convert accumulated tokens (≥5M threshold) into ETH forwarded to the treasury on every subsequent user swap.

hook.name: ShitGiftHookV2
hook.description: An afterSwap hook on a configurable SHIT token pool that queues random ShitVerse art (ERC-20) token drops for qualifying buyers. Drop probability is volume-tiered (0.5%–42%), settled via future blockhash RNG with a 2-block delay and a 1-day per-address cooldown. Art tokens can be deposited permissionlessly by anyone holding valid ShitVerse factory tokens; the Ownable2Step owner can withdraw art tokens.

hook.name: NFTStrategyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for NFT-backed token pools that charges dynamic buy fees (starting at 99% and decreasing by 100 bps per 5 blocks down to 10%) and a fixed 10% sell fee. Collected ETH fees are distributed 80% to the NFTStrategy collection, 10% to PNKSTR buyback/burn, and 10% to a configurable fee address.

hook.name: WsgemBackstopHook
hook.description: Custom-curve backstop hook for the tGBP/wstGBP pool. beforeSwap returns a BeforeSwapDelta that cancels the AMM curve and routes the swap through the wstGBP wrapper's atomic mint/redeem, so buys execute at mintcost() and sells at burncost(). beforeAddLiquidity reverts, so the pool holds no LP liquidity. The hook is ownerless, holds no capital, and charges no fee of its own. Swaps must be settle-first; a conventional swap-then-settle v4 router will revert.

hook.name: CapGate
hook.description: Reverts swaps where the absolute amount specified exceeds MAX_TRADE (100e18 units). Inherits AeonFee, which takes a mandatory 10 bps fee on the unspecified (output) currency of every swap via afterSwap return delta, routing it to a hardcoded recipient.

hook.name: BallisticFeeHookV3
hook.description: Directional quote-currency fee hook with configurable per-pool buy/sell fee rates, a time-decaying opening fee schedule, and a 10 bps platform floor. Fees are split between a per-pool creator allocation vault and a platform treasury collector. The hook bypasses fees for the registered allocation vault address.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy
hook.description: ERC1967 upgradeable proxy hook; the actual hook implementation was not available for source analysis. The address bitmask encodes beforeInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, beforeRemoveLiquidity, beforeSwap, afterSwap, and afterSwapReturnsDelta permissions.

hook.name: QuotronStockHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for w<SYM>/USDG stock pools on Ink that overrides the LP fee to zero and collects a configurable hook fee on the USDG side of each swap via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwap return delta, distributing proceeds between a per-pool LP vault pot and a shared terminal pot used for automated stock buybacks and dividends. Pools must be registered by the factory before initialization.

hook.name: QuotronStockHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Quotron stock/USDG pools on Ink that overrides LP fees to 0% and skims a flat, owner-adjustable fee on the USDG side of each swap. Fees are split between a venue-wide terminal pot (fed to an epoch converter for stock buybacks and terminal dividends) and a per-pool LP vault pot.

hook.name: PublicTransparentUpgradeableProxy
hook.description: A transparent upgradeable proxy from the @yolo/contracts project (by 0xyolodev.eth) that wraps a Uniswap v4 hook implementation. It exposes the implementation address, proxy admin, and implementation version publicly; the actual hook logic resides in the (unverified) implementation contract.

hook.name: SentryStockFeeHookV3
hook.description: A time-decaying launch fee hook that charges a high initial swap fee that decays by half-life to a floor rate. Fees are split among a creator recipient, protocol treasury, permanently-locked LP compounding, and token holder reflections, with the distribution changing after a configurable reflection delay post-launch.

hook.name: StocktopusV4FeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 1.5% fee on every swap (1% to pool creator, 0.5% to protocol) using BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta to collect fees in the input currency. Only registered pools (authorized by the factory) can swap, and each swap triggers a graduation check on the pool's associated token.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that absorbs main-token sells at the pool's own execution price (shield) and executes market buys on the pool on incoming buys (pump), delivering purchased tokens to a configurable recipient or burning them. Optionally manages a hook-held LP position with auto-harvested, auto-compounding fee splits.

hook.name: PurplXV4FeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 1.5% fee on every swap (1% to creator, 0.5% to protocol treasury) by intercepting the input currency via BeforeSwapDelta (exact-output) and AfterSwapDelta (exact-input), minting ERC-6909 claims to the hook and treasury. Pools must be registered by a factory before swaps execute; creator fees accumulate as claims and are redeemable on demand.

hook.name: BlockEcho
hook.description: Gates swaps by requiring the swap amount's last two digits (mod 100) to be within +/-2 of the current block number's last two digits. Takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on every swap's unspecified (output) amount, routed to a hardcoded recipient via afterSwap return delta.

hook.name: UniswapV4KEMHook
hook.description: A hook that enforces signed exchange-rate quotes on each swap. In beforeSwap it validates a cryptographic signature from a designated quoteSigner covering the swap parameters, maximum input, rate, nonce, and expiry. In afterSwap, any output exceeding the quoted rate is absorbed as "eg" tokens minted to the hook and later claimable by authorized accounts.

hook.name: HookdRandomHook
hook.description: An afterSwap hook that maintains a rolling random seed per ERC3232 token by hashing swap parameters, deltas, and block context on each swap. Token contracts read this seed via `randomSeed()` to derive pseudo-random values during object generation.

hook.name: DopplerHookInitializer
hook.description: Uniswap v4 pool initializer implementing the Doppler Multicurve bonding curve mechanism, distributing liquidity across multiple tick-range positions for token launches. Supports locked pools with fee-collecting beneficiaries, dynamic LP fee adjustment via linked Doppler hooks, and pool graduation logic triggered by reaching a target tick.

hook.name: TotalizerTrap
hook.description: Tracks a per-pool cumulative swap volume and reverts any swap whose amount would bring the running total to a multiple of 11. Inherits a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee (AeonFee) taken on every swap's output currency via afterSwap return delta.

hook.name: UniswapV4ScheduledMulticurveInitializerHook
hook.description: A token launch hook by Whetstone Research that gates pool initialization and liquidity additions exclusively to a designated Initializer contract, and blocks swaps until a per-pool configured start timestamp, enabling scheduled fair-launch token distributions.

hook.name: UniswapV4ScheduledMulticurveInitializerHook
hook.description: A Doppler protocol hook (by Whetstone Research) that gates pool initialization and liquidity additions to an authorized initializer contract, and enforces a configurable start time before which swaps are blocked.

hook.name: HeavierHand
hook.description: Gates swaps to only allow selling the token the pool currently holds more of, based on virtual reserves derived from slot0 price and active liquidity. Past a 10% skew cap the gate inverts so only the rebalancing direction is admitted. Charges a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on every swap via afterSwap return-delta, routed to a fixed recipient address.

hook.name: NoOp
hook.description: Minimal hook that emits a BeforeSwapFired event on every swap and takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on the unspecified (output) currency, routing it to a hardcoded recipient address via poolManager.take() in afterSwap. The fee rate and recipient are compile-time constants that cannot be overridden by derived contracts.

hook.name: TailTwins
hook.description: Gates swaps by requiring the swap amount's absolute low byte to be within 16 of the current pool's sqrtPriceX96 low byte; reverts otherwise. Also charges a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on every swap's unspecified (output) currency via afterSwap return delta, routed to a fixed recipient.

hook.name: ExactInGate
hook.description: Blocks exact-output swaps by reverting when amountSpecified > 0. Inherits AeonFee, which takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on every swap's unspecified (output) currency via afterSwapReturnsDelta, routing it to a hardcoded recipient address.

hook.name: DynamicFee
hook.description: Adjusts the LP fee dynamically based on tick movement from the previous swap - larger moves increase the fee (up to 5%), smaller moves reduce it (floor 0.05%). Inherits AeonFee, which takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on every swap routed to a fixed hardcoded recipient via afterSwap return-delta.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: GlueHook intercepts main-token sells by filling them from a funded 'pot' at the pool's own execution price (shield), and after each swap auto-harvests LP fees and executes a capped 'pump' buy of the main token using pot secondary-token reserves.

hook.name: CrownClash
hook.description: Takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee (AeonFee) plus an optional 7 bps tribute on every swap's unspecified currency when hookData encodes a player address, routing both directly to a fixed treasury. Tracks cumulative per-pool swap volume per player and maintains an on-chain leaderboard of the highest-volume trader (the champion).

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: DynamicFee Hook w/ Oracle Implementation.

hook.name: CapGate
hook.description: Reverts swaps where the absolute amount specified exceeds MAX_TRADE (100e18 units). Inherits AeonFee, which takes a mandatory 10 bps fee on the unspecified (output) currency of every swap via afterSwap return delta, routing it to a hardcoded recipient.

hook.name: AegisHook
hook.description: Dynamic-fee hook that charges additional hook fees on every swap (collected in the input token), auto-reinvests accumulated fees into the pool via an external AegisEngine, integrates an on-chain oracle for TWAP cardinality management, and delegates limit-order processing to a LimitOrderManager.

hook.name: Aegis DFM
hook.description: A dynamic fee market maker hook that uses a truncated geometric oracle to compute base and surge fees, collects a protocol fee share on each swap, and reinvests collected fees into a full-range liquidity position.

hook.name: LegacyLedger
hook.description: Charges a mandatory 0.10% protocol fee (AeonFee) on every swap's unspecified currency, routing it to a fixed immutable treasury address. Optionally charges an additional 0.05% loyalty tax when hookData encodes a player address, incrementing that player's on-chain loyalty score and tier.

hook.name: CoalaOptimismHook
hook.description: Collects a 1% buy and 1% sell tax on swaps in registered pools by intercepting beforeSwap and afterSwap. Tax is taken from the base-asset side of each swap and minted as ERC-6909 claims to the project token address. Pools must be registered by an owner-controlled factory before they can be initialized or traded.

hook.name: PumHook
hook.description: Gates swaps on creator token / carry token pools, blocking sells of the creator token until a minimum sqrtPrice threshold is reached. The owner can toggle per-token market sellability and update the dynamic LP fee via updateDynamicLPFee.

hook.name: VolumeDynamicFeeHook
hook.description: Dynamically adjusts LP fees based on swap volume using an exponential moving average, cycling between floor, cash, and extreme fee tiers. Also charges a configurable hook fee collected as an afterSwap delta.

hook.name: WETH Hook (Optimism)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that enables seamless wrapping and unwrapping of ETH to WETH within a pool, intercepting swaps to perform 1:1 ETH↔WETH conversions while blocking direct liquidity operations.

hook.name: IndexHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for index token pools that enforces an owner-controlled pool allowlist, applies dynamic LP fees with optional custom hook fees, grants zero-fee swaps to index tokens swapping on their own native pools, and tracks index token balances across pools for burn coefficient accounting.

hook.name: VolumeDynamicFeeHook
hook.description: A single-pool Uniswap v4 hook that dynamically adjusts LP fees across three regimes (floor, cash, extreme) based on EMA-smoothed per-period volume analysis. After each swap, it accrues a configurable percentage of LP fees to the hook owner and may update the pool's dynamic fee tier via poolManager.updateDynamicLPFee().

hook.name: SuperDCAGauge
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for SuperDCA token pools implementing a three-tier dynamic fee structure (0% internal, 0.10% keeper, 0.50% external), a king-of-the-hill keeper deposit mechanism, and SuperDCA token reward distribution via minting and pool donations triggered on liquidity operations. Only verified router addresses are permitted to execute swaps.

hook.name: BackGeoOracle
hook.description: Oracle hook for zero-fee, full-range Uniswap v4 pools that records TWAP observations and performs automatic backrun swaps to partially reverse large price impacts, returning value to swappers via ERC6909 tokens. Only exactIn swaps are supported; routers must implement IMsgSender or backrun transactions will revert.

hook.name: BackGeoOracle
hook.description: A TWAP oracle hook that automatically executes backrun swaps to restore price toward its geometric mean after significant price moves, crediting backrun proceeds to the original swapper via ERC6909 tokens. Only supports exactIn swaps on zero-fee, full-range oracle pools.

hook.name: ArrakisPrivateHook
hook.description: A hook for Arrakis private vaults that overrides LP fees per swap direction (zeroForOne and oneForZero) based on configuration set by authorized vault executors. Restricts liquidity additions to the Arrakis module registered for each pool.

hook.name: JBUniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A Juicebox v4 smart-router hook that compares expected output from the Uniswap v4 pool against Juicebox buy/sell paths, routing each swap to whichever delivers more tokens. Also maintains a TWAP/geomean oracle and optionally enforces slippage protection via tagged hookData.

hook.name: EMADynamicFeeHook
hook.description: EMA-based dynamic fee hook for Uniswap V4. Calculates swap fees using Exponential Moving Average of price, with 30-step fee schedule (0.01%-3.00%) and 300-block anti-JIT protection via tx.origin. No owner, no admin functions, fully immutable

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a shield mechanism (absorbs main-to-secondary sells from a funded pot at the pool's own price, returning a BeforeSwapDelta) and a pump mechanism (uses pot funds to buy back the main token on incoming buy swaps via a nested self-call), with optional auto-harvesting and auto-compounding of a hook-held LP position.

hook.name: Findex Hook (Optimism)
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Findex protocol that restricts pool initialization and liquidity additions to whitelisted pools and authorized providers, while managing dynamic LP fees and granting transfer exceptions to limited-account holders after swaps and liquidity events.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements dynamic fee management backed by a truncated geometric oracle, charging protocol fees on swaps (exactIn and exactOut) and auto-reinvesting them as full-range liquidity.

hook.name: VolumeDynamicFeeHook
hook.description: Adjusts the pool's dynamic LP fee across up to 7 tiers based on an EMA of stablecoin-denominated swap volume, raising fees during high-volume periods and lowering them during lulls. A guardian address can pause the hook, which locks the fee at a configured pause tier until unpaused.

hook.name: JBUniswapV4Hook
hook.description: Routes swaps to whichever venue (Uniswap V4 pool or Juicebox project terminal) gives the user more output, using a 30-minute TWAP oracle to compare quotes on-chain. Also maintains an on-chain price oracle compatible with the IGeomeanOracle interface for external TWAP queries.

hook.name: ATXMV4GlobalHook
hook.description: A liquidity management hook that restricts add/remove liquidity to owner-whitelisted pools and enforces full-range positions. Emits PositionLiquidityChanged events with LP attribution resolved via optional 20-byte hookData or Polygon PositionManager NFT ownership.

hook.name: Aegis V1.1
hook.description: Dynamic fee hook designed to optimize capital efficiency, protect LP value, and automatically adapt to market volatility.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that applies volatility-based dynamic fee overrides on each swap, collects a configurable protocol fee share, and reinvests it into a full-range liquidity position via a connected FullRangeLiquidityManager. It also maintains a truncated geometric oracle to track per-block tick movement for automated fee tuning.

hook.name: BackGeoOracle
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that maintains an on-chain TWAP oracle and executes automatic backrun logic to mitigate price impact — when a swap moves the price beyond a threshold, the hook performs a partial or full inverse swap in the same transaction and credits the original trader with the proceeds as ERC6909 tokens.

hook.name: AggHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that aggregates USDC.e/USDC swaps across 12 liquidity pools (11 v4 pools and 1 PancakeSwap v3 pool) by sorting routes by effective sqrtPrice and filling sequentially. It uses beforeSwapReturnsDelta to return the aggregated delta, levies a fee via poolManager.donate(), and restricts pool initialization and liquidity addition to a hardcoded admin address.

hook.name: LimitOrderHook
hook.description: Records the pool tick before each swap using transient storage, then invokes an external LimitOrderManager to execute limit orders that crossed the tick range after each swap. Includes role-gated dynamic LP fee management via poolManager.updateDynamicLPFee().

hook.name: IndexHook
hook.description: A hook for index token pools that tracks index token reserves across liquidity positions, applies a 0% LP fee override for the index token's own self-swaps, and optionally takes a custom hook fee from swap input. Pool operations are restricted to explicitly allowlisted pools, and liquidity additions enforce a per-pool LP allowlist for manually added pools.

hook.name: EMADynamicFeeHook
hook.description: EMA-based dynamic fee hook for Uniswap V4. Calculates swap fees using Exponential Moving Average of price, with 30-step fee schedule (0.01%-3.00%) and 300-block anti-JIT protection via tx.origin. No owner, no admin functions, fully immutable.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook singleton implementing a per-pool buyback-and-burn mechanism: a "shield" absorbs sells from a funded donation pot at the pool's own execution price (via beforeSwapReturnsDelta), and a "pump" spends pot secondary tokens to buy back the main token on incoming buys (via a nested self-call swap in afterSwap). Supports optional auto-compounding LP programs with configurable fee splitting.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements dynamic LP fee management using a base+surge model from a DynamicFeeManager, records price observations via a truncated geometric oracle, and collects a protocol fee share on both exact-in and exact-out swaps, reinvesting proceeds via a FullRangeLiquidityManager.

hook.name: LimitOrderHook
hook.description: Executes limit orders by tracking tick movement across swaps: beforeSwap stores the current tick in transient storage, and afterSwap calls an external LimitOrderManager to fill any orders whose tick range was crossed. Includes a role-gated function for updating the pool's dynamic LP fee via poolManager.updateDynamicLPFee().

hook.name: TELxIncentiveHook
hook.description: Tracks LP positions in an external PositionRegistry to support off-chain incentive reward calculation; gates pool initialization and liquidity operations to an authorized position manager.

hook.name: VladdyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for native ETH/TOKEN pools that charges a fixed per-pool ETH-side fee on every swap and distributes proceeds instantly across configurable modes: direct recipient payouts, buyback-and-burn, staking rewards (robin mode), lottery draws, or liquidity provisioning. Exact-output sells are unsupported.

hook.name: CreatorFeeHookV1
hook.description: Charges fixed directional buy and sell fees in beforeSwap or afterSwap depending on trade shape, collecting a protocol fee, and paying the remainder to up to five creator-nominated recipients.

hook.name: CashCatQuoteFeeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for all CashCat launchpad pools that charges a configurable swap fee (up to 10%) always in the pool's quote currency via v4 return-delta accounting. Fees are taken in beforeSwap for specified-quote swaps and afterSwap for unspecified-quote swaps, minted as ERC-6909 claims to a locker. Pool creation is gated to the CashCat launchpad; afterSwap also records a cosmetic graduation milestone based on post-swap price.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. It has no swap-time logic; all hook callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Saturn Omnichain project hook that registers `afterInitialize` as a no-op callback. Initial liquidity setup is performed via a separate `initializePools()` function that invokes an `ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper` contract and records the initial tick. Has no swap-time logic — swaps execute identically to a standard Uniswap v4 pool.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A 1% fee hook for token launches that intercepts ETH→token buys (in beforeSwap) and token→ETH sells (in afterSwap) to collect fees from the ETH side via return deltas, forwarding proceeds to a factory contract that splits revenue between the token creator and platform.

hook.name: VampHook
hook.description: A market-cap-tiered tax hook for Vamp Pad ETH/token pools. On each swap it collects a fee (up to 1.25%) scaled by the token's current market cap, then distributes platform and creator shares to configurable treasury addresses.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A single shared launchpad hook that gates pool creation and liquidity management to the factory, permanently locks single-sided token liquidity, and charges time-decaying anti-snipe fees on swaps distributed across creator, platform, and referrer fee components via ERC-6909 claims.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that charges a fixed WETH-only fee on every swap through registered pools using return-delta accounting (beforeSwapReturnsDelta/afterSwapReturnsDelta). Accrued WETH fees are split between an immutable project treasury and protocol treasury at configurable proportions, claimable permissionlessly.

hook.name: LaunchFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a configurable fee (up to 5%, set at deployment) on the ETH side of swaps in native-ETH launchpad pools. Fees are collected in beforeSwap (ETH-specified trades) and afterSwap (token-specified trades) via delta returns, then forwarded to a LaunchFeeSplitter contract that attributes them to each token's creator.

hook.name: PrismHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Prism token launchpad that applies buy and sell fees on registered launch tokens. Fees are deducted via BeforeSwapDelta (exact-input) or AfterSwapDelta (exact-output) and accumulated as claimable balances for token creators.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only afterInitialize permission. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; liquidity is bootstrapped separately via initializePools(), which delegates to an ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract and records the initial tick.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. All swap and liquidity callbacks are no-ops; the only active permission is afterInitialize.

hook.name: GreenlineBuybackHook
hook.description: After each swap, skims a configurable buyback share from the unspecified currency: token-side skims are burned immediately, quote-side skims accrue for a permissionless executeBuyback() that swaps quote back into the token and burns the proceeds. Pool initialization is gated to factory-registered pools only via beforeInitialize.

hook.name: FablesRampETH
hook.description: Singleton dynamic-fee hook for native ETH pools on Robinhood Chain. Charges a per-pool flat fee with a TTL-bounded admin override (poke) clamped between a configured floor and cap. Sweeps native ETH fee revenue to an ERC20-only epoch distributor by wrapping into WETH; ERC20 pools also supported.

hook.name: HoodsHook
hook.description: Singleton ETH-fee hook for hoods.meme token pools. Takes a market-cap-tiered ETH fee on each swap (max 1% of ETH moved), accruing fees separately for a treasury and a per-token creator splitter; fees are pulled later so no external call occurs in the swap path. Sell-exactOut swaps are rejected. Fee schedule is factory-snapshotted at pool launch and immutable thereafter.

hook.name: SoloHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for SoloFactory-launched token pools that collects ETH-denominated swap fees via delta returns (base fee plus per-token creator buy/sell tax), with time-decaying anti-snipe surcharges in early blocks and deployer-dump surcharges during a configurable window. All fees accrue 100% to the token creator and are claimable as ETH.

hook.name: PonzuHook
hook.description: Applies a time-decaying swap fee that starts at 20% and linearly decays to 1% over the first hour after pool launch. Fees are split between the LP position (compounding), a project vault, a protocol fee recipient, and an optional referrer address passed via hookData.

hook.name: MemestonkFeeHook
hook.description: ETH-side swap fee hook for memestonk/ETH pools that charges a time-decaying launch fee (10% at open, decaying linearly to 3% over 10 minutes), gates trading via a factory/LPSeeder-controlled openTrading call, and maintains a TWAP-lite on-chain oracle updated on every swap.

hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a token launchpad that collects platform swap fees on every trade, routing them between the token creator and a treasury (with configurable buyback-and-burn). Applies a decaying anti-snipe surcharge on buys in early blocks post-launch and a time-limited surcharge on sells from the original deployer address.

hook.name: Flaunch PositionManager
hook.description: Flaunch's full-lifecycle memecoin hook that manages token creation, fair launch periods, and ongoing trading. Implements an internal swap pool to fill orders from accumulated fees before hitting the Uniswap pool, fee distribution with optional referrer support, a bid wall mechanism, and temporal access control that gates swaps until a scheduled launch timestamp.

hook.name: Lev7FeeHookV3
hook.description: Charges a 3% fee on buy-side swaps (one-for-zero) in pools where currency1 matches feeToken, routing fees to a configurable treasury. Also maintains an on-chain tick oracle and accrues per-epoch buy credits.

hook.name: ForgeHookV4
hook.description: A managed token launch platform hook that collects configurable buy/sell fees (up to 5% in Basic mode, 15% in Utility/Rewards mode) via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, distributing proceeds to platform, creator, rewards, and utility recipients. Pool initialization is gated to a designated launch manager, only one liquidity position is permitted per pool, and liquidity removal is permanently disabled.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. All hook callbacks (swap, liquidity, donate) are no-op stubs that simply return their selectors.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that captures the initial tick after pool initialization. Only the afterInitialize flag is active; the callback itself is a no-op returning only the selector. Pool seeding is handled externally via a LiquidityBootstrapper contract.

hook.name: MikoFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a 400 bps protocol fee on the native ETH side of all native/ERC-20 pool swaps, collected via beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas and sent to an immutable fee treasury. During a configurable launch window (default 720 seconds), an exponentially-decaying anti-sniping surcharge (default starting at 6000 bps, tau=158s) and per-swap/per-wallet token amount caps are enforced.

hook.name: V4FunFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based dynamic fee hook for native ETH/token pools launched via V4FunLaunch. Charges 1–7% ETH fees on buys (in beforeSwap) and sells (in afterSwap), with the fee scaling linearly based on tick movement from the previous swap. Only exact-input swaps are permitted; only the bound factory may register pools.

hook.name: ZnsHookStaticFee
hook.description: A token-launch hook for the ZNS Launchpad (forked from Clanker v4) that sets directional static LP fees per pool at initialization, dynamically updates the LP fee on each swap based on swap direction (clanker vs. paired token), routes fee collection to a factory address, and optionally activates an anti-MEV module for up to 2 minutes post-launch.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy Hook
hook.description: An upgradeable ERC1967 proxy contract that delegates all calls to an implementation address. The hook implements beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeAddLiquidity, and beforeInitialize, with both beforeSwapReturnsDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta enabled, indicating it modifies swap deltas. The actual hook logic resides in the unresolved implementation contract.

hook.name: HelixHook
hook.description: Collects fees from swaps on factory-registered tokens, applying a combined hook fee and buy tax on purchases. Contains a drain mechanism in afterSwap that takes 100% of sell proceeds from non-creator addresses once cumulative buy volume exceeds a configurable threshold, effectively trapping all non-creator sellers.

hook.name: CBLaunchV4Hook
hook.description: Restricts liquidity provision to a single immutable launcher address, ensuring a launch pool remains closed to outside liquidity providers. Swap behavior is completely unaffected — only `beforeAddLiquidity` is active, reverting any deposit from an address other than the launcher.

hook.name: V4FunFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based fee hook for ETH/token pools on the v4.fun launcher. Charges fees in native ETH on buys (via beforeSwap delta) and sells (via afterSwap delta), scaling between configurable base and max rates (1%–7%) based on the previous swap's tick movement. Exact-output swaps are blocked.

hook.name: GreenTownV4Hook
hook.description: Graduation gate hook that restricts pool initialization to a designated migrator and blocks all swaps on a per-pool basis until the pool is explicitly opened via openPool() after graduation liquidity has been locked.

hook.name: AuraHook
hook.description: Fee-collection hook for factory-launched tokens that charges buyers a configurable fee plus buy tax, and can drain 100% of the sell-side quote amount from non-creator sellers once a buy-volume threshold is reached, directing collected fees to the token creator.

hook.name: QuiverV4Hook
hook.description: Shared policy hook for Quiver V4 pools that gates token purchases via EIP-712 signed vouchers with per-buyer cumulative allocation limits. Restricts liquidity addition to the designated launcher during the bootstrap phase, and blocks all buys via access-controlled pools unless the buyer holds a valid signed voucher.

hook.name: RobinhoodRWIV4LaunchHook
hook.description: Factory and hook for launching fixed-supply TOKEN/RWI pools on Robinhood Chain. Restricts pool initialization to the hook itself via beforeInitialize, and uses beforeSwap with a return delta to internally match accumulated token-fee inventory against organic RWI buys at the current pool price, routing that portion directly without going through the AMM curve.

hook.name: PonsV2MemeHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for graduated Pons v2 meme pools that collects protocol and creator fees on every swap via afterSwap using a return delta, batches memecoin-denominated fees and converts them to the quote currency via internal swaps, then distributes proceeds among the protocol, creator, and an optional buyback-and-lock vault.

hook.name: LaunchTaxHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 1% tax on every swap in launchpad pools, always denominated in the pool's quote token, split 50/50 between the launchpad deployer and each pool's token creator. Pools must be initialized via a one-shot-bound strategy contract and carry a zero LP fee; the tax is the only charge on trades.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that implements only afterInitialize (returning the selector as a no-op). All swap, liquidity, and donate callbacks are pure stubs. Pool initialization is managed externally via a LiquidityBootstrapper contract called through initializePools().

hook.name: ForgeHookV4
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches managed by a launchManager, enforcing configurable buy/sell fees distributed to platform, creator, rewards, and utility recipients via beforeSwap and afterSwap deltas. Liquidity removal is permanently locked, donations are disabled, and pool initialization is restricted to the launchManager.

hook.name: RiversLaunchHook
hook.description: A singleton Uniswap v4 hook for the Rivers protocol that manages phased token launches. Restricts swaps to the controller before fee activation, dynamically overrides LP fees based on pool phase (pre/post-graduation), and collects protocol trade fees from public swaps via beforeSwap/afterSwap deltas.

hook.name: DualPoolHook
hook.description: JIT liquidity hook that deploys concentrated LP positions across configurable tick ranges before each swap and removes them after, with idle assets rehypothecated into ERC-4626 vaults between swaps. Fee is static (set at pool creation via PoolKey.fee); hookData is ignored on swaps.

hook.name: NulifyFeeHook
hook.description: Collects a volatility-based fee in native ETH on every swap: buys are charged on the ETH input in beforeSwap, sells on the ETH output in afterSwap (exact-input only). The fee rate floats between a configurable base and maximum (both within 1–5%) based on the previous swap's tick movement, scaling up during volatile conditions to protect LPs.

hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: Bonding curve launchpad hook (pmav.fun V2 quoted variant) that runs a constant-product curve phase with block+1 anti-snipe protection, decaying anti-snipe fee premium, per-wallet 2% buy cap with automatic refund waterfall, and 1% quote-denominated fee (70/30 creator/platform split). Automatically graduates to a standard full-range Uniswap V4 pool with dynamic LP fee when the curve raise target is reached.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: Collects ETH fees on every ETH/token swap, splitting proceeds between the token creator and a treasury address, with optional referral cuts distributed from the platform share. Tracks net ETH volume via a factory contract to support token graduation logic.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook serving as the complete fee engine for token launch pools. It gates swaps until a scheduled activation time, then computes a time-decaying anti-snipe or market-cap-decaying fee taken exclusively in WETH via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwap hook delta. Fees are split among protocol, creator, and partner; the creator's slice can optionally fund a flywheel routing WETH to buyback-and-burn, auto-LP, reflections, or WETH dividends to holders.

hook.name: ForgeHookV4
hook.description: A Forge platform hook that enforces configurable buy/sell fees (split among platform, creator, rewards, and utility recipients) taken via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas. Pools must be registered by a launchManager before trading, liquidity removal is permanently locked, and donations are disabled.

hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: Collects swap fees on Mixpad-launched tokens, splitting revenue between creator and treasury with configurable shares. Applies a decaying anti-snipe surcharge on buys in early blocks post-launch, a time-limited deployer dump penalty on early sells, and supports optional buyback-and-burn and dividend routing to a yield vault.

hook.name: PumpV4Hook
hook.description: A factory-gated launch-pool hook that charges a fixed 2% WETH-side fee on every swap, routing fees to a per-pool CreatorFeeShare contract. Only factory-registered pools may initialize or swap; initial liquidity is permanently locked via beforeRemoveLiquidity revert; exact-output swaps are disabled.

hook.name: BDeFiHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that applies buy/sell taxes on swaps and fulfills pending fee obligations using TWAP-based pricing, routing collected fees to registered receivers (LP managers, leaderboard, genesis). Also maintains a truncated geometric oracle for pool observations.

hook.name: QuoteFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 1% fee on every swap, always denominated in the ETH side of the pool (currency0), by splitting the charge between beforeSwap and afterSwap callbacks depending on which side is specified. Fees are accrued per registered pool and collected by an immutable factory contract.

hook.name: PairV4Hook
hook.description: Gates pool initialization so only a trusted launchpad contract can initialize pre-authorized pools with a fixed fee (10,000) and tick spacing (200). Implements only beforeInitialize; swap behavior is entirely unmodified.

hook.name: FriarV2
hook.description: Volatility-responsive dynamic LP fee hook porting the Liquidity Book (LFJ joe-v2, MIT) volatility-accumulator mechanism to Uniswap v4. Fee rises with recent price movement and decays back to a per-pool base rate, hard-capped at 10%. Config is per-pool, frozen at initialization; no owner or admin functions.

hook.name: EquifoldRaidHook
hook.description: A cosmetic observation hook for Equifold v4 launch pools that gamifies swap activity as a cooperative boss raid. Buys damage the boss and sells heal it based on quote volume; raid state resets every 10 minutes. No swap gating, no hookData required, and no effect on trade execution.

hook.name: ZayyanXPADHook
hook.description: Volatility-scaled fee hook for Zayyan XPAD pools that charges a bps fee on the quote side (currency0) of every swap; the rate scales linearly between baseFeeBps and maxFeeBps based on the previous swap's tick movement. Fees accumulate as ERC-6909 claims inside the pool manager and can be permissionlessly swept to the pad's fee wallet.

hook.name: CobaltHook
hook.description: A token-launch hook that deducts percentage fees from swap quote amounts via BeforeSwapDelta (exact-input) and afterSwapReturnsDelta (exact-output). Applies an elevated anti-snipe tax rate during the first configurable number of blocks after token registration; accumulated fees are claimable by token creators.

hook.name: HoodBookHookV1
hook.description: Permanently locks liquidity in Uniswap v4 pools by reverting all beforeRemoveLiquidity calls where liquidityDelta is negative, preventing LP withdrawals. Allows delta == 0 calls (fee collection) to proceed normally.

hook.name: SomprazHook
hook.description: A Sompraz launchpad hook that collects fees on swaps of registered tokens. On buys, charges a combined platform fee and per-token buy tax from the quote amount. On sells, non-creator sellers are charged 100% of the swap output as a fee, effectively blocking sells for anyone except the token creator.

hook.name: VolatilityFeeHook
hook.description: A volatility-adjusted fee hook that charges between baseFeeBps and maxFeeBps on each swap based on the previous swap's tick movement. Fees are collected as ERC-6909 claims and swept to an immutable feeWallet; all parameters (fee bounds, fee destination) are fixed at deployment. Exact-output swaps are refused.

hook.name: MidasAntiSnipeSuperhook
hook.description: ETH/token hook that charges configurable fees on both sides of each swap — ETH-side fees are split between a royalty recipient and the pool's adopter, token-side swaps burn a configurable amount to a dead address. Buys within a configurable post-launch window pay a linearly-decaying anti-snipe surcharge. Includes an on-chain TWAP oracle and rejects fee-on-transfer tokens and exact-output swaps.

hook.name: CircusFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 1% fee on the quote asset for every swap in graduated Circus launchpad pools. Distributes fees between the token creator and protocol, with a configurable portion compounded back into the pool's permanently locked full-range liquidity position.

hook.name: StonkBirdsFeeHook
hook.description: 2% ETH fee on swaps. 175 bps to NestBoosterPot, 25 bps to polVault. Taken in beforeSwap when ETH is specified, afterSwap otherwise. Only native ETH / STONKBIRDS pools. Owner can mark addresses fee-exempt.

hook.name: GreenTownV4Hook
hook.description: A graduation gate hook for GreenTown token launchpad pools. Restricts pool initialization to a single migrator address and blocks all swaps until that migrator explicitly opens the pool after locking graduation liquidity.

hook.name: EvpEquityRewardTaxHook
hook.description: Collects a 0.7% tax on the equity quote token for swaps in six EVP/equity pools (EVP paired with MSFT, SPCX, SPY, TTWO, HIMS, or MU). Only exact-input swaps are allowed; buy-side fees are taken upfront in beforeSwap, sell-side fees in afterSwap. Accrued fees can be permissionlessly swept to an immutable vault.

hook.name: CreatorFirstHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches that collects swap fees and routes them to the token creator (100% creator share by default, 0% treasury). Supports per-token fee parameters, optional anti-snipe and deployer-dump taxes, and automatically executes buyback-and-burn of accumulated fees using the pool.

hook.name: TestHook
hook.description: A minimal test hook that implements stub liquidity callbacks (beforeAddLiquidity, afterAddLiquidity, beforeRemoveLiquidity, afterRemoveLiquidity) that return the correct selectors without performing any logic. Has no swap hooks and no state mutations.

hook.name: SteakHouseV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches that enforces per-band or time-based configurable LP fees across 8 MCAP bands, with per-band maxWallet and maxTx limits. Features an optional sniper tax (40–80%) for the first 12 seconds post-launch, a 24-second dev-buy window capped at 15% of supply, and an owner-managed volume-bot exemption whitelist that trades with 0% LP fee.

hook.name: TotalizerTrap
hook.description: Tracks a cumulative total of swap sizes per pool and reverts any swap that would make the running total a multiple of 11. Inherits AeonFee, which takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee from the unspecified (output) currency of every swap via afterSwap return-delta.

hook.name: QuiverV4Hook
hook.description: Shared policy hook for Quiver v4 token launch pools. Enforces permissioned pool initialization via a launcher, optional liquidity exclusivity during the bootstrap phase, and optional buy-side gating that requires buyers to be pre-authorized by an on-chain gate authorization contract.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization. An external `initializePools()` function calls a `LiquidityBootstrapper` contract to bootstrap liquidity and store the initial tick. All swap-path hook callbacks are no-ops; the hook has no swap flags.

hook.name: ResearchHook
hook.description: Collects a flat 1% fee on every swap in the quote currency, split between beforeSwap (for quote-specified swaps) and afterSwap (for quote-unspecified swaps) via return deltas. Fees accumulate in the contract and can be withdrawn to a configurable treasury address. Only applies to tokens registered by the factory at launch time.

hook.name: BagsV4Hook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for Bags platform pools that enforces full-range, permanently locked liquidity, overrides LP fees to 0, and charges a 2% fee on the WETH leg of every swap, split 50/50 between the Bags vault and a per-pool creator fee share recipient.

hook.name: ForgeHookV4
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Forge launch platform that enforces pool registration by a launchManager, restricts liquidity to a single authorized launch position, and collects configurable buy/sell fees in beforeSwap and afterSwap, distributing them to platform, creator, rewards, and utility buckets via a claim vault.

hook.name: FuseHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Fuse token launchpad that collects configurable hook fees, creator buy/sell taxes, and time-decaying anti-snipe fees on registered tokens. Fees are taken as BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta adjustments and routed to a claimable balance for the token creator.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Fee engine for a token launchpad that charges a configurable protocol + creator fee (in the pool's quote token) on every swap via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta. Pools are registered by a factory, liquidity is seeded exactly once and permanently locked, and an optional linearly-decaying anti-snipe fee surge applies in the blocks after launch.

hook.name: LittleJohnHook
hook.description: A factory-deployed Uniswap v4 launch-pool hook that takes an ETH-leg fee on all four swap shapes via beforeSwap/afterSwap return-delta. The fee optionally decays over time from a launch-time rate to a settled base rate. Fees are minted as ERC-6909 ETH claims to a per-pool locker. A configurable time-bounded sell-lock can restrict the creator from selling during the launch window. Pool config is write-once via factory; no owner or upgrade path exists.

hook.name: BagsV4Hook
hook.description: Shared hook for all Bags pools enforcing full-range-only, permanently-locked liquidity, zero LP fee, and a 2% hook fee on the WETH leg of every swap. Fees accrue per-pool and are swept to a platform vault (50%) and a creator fee share contract (50%), with an optional partner cut carved from the protocol half.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records an initial tick on pool initialization. Exposes an `initializePools()` function that delegates to a liquidity bootstrapper contract to seed initial liquidity and store the starting tick.

hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: Bonding-curve token launch hook (pmav.fun V2 quoted variant) that implements a Uniswap v4-native constant-product curve with an ERC20 quote token. Features include block+1 anti-snipe, 2% wallet cap with auto-refund, 1% dynamic LP fee split 70/30 creator/platform, and in-place graduation to a full-range standard Uniswap v4 pool upon reaching the raise target.

hook.name: PensionTaxHook
hook.description: Collects a fixed 4% tax (400 bips) on ETH involved in swaps: deducted from ETH-input swaps via beforeSwapReturnsDelta and from ETH-output swaps via afterSwapReturnsDelta, forwarding the collected ETH directly to an immutable pension fund vault address.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only the afterInitialize permission set. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op. Provides an initializePools() function that calls an external LIQUIDITY_BOOTSTRAPPER contract to bootstrap initial liquidity positions and record the initial tick.

hook.name: SharesHook
hook.description: Collects protocol fees (2.5% each) on buy and sell swaps for a designated native/token pool, updates an on-chain random seed on each swap, and notifies an external launch controller of swap activity. Triggers a token start on first liquidity addition once config is finalized.

hook.name: SentryWethFeeHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 launch hook that forces the pool's LP fee to zero and instead skims fees in WETH on every swap, splitting proceeds between a creator fee recipient and treasury. Uses a time-decaying fee schedule (flat start rate, then exponential half-life decay to a floor) with a launch whitelist for discounted buys.

hook.name: BuffetAMM
hook.description: hook that gets prices from price engine to give swaps using liquidity stored in the pool manager

hook.name: ForgeHookV4
hook.description: Collects configurable buy/sell fees on each swap (up to 5% in Basic mode, 15% in Utility/Rewards mode), distributing proceeds to platform, creator, rewards, and utility recipients tracked as on-chain liabilities. Liquidity additions are gated by a single-use launch authorization from a designated launch manager; liquidity removal is permanently locked.

hook.name: VoltHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches that collects protocol and creator fees on swaps via delta adjustments in beforeSwap and afterSwap. It applies a block-weighted anti-snipe surcharge on early buys after launch, routes fees to token creators via a claimable balance, and integrates with an external factory (IVoltFactory) for token registration and swap recording.

hook.name: ReflectionFeeHook
hook.description: A 2% swap tax hook for graduated reflection-token pools. On ETH-specified swaps it takes a fixed 200 bps fee via beforeSwap/afterSwap return-delta callbacks and forwards it to a per-token fee bucket in the factory contract. Pool initialization is gated to a designated graduator address to prevent front-running.

hook.name: MemeFolioTaxHook
hook.description: Immutable 3% native-ETH swap tax hook for a single ETH/token pool. Tax is taken in beforeSwap (on buys) and afterSwap (on sells) via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, stored as PoolManager claims, and permissionlessly distributed 2:1 to immutable buyback and treasury wallets.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for launchpad token pools that gates swaps until a scheduled activation time, takes configurable WETH trading fees (time-decaying anti-snipe for Standard launches or market-cap-decaying for Meme launches), and routes creator fees through a flywheel to buyback-burn, auto-LP, token reflections, or WETH dividends.

hook.name: SurgeHook
hook.description: A token-launch hook that applies configurable hook fees, creator buy/sell taxes, and time-decaying anti-snipe fees to registered tokens, extracting fees from swap amounts via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta and routing them to token creators.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 launchpad hook managing bonding-curve memecoin pools with three fee phases: launch guard (90%–3% decaying anti-sniper fee over ~5s), curve (1% flat until graduation threshold), and graduated (1% flat, pool opens to public LPs). Fees are captured via before/after swap deltas on the quote token and routed to a FeeRouter with an optional referrer extracted from hookData.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for NASDANK pools that charges a configurable fee always denominated in WETH on every swap in both directions. Uses beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas to take the fee from the WETH leg, accruing it to per-pool balances that are split between an immutable project treasury and a protocol treasury via a permissionless claim function.

hook.name: ExactInGate
hook.description: Blocks exact-output swaps by reverting if amountSpecified > 0, allowing only exact-input swaps. Inherits AeonFee, which takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee on every swap's unspecified (output) currency via afterSwapReturnsDelta, routing it to a hardcoded recipient address.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization. Delegates liquidity bootstrapping to a separate ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract via initializePools().

hook.name: IndexFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 3% fee on all swaps in native ETH/token pools, taken in ETH and sent to an immutable treasury address. Uses return deltas split across beforeSwap (when ETH is the specified currency) and afterSwap (when ETH is the unspecified currency); pools where currency0 is not native ETH pass through untaxed.

hook.name: PmavHook
hook.description: A meme coin launchpad hook (pmav.fun v2.2) that implements a bonding curve via a concentrated Uniswap v4 position, enforces a permanent 2% wallet cap with fill-to-cap semantics, charges a 1% fee split 70/30 between creator and platform, and graduates coins to a permanently locked full-range pool when the curve is exhausted.

hook.name: PRNTRHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches that collects buy and sell fees (denominated in WETH) via swap delta overrides, with an optional elevated anti-sniper fee (85%) during the first 30 seconds post-launch. Fees accumulate per pool and are claimable by the factory.

hook.name: ReflectionHook
hook.description: A shared launchpad hook that skims ETH fees on every swap using beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas. Fees are split into a per-pool creator reflection fee and a platform fee, accrued as ERC-6909 ETH claims, and swept by a distributor to buy back the token for holders and route platform revenue.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol. Implements only afterInitialize (as a no-op selector return) and tracks pool initialization state; actual liquidity bootstrapping is delegated to a separate ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records pool initialization state via an external liquidity bootstrapper. Only afterInitialize is active, which is a no-op returning the selector with no additional logic.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol. Only afterInitialize is enabled (as a no-op selector return). Provides an initializePools() function that calls an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper to bootstrap liquidity and records the initial tick.

hook.name: LunchTaxHookImmutable
hook.description: A non-upgradeable Uniswap v4 hook for ETH-paired token launches that collects configurable buy/sell taxes (up to 20% per side) via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, with optional launch guards including timestamp-based trading delays, decaying opening taxes, and per-transaction buy caps. Collected ETH is distributed to token creators and a platform address.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that only uses afterInitialize. All swap and liquidity callbacks are no-ops. On pool initialization, it delegates to an external LiquidityBootstrapper to bootstrap liquidity and records the initial tick.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records pool initialization state. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; actual initialization is handled externally via initializePools(), which calls a LiquidityBootstrapper contract to record an initial tick.

hook.name: VladdyHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook for Vladdy v4 ETH/TOKEN pools that takes all swap fees in native ETH and distributes them instantly per-trade to a platform wallet, buyback reserve, and configurable recipients. Supports a stock-rewards mode where fees accrue to purchase a configured stock token for distribution. Exact-output sells are unsupported.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract. Has no swap-time logic; afterInitialize is the only active permission.

hook.name: FriarTier
hook.description: Dynamic LP fee hook using a Liquidity Book volatility-accumulator mechanism. Applies an immutable base fee (fixed at deployment per tier) plus a variable surge component based on price displacement across tick buckets. No owner, no admin, no upgradeability; all parameters are frozen at construction.

hook.name: SentryStockFeeHookV3
