hook.description: Launch hook with a time-decaying dynamic fee (high start → floor) that skims fees from swaps and splits them among creator, treasury, holder reflections (via dividend token notifyReward), and auto-compounding locked full-range LP. A pre-reflection delay window redirects the reflection share to creator/treasury; whitelisted launch wallets pay the floor fee rate.

hook.name: SnipeGuardHook
hook.description: Applies a punitive dynamic swap fee at pool launch that decays linearly from 50% to 1% over 180 seconds, discouraging sniper bots from buying in the first blocks after a pool is created.

hook.name: PeepsV4TaxHook
hook.description: A tax-on-swap hook for Peeps V4 token launches that skims configurable buy/sell taxes via BeforeSwapDelta, then distributes collected amounts across funds, burn, dividend, and liquidity sinks in afterSwap. Enforces an optional anti-farmer window blocking third-party LP additions, and gates all swaps via a registry-controlled clearing window.

hook.name: V4GasDetectHook
hook.description: A honeypot hook that blocks real sell transactions by checking gasleft(): buys always succeed, sells are allowed only when gas remaining exceeds 30M (typical of simulations/eth_call), and revert on real user transactions with normal gas. Users who buy tokens cannot sell them.

hook.name: DTFFeeHook
hook.description: Swap-tax hook that skims a configurable buy/sell fee (always denominated in a fixed fee token) off every swap and forwards it directly to a treasury. Features a time-decaying launch tax (starting up to 90%, decaying linearly to the baseline fee over an immutable window) as an anti-sniper measure, with permanent exemptions for the protocol router and launcher. Fee rate and treasury are admin-adjustable via OpenZeppelin AccessManager.

hook.name: RallyHook
hook.description: A bonding-curve token launch hook that runs a virtual constant-product curve during the CURVE phase, serving all swaps from hook inventory against virtual reserves. On graduation it atomically seeds a permanent full-range CLMM position and switches to collecting a post-graduation protocol fee split across configurable recipients, with optional referral tracking via hookData.

hook.name: V4GasDetectHook
hook.description: A hook that gates oneForZero swaps on gasleft(), reverting if remaining gas is at or below 30,000,000; zeroForOne swaps are always permitted unconditionally.

hook.name: RobinhoodArenaFeeHook
hook.description: A post-swap hook for Robinhood Arena launch pools that collects a configurable fee from the output token of each swap and distributes it to multiple recipients via an external ArenaFeeHelper contract. Pool initialization is restricted to owner-authorized deployer addresses.

hook.name: Zhao8Hook
hook.description: Takes a configurable creator fee (up to 10% at deploy time, plus an optional sniper premium from a registry) from the output currency of every swap using the afterSwap-returns-delta pattern, routing 80% to the token creator and 20% to the protocol owner via a fee locker contract.

hook.name: MomoHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Momo token launch platform that collects protocol fees on swaps in registered token pools. It applies a configurable base fee (default 1%) and a higher anti-snipe tax (default 7%) on buys within the first 30 blocks after a token's launch, with collected fees claimable by the token creator.

hook.name: CreatorFeeHook
hook.description: A launchpad fee hook that takes a fixed percentage of each swap's output (TOTAL_FEE_BPS), splitting it 70/30 between the token creator and the protocol treasury via a shared fee engine. Pools must be WETH pairs and can only be created by the authorized factory. Also supports multi-token LP rewards via a juice mechanism using V4-style fee-growth accounting.

hook.name: StockFeeHookImmutable
hook.description: Fee hook for stock-paired (TOKEN/<stock>) Uniswap v4 launch pools. Charges a fixed fee on the stock/quote leg across all four swap directions, accumulating as ERC-6909 claims. A permissionless claimFees() converts accrued stock fees to WETH via Uniswap V3 (TWAP-guarded slippage floor) and distributes as native ETH across a fixed 4-way split: dev, treasury, buyback, and token mechanism.

hook.name: BoobHook
hook.description: A launch-pad fee hook that collects a configurable basis-point fee on quote-token amounts for registered token swaps. Applies a higher anti-snipe tax on buys within the first configurable number of blocks after token launch. Collected fees accrue to the token creator and are claimable via `claimFees`.

hook.name: WickHook
hook.description: Single-pool hook with a 0% LP fee that captures a 4% hook fee on each swap (2.25% pot, 0.75% team, 1% staking distributor). Includes a launch guard that restricts buy-side swaps to allowlisted senders until disabled by the owner.

hook.name: QuoteAssetCreatorFeeHookV1
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for token/quote-asset pools that charges a fixed 1% fee on every swap, denominated in the quote asset. Fees are split 0.9% to the token creator's reward vault and 0.1% to a launcher fee recipient, implemented via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta returns. Pools must be registered by the token creator before swaps are permitted.

hook.name: PNGStrategy Hook
hook.description: Applies configurable buy and sell fees on ETH↔strategy-token swaps by intercepting them via BeforeSwapDelta (buy) and AfterSwapDelta (sell), taking fees in ETH via poolManager.take(). Collected fees are split among a strategy contract, an owner recipient, and a holder rewards recipient according to configurable BPS ratios; pool initialization and liquidity addition are restricted to the strategy contract.

hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: A Clanker protocol hook that sets separate static LP fees for buying vs. selling the clanker token, applying them dynamically via updateDynamicLPFee on each swap. Collects protocol fees via delta manipulation in both beforeSwap and afterSwap, supports optional MEV protection modules (active for up to 2 minutes post-launch), and triggers LP locker fee claims on every swap.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records pool initialization state and delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract via initializePools(). Implements no swap-related logic.

hook.name: RuneMarketHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that gates pool initialization to authorized addresses, enforces per-pool pause controls settable by an OPERATOR_ROLE admin, collects a configurable percentage fee on swaps via afterSwapReturnsDelta, and notifies an IOrderManager of tick movements after each swap to settle limit orders.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that records the initial tick after pool initialization via a liquidity bootstrapper. All swap and liquidity callbacks are pure no-ops; the hook's only active logic is the afterInitialize flag and a separate initializePools() entry point.

hook.name: LaunchpadV4Hook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook that charges a fixed 1% base fee plus an optional creator tax (up to 10%) denominated in the payment token side of each swap. Fee proceeds are split between an immutable protocol recipient and a per-pool creator fee recipient via PoolManager token credits. Pool registration is gated to a factory address and liquidity additions are restricted to a position manager.

hook.name: HookedHook
hook.description: A shared fee-collection hook for MainToken/USDG and MainToken/ETH listings that charges configurable buy/sell fees (in basis points) in afterSwap via delta returns, distributing proceeds between a fee collector and an ops wallet. Supports multiple listings, fee-exempt addresses, and rejects exact-output swaps.

hook.name: KlikHook
hook.description: A fee-taking hook for klik.finance that charges market-cap-tiered fees (0.10%–1.00%) on token swaps, split between a platform treasury and the token creator. Fees are minted as ERC-6909 claims to support single-sided launch pools and flushed on subsequent swaps. Includes launch-block locking and per-origin anti-snipe buy caps in USD for the first few blocks after pool deployment.

hook.name: AgenEngineHook
hook.description: A shared programmable-fee Uniswap v4 hook that reads per-market rules on every swap, applies a configurable fee (optionally tiered by trade size and direction, in either token), overrides the pool LP fee to zero, and routes collected fees to market-specific vaults via ERC-6909 claims.

hook.name: Lev7FeeHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 3% buy fee in feeToken, sent to a treasury. Exact-in buys are charged in beforeSwap via BeforeSwapDelta; exact-out buys are charged in afterSwap via AfterSwapDelta. Also maintains an on-chain tick oracle for fee pools with a configurable observation interval.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that restricts pool initialization to a single designated launchpad address, preventing front-running of pool creation for token launches. It is not in the swap path and runs only once per pool, at initialization.

hook.name: VoltHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Volt launchpad that collects a flat 1% swap fee on registered tokens and routes it entirely to the token's founder via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta adjustments. Founders accumulate earnings on-chain and withdraw via claimEarnings().

hook.name: GemHook
hook.description: A launch-platform hook for the Gem Factory that collects configurable protocol fees and per-token creator taxes on swaps through registered token/quote pairs. Fees are taken from the quote-token amount in beforeSwap or afterSwap and distributed to token creators as claimable balances.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for token launches that gates pool creation to a factory, blocks all third-party liquidity adds/removes, and charges configurable fees on the quote currency with a time-decaying anti-snipe surcharge split among creator, platform, and optional referrer.

hook.name: AMT-1 Canonical Market Hook
hook.description:
Immutable custom-accounting Uniswap v4 hook for AMT-1 markets.
Routes exact-input swaps through deterministic mint and burn pricing
without LP liquidity or a secondary pool price.
Github: https://github.com/Amt-Protocol/amt-1/

hook.name: HookedV1
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for MainToken/USDG trading pairs that collects fees via afterSwapReturnsDelta: 10% on buys (6.5% to a rewards collector, 2% to a jackpot, 1.5% to an ops wallet) and 3.5% on sells (2% to jackpot, 1.5% to ops). Liquidity provision is restricted to the owner and a configurable position manager.

hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: Levies a flat 1% protocol fee in native ETH on every swap of a native-ETH/token pool, split 70% to a treasury and 30% to a per-pool creator address registered by a launch factory. Fees are accrued in-contract using PoolManager custom accounting deltas (beforeSwap and afterSwap) and withdrawn separately.

hook.name: ZeroHook
hook.description: A fee-collection hook that charges a configurable BPS fee on the ETH side of every swap in factory-registered token-ETH pools. Fees are taken from the pool manager and routed to a factory contract for distribution to token creators.

hook.name: StonkBrokerHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for ETH/token pools that charges a configurable flat fee (up to 5%) in ETH on every swap. On buys (ETH in), the fee is deducted from the input via beforeSwap delta; on sells (ETH out), from the output via afterSwap delta. Fees are sent directly to a per-pool recipient address during the swap. Only exact-input swaps are permitted.

hook.name: DegenV3Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for DEGEN token launches on Robinhood chain that applies a time-decaying swap fee (up to 79% in the first 30 seconds post-launch, settling to a permanent 1%), split among an operating treasury, a DEGEN buyback vault, and a per-pool creator beneficiary. Fees are accumulated as ERC-6909 claims and can be flushed permissionlessly.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only the afterInitialize flag active (implemented as a no-op). Includes a separate initializePools() function that delegates to an external LiquidityBootstrapper to record the initial tick. Swap behavior is entirely vanilla.

hook.name: Clanker Static Fee Hook (V2)
hook.description: A Clanker v4 hook that applies directional static LP fees: different fee rates for clanker-token vs paired-token swap directions. On each swap, it calls updateDynamicLPFee to enforce the configured static rate for that direction.

hook.name: MultiHookHost
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook with a configurable block-number-based anti-sniper gate that blocks swaps until a set number of blocks after pool launch. In afterSwap, it redirects a configurable fee (platform + creator basis points) from the unspecified swap output into per-currency balances, with an optional buyback-burn that sends an additional token slice to a burn address on buy swaps.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only afterInitialize enabled (no-op). Provides a permissionless initializePools() function that delegates to an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract and records the pool's initial tick.

hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: Collects a platform swap fee on every trade and splits it between the token creator and treasury, with the creator's share further split into a claimable payout and an automatic buyback-and-burn. Applies a decaying anti-snipe surcharge on buys in the first N blocks after launch and a time-limited extra fee on sells from the deployer address.

hook.name: FoundryHookV4R2E2
hook.description: A market-cap-tiered fee hook for launched tokens where buy fees are charged as a dynamic LP fee override and exact-input sell fees are taken by the hook via afterSwapReturnsDelta and accumulated for later release to a locker. Exact-output sells are rejected. Pools must be registered by a factory before fee logic activates.

hook.name: JoltHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Jolt token launchpad that collects protocol and creator fees on swaps via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta. Includes an anti-snipe mechanism that charges elevated fees for early buys within a configurable number of blocks after token launch, with fees routed to token creators and claimable on-demand.

hook.name: StrategyHook
hook.description: A multi-strategy hook for USDG/token pools that enforces owner-gated pool initialization and liquidity management, applies a time-decaying fee curve on swaps (starting high at launch and decaying to a resting rate), and splits collected fees between an ops wallet and a protocol fee collector contract via afterSwapReturnsDelta.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook that charges a fixed WETH fee on every swap in both directions using return-delta accounting. Each pool has an immutable per-pool fee config (feePips, projectTreasury, protocolTreasury) registered once by a permissioned launcher; accrued WETH is distributed via a permissionless claim() function.

hook.name: FeeHook
hook.description: Levies a flat 1% protocol fee in native ETH on every swap of a native-ETH/token pool, using BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapReturnsDelta to take the fee via PoolManager custom accounting. Fees are split between a treasury (10% default, up to 40% max) and a per-pool creator address (minimum 60%), accrued in-contract and withdrawn on demand.

hook.name: PhantomHook
hook.description: A token-launch hook that collects protocol and creator fees on swaps of registered tokens, distributing fees to token creators. Includes block-number-based anti-snipe protection that charges elevated fees during the initial blocks after a token's launch.

hook.name: Doppler
hook.description: Uniswap v4 pool initializer that distributes liquidity across multiple positions using a bonding curve (Multicurve). Supports dynamic LP fees, optional Doppler Hook callbacks on initialization and swaps, and fee collection via afterSwap delta returns.

hook.name: LunchTaxHookPair
hook.description: ERC1967 proxy wrapping a Uniswap v4 hook that applies configurable buy/sell taxes (up to 5% per side) via beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns, accruing fees per pool in the quote token and distributing them to recipients through a pull-based ledger with optional holder-rewards routing.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 launchpad hook that collects a configurable fee (up to 1%) on every swap in registered token pools, splitting proceeds between the token creator, the platform treasury, and up to three referral tiers. Tracks cumulative quote volume per token to signal graduation milestones.

hook.name: VenomHook
hook.description: Collects layered swap fees (protocol fee + creator buy/sell tax + time-decaying anti-snipe surcharge) on tokens registered via a companion Venom factory. Fees are denominated in the quote currency and routed to token creators for on-demand claiming.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy Hook
hook.description: An upgradeable ERC1967 proxy hook with beforeSwap, afterSwap (returning a delta), beforeInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, and beforeRemoveLiquidity permissions. The implementation contract was not resolved, so full logic cannot be verified.

hook.name: PeepsV4TaxHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for meme token launches that skims configurable buy/sell taxes via BeforeSwapDelta, overrides LP fee to 1%, and distributes collected taxes to funds, burn, dividend, and liquidity sinks. Enforces exact-input-only swaps, blocks swaps during a clearing window, and restricts third-party liquidity additions via a time-based anti-farmer lock.

hook.name: RobinoHook
hook.description: Observation hook for Robino graduated pools that emits events on pool initialization, liquidity changes, and swaps. Pool initialization is gated to tokens registered in the Robino factory; afterSwap only records swap data via events without modifying execution.

hook.name: PmavHook
hook.description: Token launchpad hook that runs each coin on a concentrated bonding curve (800M tokens, ETH-paired). Enforces block+1 trading start, first-hour 2% per-wallet cap with auto-refund, decaying anti-snipe fee premium, and 70/30 creator/platform fee split. Graduates to a permanently locked full-range LP in the same pool when the curve sells out.

hook.name: FeeVaultHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for token launch pools that skims a configurable share (10–50%) of each swap fee into a per-pool quote vault. Accumulated fees are distributed to token holders via Merkle-based drops, triggered either when the vault reaches a configured threshold or on a 7-day epoch cadence.

hook.name: DualPoolHook
hook.description: JIT liquidity hook that deploys concentrated LP positions across multiple configurable tick ranges (buckets) before each swap and removes them after, using ERC-4626 vault rehypothecation to earn yield on idle capital between swaps. Pool fee is static (set at deploy time); swaps can be paused per-pool by the owner.

hook.name: LootHookV4
hook.description: Meme token launchpad hook that records oracle price observations, enforces per-origin cumulative buy caps during the first hour after launch, writes transient attestation data for on-chain game credit, dispatches token graduation, and executes an in-swap crank for fee collection and protocol maintenance.

hook.name: SVMHook
hook.description: A gamified trading hook that charges a percentage fee on every ETH swap via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, assigns buyers to competing teams (STOCKS vs MEMES), and distributes the collected pot to the winning team at the end of each round.

hook.name: EdgeHook
hook.description: Fee hook for token launches on the Edge protocol. Charges a decaying anti-dump sell tax (linear decay over a configurable block window) plus configurable hook and creator buy/sell taxes on registered token swaps. All collected fees are routed to token creators via a claimable balance mapping.

hook.name: VladdyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for native ETH/TOKEN pools that captures swap fees (1–5%) entirely in ETH and distributes them instantly per-trade. Supports five fee-distribution modes: direct recipient payouts with optional buyback-and-burn, stock rewards (buys a configured stock token for holders), ETH staking payouts (robin mode), weighted lottery draws, or auto-liquidity provisioning around the current price.

hook.name: MidasGoldHook
hook.description: ERC-20/ERC-20 pool hook that collects a fixed fee always denominated in currency0. For zeroForOne swaps the fee is deducted from the input in beforeSwap; for oneForZero swaps it is deducted from the currency0 output in afterSwap. Only exact-input swaps are supported. The fee rate and recipient are immutable at deployment, and the hook only permits the fixed token pair set at construction.

hook.name: Flaunch PositionManager
hook.description: Flaunch protocol's core hook for memecoin pool launches on Uniswap v4. Implements an Internal Swap Pool that fills swaps from accumulated fee inventory before hitting the AMM, captures and distributes fees to creators, protocol, and a bid wall, records TWAP oracle observations per swap, and optionally routes referrer fees when an address is encoded in hookData.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project with only the afterInitialize flag set. The afterInitialize callback is a no-op; pool liquidity setup is triggered externally via initializePools(), which calls a configurable ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap positions and record the initial tick.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook with oracle-based dynamic fee adjustment, full-range liquidity management, and fee reinvestment. Uses a truncated geometric oracle to track tick movement and adjusts surge fees accordingly. Charges both a declared protocol fee and an undisclosed additional 0.10% surcharge on every swap.

hook.name: StrategyHook
hook.description: A token launchpad hook (pmav.fun V2) that creates coins with 1B fixed supply trading on a concentrated bonding curve. Enforces block+1 anti-snipe, first-hour per-wallet 2% cap with auto-refund, and 2% flat fees split among platform (0.25%), creator (0.25–0.75%), and a dividend treasury. Graduation converts the curve position to a permanently locked full-range LP in the same pool.

hook.name: Rivers LaunchHook
hook.description: A singleton Uniswap v4 hook for Rivers launch pools that manages a phased token launch lifecycle (seeding, bootstrapping, graduation, settlement). Applies dynamic LP fees, collects protocol and creator fees on trades, and restricts swaps and liquidity based on pool phase and controller authorization.

hook.name: HoodlumPadHook
hook.description: Shared Uniswap v4 hook for HoodlumPad V2 memecoin launches. Skims a fixed 1% fee from memecoin swaps (split 50/50 between creator and protocol treasury) as ERC-6909 claim tokens, maintains a self-hosted 200-slot TWAP oracle, and provides a batched fee-conversion mechanism to swap accrued memecoin fees into the quote asset.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable percentage fee on every swap for registered launchpad token pools, splitting proceeds between the token creator and platform treasury, with optional referral rewards distributed via an external registry.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that uses afterInitialize to support pool setup via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. It has no active swap, liquidity modification, or donation hooks.

hook.name: Flaunch PositionManager
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that manages memecoin launches on the Flaunch platform, featuring an internal swap pool for pre-swap fee conversion, temporal gating for scheduled token launches, a BidWall for buy-side liquidity support, and fee distribution to protocol, creators, and optional referrers.

hook.name: PulseHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for a token launchpad that charges a 1% flat protocol fee on swaps involving factory-whitelisted tokens. Fees are extracted via the beforeSwap/afterSwap delta return mechanism and forwarded to a configurable revenue wallet.

hook.name: SentryStockFeeHookV3
hook.description: A launch hook for tokenized stock or WETH pairs that applies a time-decaying dynamic fee, starting at a high launch rate and settling at a 1.7% floor. Fees are split among creator, treasury, holder reflections, and permanently-locked LP compounding; pool initialization is restricted to the factory.

hook.name: Friar
hook.description: A volatility-responsive dynamic LP fee hook that adjusts swap fees using the Liquidity Book volatility-accumulator mechanism, surging fees with recent price movement and decaying back after configured windows. All parameters are immutable with no owner or upgrade mechanism.

hook.name: Friar
hook.description: Volatility-responsive dynamic LP fee hook using the Liquidity Book volatility-accumulator model. Sets per-swap LP fees based on recent price movement — low base fee in calm markets that surges with volatility and decays over configurable windows. No owner, no upgradeability; all parameters are immutable.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the pool's initial tick after initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. The hook has no swap, liquidity, or donate callbacks active; it only holds the afterInitialize flag.

hook.name: FlareHook
hook.description: Fee-collection hook for the Flare token launchpad. Collects protocol fees and creator buy/sell taxes on swaps for registered launched tokens, with a time-decaying anti-snipe surcharge on buys during the first N blocks after launch. Fees are claimable by token creators.

hook.name: RobFeeHook
hook.description: Fixed 2% swap fee on the native-ETH side of the pool, both directions, distributed instantly to four fixed recipients. Fee rate is a constant; only the distribution split is owner-adjustable. Non-upgradeable, no pool-creation or liquidity restrictions

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: LaunchpadHook charges a configurable ETH fee (0.3%–1.5%) on every swap across all four exact-in/exact-out quadrants, taking fees via beforeSwap and afterSwap delta returns. Sells during an optional launch window pay a higher linearly-decaying fee; fees are distributed among the token creator, a land fund, and a treasury.

hook.name: VelvetHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Velvet token launchpad that collects fees on swaps using return deltas. Buy swaps are charged a configurable hook fee plus a per-token buy tax; sell swaps by non-creator addresses have their entire quote output taken as fee, effectively restricting selling to the token creator only.

hook.name: ERC8404FeeHook (Hoodroids)
hook.description:
A Uniswap v4 custom-accounting hook for the Hoodroids/ETH pool.
It collects a quote-currency-only swap fee through beforeSwap/afterSwap
deltas and sends it to an immutable fee collector. The owner may only
reduce the fee; it can never be increased.

hook.name: DirectionalFeeHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable per-direction fee (in basis points, up to 5%) on each swap's unspecified currency via afterSwap, forwarding proceeds to a per-pool vault. Rates are separately configurable for zeroForOne and oneForZero, take effect after a 5-minute delay, and can be suspended globally by the owner via a pause flag without blocking swaps.

hook.name: CoinbarrelAdvancedHookV3
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing custom fee accounting for Coinbarrel Advanced V3 pools. It intercepts swaps to collect configurable buy/sell fees via BeforeSwapDelta (input-side) and afterSwapReturnDelta (output-side), minting fee tokens to itself rather than transferring during swaps, while recording per-pool TWAP and organic volume observations.

hook.name: SlvrHook
hook.description: A hook for the SLVR/ETH pool that taxes exact-input swaps up to 2%: buys pay an ETH fee into a lottery jackpot pot and receive weighted tickets; sells pay a SLVR fee to in-range LP stakers. Optional hookData (address buyer, uint8 boost) enables ticket attribution and boost multipliers. Exact-output and partial fills revert.

hook.name: ZiaFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that enforces keeper-configurable dynamic LP fees (up to 1%) and collects a bounded hook fee (up to 0.25%) in the swap's specified currency, accruing ERC-6909 claims redeemable only to an immutable treasury address.

hook.name: Clanker Dynamic Fee Hook (V2)
hook.description: A dynamic fee hook for Clanker pools that adjusts LP fees based on realized volatility. It simulates each swap to estimate the post-swap tick, computes a volatility accumulator from tick displacement relative to a reference tick, and calls updateDynamicLPFee with a fee that scales quadratically with volatility, bounded by configurable base and max fee parameters.

hook.name: FluxHook
hook.description: FluxHook collects protocol and creator fees on swaps via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, routing them to claimable balances. It applies a configurable anti-snipe fee multiplier during the initial blocks after token launch.

hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: Bonding curve launch hook for the pmav.fun V2 platform (Robinhood Chain) using a quote ERC20 (USDG). Manages a constant-product AMM curve from token launch to graduation: enforces block+1 trading delay, a permanent 2% wallet cap with fill-to-cap refund waterfall, decaying anti-snipe premium on buys, 1% quote-denominated fees, and in-place graduation to a full-range V4 pool with dynamic LP fee.

hook.name: BlazeHook
hook.description: BlazeHook charges configurable buy and sell fees (in basis points) on swaps for tokens registered by the factory. It takes fees as BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta from the quote token, routes them to the token creator, and applies a time-decaying anti-snipe surcharge during the first N blocks after launch.

hook.name: LaunchTaxHook
hook.description: Charges a fixed 1% tax on every swap in strategy-created launchpad pools, denominated in the pool's quote token and split 50/50 between the launchpad deployer and the pool's token creator. Tax is applied via BeforeSwap and AfterSwap return deltas depending on whether the quote is the specified or unspecified currency.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that records the initial pool tick via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. Only the afterInitialize flag is active; all swap and liquidity callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: BallHook
hook.description: A launchpad hook that collects a configurable fee on swaps of registered tokens, routing proceeds to token creators. Applies an elevated snipe tax (default 9%) on buys within the first 28 blocks after token launch, and a standard hook fee (default 1%) otherwise.

hook.name: LaunchFeeHook
hook.description: Applies a time-based anti-snipe fee to pools: 50% flat fee for the first 4 minutes after initialization, then a permanent 3.5% LP fee floor. Fees are immutable — no admin controls or setters exist.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: Collects swap fees split between token creators and a platform treasury, with referral fee distribution, snipe-window protection blocking early buys, and per-transaction buy caps during a configurable fair launch window.

hook.name: CapGate
hook.description: Reverts swaps exceeding a fixed 100-token size cap (MAX_TRADE = 100e18). After each swap, takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee from the output currency and routes it to a hardcoded recipient address via poolManager.take().

hook.name: FlowHookV3
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for USDG-paired pools that taxes buy and sell swaps, routing fees to holder, LP, treasury, buyback/burn, and referral buckets via delta interception. An anti-snipe decay fee is applied to buys shortly after pool launch.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook that records the initial tick after pool initialization, delegating liquidity setup to an external bootstrapper contract. All swap, liquidity, and donate callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: HeavierHand
hook.description: Gates swap direction by virtual reserves: within a 10% skew band, swaps must sell the pool's heavier currency; beyond the cap, the gate inverts and only the rebalancing leg (selling the lighter side) is admitted. Charges a mandatory 10 bps Aeon protocol fee on every swap via afterSwap return delta.

hook.name: CubeHook
hook.description: Collects a configurable fee (in basis points, 1%–10%) on swaps for factory-registered tokens in Cube Family launchpad pools. Fees are taken via BeforeSwapDelta or AfterSwapDelta and forwarded to a factory contract; when the pool manager lacks sufficient balance, fees are parked as ERC-6909 claims and flushed on the next eligible swap.

hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Mixpad launchpad that collects platform swap fees on every trade and splits them between the token creator and treasury. Applies a decaying anti-snipe surcharge on early buys and a time-limited surcharge on deployer sells, and routes a configurable share of creator fees into automatic buyback-and-burn of the launched token.

hook.name: FablesRWA
hook.description: A session-aware dynamic-fee hook for tokenized equity (RWA) pairs. Adjusts LP fees based on US equity market sessions (open/overnight/closed) using a baked NYSE calendar, with linear opening descent spikes and optional closing ramp to price information asymmetry around market open and close events. Operator pokes can temporarily override the autonomous fee within bounded limits.

hook.name: LatchHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Latch token launches that intercepts swaps on registered tokens to collect configurable protocol fees and creator-defined buy/sell taxes (paid in the quote token). Fees are claimable by token creators, and swap volume is reported to the factory for graduation threshold tracking.

hook.name: LegacyLedger
hook.description: On every swap, takes a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee (via AeonFee base) plus an optional 0.05% loyalty tax on the unspecified currency, routing both directly to a fixed treasury address. Swaps that include a 32-byte player address in hookData earn loyalty marks accumulating into a capped tier score.

hook.name: FoundryHookV4Variable
hook.description: Shared fee hook for all Foundry launchpad pools on Robinhood Chain. Applies a market-cap-scaled dynamic LP fee (0.5%–1.5%) split between creator and protocol, with configurable creator payout wallets and a graduation mechanism transitioning pools from bonding curve to post-graduation LP fee mode.

hook.name: GammaHook
hook.description: Implements a dynamic launch-decay anti-snipe fee for Uniswap v4 pools. At pool launch, a high peak fee is charged that decays linearly over a configurable shield window down to a steady-state base fee, with fee overrides applied via beforeSwap.

hook.name: FoundryHookV4
hook.description: Shared fee hook for all Foundry launchpad pools on Robinhood Chain. Applies a market-cap-scaled dynamic LP fee (1.25% below $25k FDV, 1.00% above) pre-graduation, switching to a 0.30% LP fee post-graduation. Fees are split between the pool creator and the protocol treasury via a pull-pattern claim.

hook.name: RobinShareHook
hook.description: A shared hook for RobinShare native ETH/TOKEN pools that takes an immutable ETH-denominated fee (1–5%) on every swap and distributes it instantly per-swap to a platform wallet, a buyback reserve, and configurable recipients. Supports agent-triggered buyback-and-burn via internal fee-exempt swaps.

hook.name: RallyHook
hook.description: A token launch hook that runs a virtual constant-product bonding curve. During the curve phase, the hook serves swaps from its own inventory against virtual reserves; upon reaching the graduation threshold, it atomically seeds a permanent full-range CLMM position and thereafter collects protocol fees on all swaps.

hook.name: WethFeeHookImmutable
hook.description: An immutable Uniswap v4 hook that charges a WETH-denominated fee on every swap using per-token tiers (3%, 5%, or 10%) from a launchpad registry, or a global fallback rate. Accrued fees are held as ERC-6909 claims and distributed via a permissionless distribute() call that splits proceeds between the token creator, treasury, a flagship buyback vault, and the token's on-chain mechanism.

hook.name: ReflectionHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for launchpad token pools that skims a per-pool ETH reflection fee plus a platform fee on every swap. Fees are collected as ERC-6909 ETH claims in beforeSwap (exact-in buys, exact-out sells) and afterSwap (exact-in sells, exact-out buys), then swept by a distributor.

hook.name: UniversalKlikHook
hook.description: A swap fee hook for ETH/token pools that collects a tiered ETH fee (0.10%–1.00% based on token market cap) on each swap, splitting proceeds between a platform treasury and the token's creator address. Fees are waived on the pool's launch block.

hook.name: TaxHook
hook.description: Applies fixed buy (3%) and sell (6%) taxes on every swap via afterSwap, deducting fees from the unspecified output currency and accumulating them as ERC-6909 claims. Tax rates are compile-time constants; fees are forwarded to a treasury address controlled by an owner with a 3-day timelock.

hook.name: DynamicFee
hook.description: Adjusts LP swap fees based on tick movement from the prior swap: larger price moves raise the fee and smaller moves lower it, bounded between 0.05% and 5%. All swaps also pay a mandatory 10 bps protocol fee taken from the output currency and routed to a fixed recipient via afterSwap return-delta.

hook.name: CashCatHookV2
hook.description: Fee engine for CashCat pools that takes a fixed-rate fee from the quote (ETH) side of every swap via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta returns, splitting proceeds between a creator and a platform treasury. Liquidity is permanently locked after a single factory-controlled seed; only the factory may create or seed pools.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Shared launchpad hook for B20 token launches. Gates pool creation to a factory, permanently locks single-sided liquidity, and charges a swap fee on the quote currency split among creator, platform, and an optional referrer. Includes a time-decaying anti-snipe surcharge that blocks exact-output swaps during a configurable launch window after pool creation.

hook.name: LendsProtocolHook
hook.description: Charges an owner-configurable fee (up to 5%) on swaps in explicitly enabled pools, collecting it in the quote currency and distributing it proportionally to up to 10 weighted fee recipients via beforeSwap and afterSwap delta adjustments.

hook.name: JetstreamHook
hook.description: Singleton hook that charges a configurable fee (up to 3%) on the ETH leg of every swap, distributing proceeds between the pool creator, a buyback wallet, and a platform wallet. Liquidity additions are gated until the pool is registered by the factory.

hook.name: FablesRWA
hook.description: Session-aware dynamic-fee hook for tokenized RWA equity pairs that adjusts LP fees based on US market calendar sessions (open, overnight, closed) using block.timestamp, with an opening descent ramp, a closing ramp, and a time-bounded operator fee poke override.

hook.name: CrestHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 launchpad hook that collects protocol fees and creator buy/sell taxes on swaps for registered tokens, with a time-decaying anti-snipe fee that charges elevated rates during early blocks after token launch.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol that records the initial tick after pool initialization. It delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract and has no swap-time logic.

hook.name: Rivers Shared LaunchHook V4
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for Rivers launch pools implementing a phased launchpad lifecycle with band-based bonding curve mechanics. Takes protocol and creator fees on swaps via delta manipulation, dynamically overrides LP fees based on pool phase, and restricts swaps and liquidity to a controller during pre-graduation phases.

hook.name: BuybackBurnHookV1
hook.description: Charges fixed directional buy and sell fees in beforeSwap or afterSwap depending on trade shape, collecting a protocol fee, and spends the remainder buying the pool's own token back on sells and burning it.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Saturn Omnichain hook that enables only afterInitialize (which is a pure no-op). Pool setup is handled externally via initializePools(), which calls a bootstrapper contract to record the initial tick. No logic executes at swap or liquidity time.

hook.name: FlareHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Flare launchpad that charges a flat 1% fee on every swap in pools containing factory-listed tokens. Fees are accumulated in the hook contract and withdrawn to a configurable vault address.

hook.name: PRNTRHook
hook.description: Collects per-swap fees on ETH-in (zeroForOne) and ETH-out (oneForZero) legs using a configurable fee tier (100–500 bps). Applies an 85% anti-sniper fee during the first 30 seconds after pool launch. Accumulated WETH fees are claimable by a registered factory address; the factory itself is exempt from all fees.

hook.name: LootHook
hook.description: Takes a 1.5% ETH fee on all swaps in registered pools and distributes it to token holders (via DividendToken.fundPot), the pool creator, a platform address, and an ops address. Buy-side fees are minted as ERC-6909 ETH claims in beforeSwap and redeemed during the next sell or via a permissionless collect() call.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: A permissionless launchpad game hook that seeds ETH-paired token pools and tracks swaps in afterSwap to run a timed competition: sufficiently large buys defend an escalating floor price, update the leader, and accrue LP fees to a pot awarded to the last qualifying buyer when the idle timer expires.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for NASDANK token pools that charges all swap fees exclusively in WETH on every swap in both directions. Accrued WETH is split between an immutable project treasury and a protocol treasury per pool, with fee configuration set once at pool launch by an authorized launcher contract.

hook.name: TripoolsAntiSnipeHook
hook.description: Shared hook for all Tripools launch factory pools that enforces a 6-second anti-snipe window with a 50% tax on non-whitelisted buys, and applies a dynamic tiered fee schedule on buys and sells, splitting revenue between the protocol treasury and the token creator.

hook.name: RobinhoodMultiPairV4LaunchHook
hook.description: A multi-pair Uniswap v4 launch hook for the Robinhood Chain that atomically initializes and permanently funds up to four trading pairs (RWI, ETH, USDG, PONS) in a single transaction. Uses beforeSwap to match accumulated token-fee inventory against organic buys at the live pool price via a return delta, without moving the pool.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. Only the afterInitialize permission is set; the callback is a no-op returning the selector. Provides an initializePools() function that delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract and records the resulting initial tick.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that activates only on pool initialization (afterInitialize). It delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract and records the initial tick. No swap or liquidity modification logic is active.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Saturn Omnichain that enables only the afterInitialize callback (a no-op returning only the selector) and exposes an initializePools() function that delegates liquidity bootstrapping to a separate contract and records the initial tick. All swap, liquidity, and donate callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: PrinterHook
hook.description: Collects a flat 5% ETH fee on every swap in native-ETH/token pools, routing accrued fees automatically to a token buyback-and-burn leg, a compounding single-sided liquidity band, and a treasury. Supports a one-time decaying anti-snipe buy surcharge in the early launch window.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that uses only the afterInitialize permission (as a no-op selector return) to satisfy hook address validation. Stores pool configuration constants and an initial tick, delegating liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract.

hook.name: MultiHookHost
hook.description: A launchpad hook that redirects a configurable platform and creator fee slice from every swap's unspecified-side output, with optional per-pool anti-sniper temporal gating (blocks swaps before a launch block threshold) and optional buyback-burn (sends a portion of buy-side output tokens to the dead address).

hook.name: ForgeHookV4
hook.description: A token launch hook that gates pool creation to a designated launch manager, enforces configurable buy/sell fees on swaps (up to 5% basic or 15% utility mode), and distributes proceeds across platform, creator, rewards, and utility recipients via ERC-6909 claim tokens minted to a claim vault. Liquidity removal is permanently locked and donations are disabled.

hook.name: CrestHook
hook.description: A fee hook for Crest factory-launched tokens. On buys, applies a combined protocol fee, per-token buy tax, and a time-decaying anti-snipe fee. On sells, non-creator sellers are charged 100% of quote proceeds as a fee routed to the token creator's claimable balance; the token creator may sell without fee.

hook.name: MintFastHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that charges a fixed 2% ETH-side protocol fee on all swaps in launchpad pools (ETH is always currency0). Fees are accrued as ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager and redeemed for real ETH via a launchpad-only collect() function.

hook.name: CashCatGraduationHook
hook.description: Singleton hook for the CashCat launchpad that restricts pool initialization to the launchpad (beforeInitialize) and monitors post-swap prices to set a one-way graduation latch when a launch token's paired-currency principal reaches a configured threshold (afterSwap).

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook that delegates initial liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract via initializePools(). Only the afterInitialize flag is set; all swap and liquidity callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that applies dynamic fee overrides via beforeSwap lpFeeOverride, records tick observations via TruncGeoOracleMulti, and reinvests collected fees via a FullRangeLiquidityManager. On every swap, an additional undisclosed 0.10% fee (AGGRESSIVE_SURGE) is unconditionally extracted from the input amount on top of any disclosed hook fee.

hook.name: MrSuccHook
hook.description: Collects a 2.5% protocol fee on buys and sells in a designated native/token pool, routes fees to a configurable recipient via poolManager.take(), updates an on-chain random seed on each swap, and triggers token launch on first liquidity add.

hook.name: UruLaunchHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 launch hook for the URU token that applies a time-decaying sniper tax (up to 99% at launch, decaying to 0%) on swaps during a configurable window, routing proceeds to a vault. It also tracks URU trading volume per epoch to compute a bounded emission-rate signal.

hook.name: VladdyHook
hook.description: Fee-collecting hook for Vladdy native-ETH/TOKEN pools. Takes all swap fees in ETH (configured 1–5% rate, immutable per pool) and distributes them per-swap to a platform wallet, configured recipients, and/or a buyback-and-burn reserve. Supports an optional stock-rewards mode where the non-platform fee share accrues to a reserve spent buying a stock token deposited into a distributor contract.

hook.name: Ponzuki
hook.description: Time-decaying swap fee that starts at 20% and linearly decays to 1% over the first hour after pool launch. Fees are split between the LP position (compounding), a project vault, a protocol fee recipient, and an optional referrer address passed via hookData.

hook.name: FriarTier
hook.description: Dynamic LP fee hook implementing a Liquidity Book volatility-accumulator surge mechanism on top of an immutable base fee set at deployment. Each deployment represents a distinct, non-configurable fee tier shared by all pools on that hook, with no admin controls, no upgradeability, and no protocol fee.

hook.name: V4GasDetectHook
hook.description: A honeypot hook that allows buys unconditionally but blocks sell transactions in real on-chain execution by checking gasleft() against a 30M gas threshold. Simulations (eth_call, fork sims) have high gasleft() and pass; real user transactions have lower gasleft() and revert, trapping sellers.

hook.name: BaldPadFunFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based ETH fee hook for BaldPadFun launch pools. Charges 1–5% fees in native ETH on exact-input buys (via beforeSwap delta) and sells (via afterSwap delta), with the fee scaling linearly based on the previous swap's tick movement. Fees are sent directly to a per-pool fee recipient on each swap. Exact-output swaps are rejected.

hook.name: Flaunch PositionManager
hook.description: Flaunch's central Uniswap v4 hook that manages meme token launches (flaunches), runs an internal swap pool that fills orders from fee inventory before routing to Uniswap, distributes swap fees to creators, referrers, and protocol, records price observations for a TWAP oracle, and manages a BidWall for liquidity buybacks. New pools are gated by a configurable launch timestamp until trading is enabled.

hook.name: DamperHook
hook.description: A sell-protection hook for newly launched token pools that applies dynamic surge fees and burns a portion of coins sold during a 3-hour post-launch damper window, scaling fees based on recent sell pressure and cumulative price impact. Liquidity mutations and pool initialization are restricted to the authorized launcher.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain protocol with only the afterInitialize flag set; the afterInitialize callback performs no action. A separate initializePools() function delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract and records the initial tick.

hook.name: HoodXLaunchHook
hook.description: An identity hook that gates pool initialization to a single bound factory address; pools created outside the HoodX factory are rejected. Swap and liquidity behavior are unmodified standard Uniswap v4.

hook.name: PonsV2MemeHook
hook.description: Singleton post-graduation hook for Pons V2 meme pools that charges a configurable fee on each swap via afterSwap (using the delta return mechanism), converts any memecoin-denominated fees back to the pool's quote currency through internal swaps, then splits the proceeds among protocol, creator, and buyback-and-lock buckets.

hook.name: NoOp
hook.description: A minimal hook that emits a swap event in beforeSwap and collects a fixed 10 bps protocol fee on every swap's unspecified (output) currency in afterSwap via a return delta, routing fees to a hardcoded recipient address (AEON_FEE_RECIPIENT).

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy Hook
hook.description: An upgradeable ERC1967 proxy hook with beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeSwapReturnsDelta, afterSwapReturnsDelta, beforeInitialize, and beforeAddLiquidity flags enabled. The implementation contract source is not available for analysis; swap logic and access control could not be verified.

hook.name: PonsV2MemeHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook shared by all graduated Pons v2 meme pools. Takes a configurable fee on every swap via afterSwap, converts memecoin-denominated fees to quote currency via internal swaps against the pool's own liquidity, then distributes proceeds among protocol, creator, and a five-year buyback-and-lock vault according to per-pool fee splits frozen at launch.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that enables only the afterInitialize callback, which returns the selector without performing any state changes. A separate initializePools() function delegates to an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract to bootstrap liquidity and records the initial tick in contract storage.

hook.name: MoonFlameBurnTaxHook
hook.description: Burns 5% of FLAME on buys and 10% on sells by intercepting swap deltas: sells are taxed in beforeSwap (reducing input) and buys in afterSwap (reducing output). Burned tokens are taken from the pool manager and destroyed via FLAME.burn(). Only supports exact-input swaps on a single configured FLAME/quote pool.

hook.name: TripoolsAntiSnipeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for Tripools launch pools that enforces a 6-second anti-snipe window (50% tax routed entirely to treasury for non-whitelisted buys) and a dynamic tiered tax schedule for buys and sells, splitting fees between the pool creator and protocol treasury, always settled in ETH.

hook.name: AMT-1 Canonical Market Hook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook that routes all swaps through the AMT-1 token's own mint/burn mechanism, bypassing standard Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity. Blocks all LP liquidity provision; only exact-input swaps are supported.

hook.name: ReflectionHook
hook.description: Charges a per-pool creator reflection fee plus a fixed platform fee, both in native ETH, on native-ETH/token pools. Fees are collected via delta returns in beforeSwap (exact-in buys, exact-out sells) and afterSwap (exact-in sells, exact-out buys), covering all four swap directions without double-charging.

hook.name: FeraHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook implementing regime-specific dynamic LP fees — MEME pools use an EWMA volatility/flow estimator, RWA pools use a Chainlink oracle price-deviation overlay — plus a cumulative-tick TWAP oracle and an economic anti-JIT guard that withholds and linearly decays accrued fees on fast liquidity removal.

hook.name: FlintHook
hook.description: A token launch hook for the Flint platform that collects protocol and creator fees on swaps in quote-token terms, applying an anti-snipe surcharge during the initial blocks after token launch. Fees are routed to claimable balances for token creators and can be claimed via `claimFees`/`claimAllFees`.

hook.name: TailTwins
hook.description: Gates swaps by requiring the low byte of the swap size to be within 16 units (circular distance) of the low byte of the pool's current sqrtPriceX96. Takes a mandatory 10 bps fee on every swap's unspecified currency, sent to a hardcoded Aeon recipient via afterSwap return delta.

hook.name: PmavHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook-based token launchpad (pmav.fun V2) that deploys ERC-20 coins with a concentrated bonding curve position, enforces fair-launch rules including a block+1 trading delay, a 2% first-hour buy cap with auto-refund, and a decaying anti-snipe premium. Charges a 1% fee split 70/30 creator/platform. Graduates coins by replacing the curve with a permanently locked full-range position in the same pool.

hook.name: LaunchpadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for token launchpads that collects a percentage fee on every swap (via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas), splits fees between the token creator and platform treasury, distributes referral cuts, and tracks quote volume for token graduation logic.

hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: A meme coin launch platform that creates bonding curve pools on Uniswap V4 paired with a quote token. Features a concentrated liquidity curve with dynamic fees post-graduation, a permanent 2% wallet cap per tx.origin, optional anti-snipe decaying premium, creator/platform fee distribution, and pool graduation once a fundraising target is reached.

hook.name: RobinhoodArenaFeeHook
hook.description: Fee hook that collects and distributes swap fees via afterSwap delta return, with fee amounts calculated by an external fee helper contract per pool. Restricts pool initialization to an owner-controlled allowlist of approved deployers.

hook.name: Ponzuki
hook.description: Time-decaying swap fee that starts at 20% and linearly decays to 1% over the first hour after pool launch. Fees are split between the LP position (compounding), a project vault, a protocol fee recipient, and an optional referrer address passed via hookData.

hook.name: MixpadHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Mixpad token launches that collects platform swap fees on every trade, splits them between the token creator and treasury, optionally executes automatic buyback-and-burns from the creator's share, and applies a decaying anti-snipe surcharge in the blocks after launch plus a time-limited sell surcharge for the original deployer address.

hook.name: UniversalKlikHook
hook.description: Market-cap-tiered fee hook for ETH-paired pools that charges fees on buys and sells, splitting proceeds between a platform treasury and the token creator address. Fees range from 1% (low market cap) to 0.1% (high market cap), applied via BeforeSwapDelta on exact-input buys and AfterSwapDelta on exact-output buys and exact-input sells. Exact-output sells are blocked.

hook.name: PairV4Hook
hook.description: A gating hook that restricts pool initialization to a designated launchpad address. Pools must be pre-authorized by the launchpad with specific project/quote token pairs, fee (1%), and tick spacing before they can be initialized.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Saturn Omnichain that only activates on afterInitialize. It coordinates with an external liquidity bootstrapper contract to initialize pools and records the initial tick and pool initialization status on-chain.

hook.name: EthicsV4FeeModeV2
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook that collects a fixed 1% fee on swaps in the pool's quote currency, distributing it based on a configured mode: Creator mode splits between creator (70%) and an Ethics address (30%), Rewards mode splits between a rewards vault (90%) and Ethics (10%), and Burn mode burns the base token instead.

hook.name: GoldStandardHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook that adds a configurable fee to pools paired with a fixed ERC-20 reserve asset. Fees are denominated in the reserve and split between a fixed royalty recipient and the pool adopter recorded at initialization. An optional time-decaying launch surcharge applies to buys only. Exact-output swaps revert.

hook.name: FablesRWA
hook.description: Session-aware dynamic-fee hook for tokenized equity pairs. Computes LP fees from a configurable US market calendar (open, overnight, and closed session tiers with an opening descent ramp and closing ramp around the bell), with TTL-bounded operator poke overrides, all resolved at swap time via the beforeSwap fee-override return.

hook.name: HookrHook
hook.description: Shared Uniswap v4 hook for the Hookr launchpad implementing per-pool anti-snipe guards with temporal cumulative buy caps, surge-based dynamic LP fees, auto-burn of token output in afterSwap, in-swap LP reward donations, and a deterministic jackpot for qualifying buys.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that only activates on pool initialization. It stores a reference to a liquidity bootstrapper contract and records the initial tick after pool setup; all swap and liquidity callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: GammaHook
hook.description: Implements a time-decaying dynamic LP fee for pool launches: charges a high anti-snipe fee (peakFee) at launch that decays linearly to a steady-state base fee over a configurable shield window, then holds at baseFee. Fee configuration per pool is registered by a factory contract.

hook.name: GuardHook
hook.description: Restricts pool initialization to the factory address to prevent front-running of pool launch. All swap-time flags are disabled, so the hook is never invoked during trades; the pool fee serves as the creator tax.

hook.name: LaunchpadV4Hook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 launchpad hook that charges a fixed 1% base fee plus a per-pool creator tax (up to 10%) on swaps denominated in a configured payment token. Fees are minted as ERC-6909 claims and redeemable to immutable protocol and creator recipients; pool initialization and liquidity addition are gated to a designated factory and position manager.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers an afterInitialize permission (the callback is a no-op stub). Exposes an external initializePools() function that bootstraps liquidity via an external contract and records the initial tick and pool initialization state.

hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: Token launch hook that manages a Registered → Launching → Live lifecycle, restricting swaps to the factory during launch and applying a time-based anti-snipe fee (higher fee for SNIPE_DURATION seconds post-launch). Fees are extracted via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas in native ETH and routed to a per-pool FeeVault for the creator. Maintains an on-chain TWAP oracle updated on every swap.

hook.name: InstantHook
hook.description: Collects a fixed 1.50% fee on the ether leg of every swap in ether-quoted Uniswap v4 pools, routing proceeds to a per-market fee vault via ERC-6909 claims. The pool's LP fee is overridden to zero, making the hook fee the sole cost of a trade.

hook.name: FablesRWA
hook.description: Session-aware dynamic-fee hook for tokenized equity (RWA) pools. Adjusts LP fees based on a market calendar (open/overnight/closed sessions) driven by block.timestamp, with optional operator fee overrides ("pokes") bounded by TTL, configurable floor, and per-pool fee cap.

hook.name: GataraEthHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for token launches with native ETH as the quote currency. Charges directional fees (buy/sell) split between the pool creator, protocol treasury, and a time-decaying cocoon surcharge, using beforeSwap/afterSwap delta returns. Blocks buys in the exact launch-second as an anti-snipe guard.

hook.name: ArrakisPrivateHook
hook.description: Arrakis private vault hook that enforces per-direction dynamic LP fee overrides in beforeSwap and restricts liquidity additions to the vault's registered module only.

hook.name: PlebIndexFeeHook
hook.description: Charges an immutable ETH trade tax (up to 4%) on PLEB/ETH pool swaps, diverting the fee directly to a fixed treasury address via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta. Restricts pool initialization to native-ETH/PLEB pairs; has no owner or upgrade mechanism.

hook.name: CreatorFeeAntiSnipeHook
hook.description: Launchpad hook that charges a creator fee on every swap output (split 70/30 between creator and protocol) and caps exact-in WETH buy amounts during a configurable time-based launch window using a 3-phase curve (flat cap → linear ramp → uncapped) to reduce sniping at launch. Also supports multi-token LP reward distribution ("juice rail") using a fee-growth accumulator pattern.

hook.name: LiquidityGuardHook
hook.description: Restricts liquidity additions to a single authorized hub address by reverting in beforeAddLiquidity if the sender is not the hub. All other hook callbacks revert unconditionally. Swaps are unrestricted and behave identically to a standard Uniswap v4 pool.

hook.name: DelistGameHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the IndexPVP game that collects protocol fees (flat 1% + volatility-based dynamic component) on all swaps, overriding LP fees to 0. Includes per-pool circuit-breaker sell surcharges (up to 90%) and a global halt-window sell fee (20%), with liquidity and trading access restricted to a game contract.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy
hook.description: An ERC1967 upgradeable proxy whose implementation contract is not resolved. The hook has beforeSwap, afterSwap, and afterSwapReturnsDelta permissions, indicating it modifies swap outputs. The underlying implementation logic cannot be inspected from the verified proxy source alone.

hook.name: LaunchTaxHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook that collects a configurable swap tax (in the pool's quote currency) on token launches, splitting fees between a platform tax collector and the token creator. Trading is gated by a per-token start timestamp set by the launch factory.

hook.name: DoubleBackedFeeHook
hook.description: Takes a fixed 3% swap fee always in native ETH (currency0), splitting fee collection between beforeSwap (ETH-specified trades) and afterSwap (ETH-unspecified trades). All fees are forwarded to a vault address. Pools without native ETH as currency0 pass through without a fee.

hook.name: NovaHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook for factory-launched tokens that charges configurable protocol and creator swap fees on token/quote pairs, routing proceeds to token creators. Includes a time-decaying anti-snipe fee applied to buy-side swaps during the first N blocks after token launch, claimable on-chain by creators.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for the NASDANK memecoin launchpad that charges a configurable WETH-denominated fee on every swap through registered pools. Fees are collected via BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta return values and split between an immutable project treasury and protocol treasury, claimable permissionlessly by anyone.

hook.name: LittleJohnBondingHook
hook.description: A bonding-launch Uniswap v4 hook extending LittleJohnHook with a graduation milestone: once ETH absorbed (derived from post-swap sqrt price and fixed launch liquidity) reaches a threshold, emits BondingGraduated. Only the factory's initial liquidity add is permitted per pool; all subsequent adds revert. Fees are taken via return-deltas and minted as ERC-6909 native-ETH claims to LpLockerV4.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy
hook.description: Upgradeable hook deployed as an ERC1967 proxy; the implementation contract source is unresolved. Based on address flags, it intercepts swaps and liquidity additions, returning swap deltas from both beforeSwap and afterSwap.

hook.name: NexusHook
hook.description: A token-launch platform hook that charges configurable buy/sell fees and a block-based anti-snipe tax on registered tokens, taking fees directly from swap amounts via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta and routing them to token creators as claimable balances.

hook.name: VladdyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for native ETH/token pools that replaces LP fees with an instant ETH fee distribution mechanism. On every swap it takes a configured fee in ETH and splits it per-trade among a platform wallet, configured recipients, and a reserve used for buyback-and-burn, stock rewards, or staking distributions (robin mode).

hook.name: LaunchBeforeInitializeHookV1
hook.description: Gates pool initialization to a single authorized factory address, enforcing fixed launch economics: LP fee of 12,500, tick spacing of 200, ETH (address(0)) as currency0, and a fixed opening sqrt price derived from tick 191,200. Pool creation reverts unless the sender is the bound factory and all parameters match exactly.

hook.name: CoinbarrelAdvancedHookV3
hook.description: A custom accounting hook that implements configurable split fee policies (input-side and output-side pips), mints fee claims during swaps without transferring assets, accumulates liabilities across revenue, reinvestment, and rewards buckets, and maintains on-chain TWAP-style observations with tick and volume tracking.

hook.name: FactoryHook
hook.description: Singleton hook for graduated BCToken pools that computes a volatility-adjusted dynamic fee split between LP positions (via LP-fee override) and a protocol waterfall (via hook deltas). Blocks swaps until the coin graduates and supports an owner-controlled halt flag.

hook.name: PadHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for the Mixpad token launchpad. Collects a platform fee on every swap, splitting it between the token creator and treasury; a configurable portion is auto-routed to a buyback-and-burn. Applies a block-decaying anti-snipe surcharge on early buys and a time-decaying surcharge on sells by the original token deployer.

hook.name: VladsHook
hook.description:
Uniswap v4 hook on Robinhood Chain (4663). Flags 0x4cc
(afterAddLiquidity, beforeSwap/afterSwap + return deltas). Collects
protocol fees 2% buy / 2% sell in native ETH to feeRecipient. Exact-output
unsupported on tracked pool. Bound to native ETH + Vlads ERC-20 pool
(fee 10000, tickSpacing 60) after finalize.

hook.name: NasdankFeeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook that charges a configurable fee exclusively in WETH on both swap directions using return-delta accounting. Per-pool fee configurations are registered once by an authorized launcher and split between an immutable project treasury and protocol treasury.

hook.name: PRHook
hook.description: Captures a configurable buy/sell fee on each swap in PR-token pools and routes it to a designated buyback vault. Exact-output swaps are handled in beforeSwap via BeforeSwapDelta; exact-input swaps in afterSwap via AfterSwapDelta. Operates only on owner-allowlisted pools.

hook.name: LivoSwapHook (0.5 fee tier)
hook.description: Singleton hook charging a fixed 0.5% LP fee (split 50/50 between creator and treasury) and a time-limited sell tax on tokens launched via the Livo launchpad. Blocks all swaps before a token's graduation event.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that only uses afterInitialize as a no-op. All swap and liquidity callbacks return immediately without side effects. An external initializePools() function calls a LiquidityBootstrapper contract and records the initial tick.

hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that shields a designated main token from sell pressure by absorbing sells at pool price from a funded pot (beforeSwap delta), and pumps the main token by buying with pot secondary funds on buys (afterSwap nested swap). Supports hook-held LP positions with auto-harvesting and auto-compounding fee splits.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy
hook.description: An upgradeable ERC1967 proxy hook with beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeInitialize, afterInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, and afterSwapReturnsDelta permissions. The implementation contract source is not verified, so full behavioral analysis is not possible.

hook.name: FactoryHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for bonding-curve token factory pools that gates swaps until the token's LP stage is reached, applies a volatility-based dynamic fee split between LPs and a protocol treasury via beforeSwap/afterSwap deltas, and records tick observations with a truncated oracle.

hook.name: FlowPadCurveHook
hook.description: FlowPad bonding-curve launch hook. Seeds a pool with single-sided concentrated token liquidity; buyers walk the price down accumulating ETH, functioning as a real on-chain bonding curve. Enforces a configurable snipe guard (first N blocks restricted to the launcher), takes ETH-denominated trade fees split between creator and protocol via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, and supports permissionless graduation once the curve sells out.

hook.name: Spot
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that computes a two-component dynamic fee (base + surge) via an external fee manager and redirects a configurable share of swap fees into full-range protocol-owned liquidity through an external liquidity manager.

hook.name: TitanHook
hook.description: A fee-collecting hook for token launches that charges a configurable platform fee plus per-token buy/sell taxes on each swap, applies a time-decaying anti-snipe surcharge on buys made within a set number of blocks after launch, and routes all collected fees to the token creator's claimable balance.

hook.name: FablesRWA
hook.description: Session-aware dynamic-fee hook for tokenized equity (RWA) pools that adjusts LP fees based on US market trading sessions (open, overnight, closed) using a configurable on-chain calendar with opening descent and closing ramp mechanics. Supports per-pool directional fee premiums and admin fee overrides (pokes) with TTL expiry.

hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: A pmav.fun V2 bonding-curve fair-launch hook (quoted/RWA variant) that runs coin sales directly as a Uniswap v4 pool. Enforces a block+1 anti-snipe delay, a permanent 2% wallet-cap with auto-refund waterfall, and a decaying anti-snipe buy premium; on reaching the raise target it automatically graduates the pool to a standard Uniswap v4 position with permanently locked full-range liquidity.

hook.name: HookPadHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for all HookPad token launch pools, enforcing a 5-second anti-snipe window with a 60% buy tax routed to the protocol treasury, followed by a dynamic tiered buy/sell tax schedule cycling per global trade count. All fees are taken from the native ETH side of every swap and forwarded to a fee locker for distribution to the token creator or treasury.

hook.name: GreenTownV4Hook
hook.description: A graduation gate hook for GreenTown token pools that restricts pool initialization to a designated migrator and blocks all swaps until the pool is explicitly opened (after locked graduation liquidity is deposited). One hook instance serves all GreenTown tokens, with per-pool open state keyed by PoolId.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization via an external liquidity bootstrapper contract. All swap, liquidity, and donate callbacks are no-ops; only afterInitialize is active.

hook.name: ZentralCoreFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based dynamic fee hook for the Zentral launchpad. Fees scale between a per-pool base and max rate (0.25%–3%) based on previous-swap tick movement, collected in ETH, token, or both per pool configuration. Input-side fees are taken in beforeSwap; output-side fees in afterSwap. Exact-output swaps are rejected; only exact-input swaps are supported.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A minimal hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that registers afterInitialize to validate permissions. All swap and liquidity callbacks are no-ops. Pool initialization is handled externally via a liquidity bootstrapper contract that sets the initial tick.

hook.name: SniperHook
hook.description: A hook for factory-registered tokens that collects fees on buy and sell swaps using BeforeSwapDelta and AfterSwapDelta, applies an elevated snipe tax during the first N blocks after token launch, and accumulates collected fees claimable by token creators.

hook.name: PRNTRHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements tiered fee collection: charges an 85% anti-sniper fee for the first 30 seconds after pool launch, then applies a configurable base fee (100–500 bps). Fees are taken via poolManager.take() in both beforeSwap and afterSwap, accumulated per pool, and claimable by the factory in ETH.

hook.name: LivoSwapHook (1 fee tier)
hook.description: A singleton Uniswap v4 hook that collects a fixed 1% LP fee (split 50/50 between creator and treasury) on all swaps, plus a time-limited buy/sell tax, for tokens graduated via the Livo launchpad. Swaps revert before a token's graduation event.

hook.name: FoundryHookV4R2E2
hook.description: Market-cap-tiered fee hook for a token launch platform. Charges ETH-denominated fees on buys via dynamic LP fee override and on sells via afterSwap delta taking, accumulating sell fees on-hook for off-path locker withdrawal. Tracks bonding curve graduation progress.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records pool initialization state. Only the afterInitialize flag is active, but the callback is a pure no-op; an external initializePools() function delegates liquidity bootstrapping to a separate ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper contract. Swap behavior is entirely unmodified.

hook.name: HoodsHook  hoods.meme launchpad
hook.description: Uniswap v4 launchpad fee hook that collects a market-cap-tiered ETH fee (max 1%) on swaps via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas, splitting proceeds between a platform treasury and the token creator. Fees are waived on the pool's launch block and step down as market cap grows.

hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project that records the initial tick after pool initialization and delegates liquidity bootstrapping to an external LiquidityBootstrapper contract. No swap logic is implemented; all swap-related callbacks are no-ops.

hook.name: TripoolsAntiSnipeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for Tripools token-launch pools that enforces a 6-second anti-snipe window (50% flat tax on non-whitelisted buys) and a dynamic tiered fee schedule on all swaps. Ordinary buy/sell taxes split 20% to a protocol treasury and 80% accrued for the token creator in ETH; snipe taxes route 100% to the treasury.

hook.name: MultiHookHost
hook.description: Launchpad hook combining an optional anti-sniper temporal gate on early swaps, platform-and-creator fee redirection from swap output, and optional per-pool buyback-burn on token purchases. Pool initialization is restricted to an authorized Graduator contract set once by the deployer.

hook.name: TokenLaunchpad
hook.description: A permissionless token launchpad that deploys fixed-supply ERC-20 tokens and initializes native-currency Uniswap v4 pools with permanent bootstrapped liquidity. Uses beforeInitialize to revert any external pool initialization attempt, ensuring only the launchpad itself can create pools for launched tokens.

hook.name: PRAdaptiveHookv2
hook.description: Collects a configurable fee (0-5% max) on swaps involving the PR token. Buy fees are paid in PR, sell fees in ETH. Fees are forwarded to a buyback vault address. Only operates on owner-allowlisted pools.

hook.name: ERC1967Proxy
hook.description: Upgradeable ERC1967 proxy hook with beforeInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, and afterSwap permissions. The actual hook logic resides in an unverified implementation contract; behavior cannot be fully analyzed from the proxy source alone.

hook.name: QuiverHook
